Super super delicious!! You have to know what you’re doing when you specialize in one dish, and you keep your place packed!

reviews.author: pomodorini
reviews.title: Yummy Pho
reviews.content: One of our best pho experiences in Hanoi, would definitely recommend getting the basket of fried bread sticks to go along with the rich broth. The beef broth is very flavourful served with a generous serving of spring onions. Adding the lime and some chilli gives the soup an added kick. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Khanh
reviews.title: Good pho in a hole in the wall setting
reviews.content: The pho had good flavor although you can have the same at other Vietnamese restaurants.  Little to no English spoken here and service is non existent. You order, sit down and they bring you a bowl, then you pay and leave.

reviews.author: alexapaton
reviews.title: Best beef pho ever !
reviews.content: This place is worth the walk out of the old quarter. Absolutely delicious, the broth is still in my memory

reviews.author: Justin Li
reviews.title: No fuss beef pho
reviews.content:
Theres only one item on the menu and that's beef pho which is 60k. You can add a basket of deep-fried breadsticks for 10k as well.

The wait was only 1-2 minutes before we were tucking into a steamy bowl of deliciousness. The broth is much more flavoursome than other northern style pho recipes, featuring a meatier taste with plenty of spring onions, garlic and coriander.
The meat itself was cut into strips, similar to what you'd expect in a stir fry.

Overall the bowl was very full of meat and noodles. Fair price for a good meal.

reviews.author: chienwinston
reviews.title: The best Pho I have had in Hanoi
reviews.content: During 5-day trip in Hanoi, my wife and I have had 10 different type of Pho. Their soup of Pho is fabulous and meat is perfect tasty. It worths you visit. In addition, nearby a famous restaurant，Bun Cha Huong Lien ， where Barack Obama and Anthony Bourdain visited you won’t miss.

reviews.author: lornabroughton
reviews.title: A genuine experience and good food
reviews.content: It costs 55k per person for a very good bowl of pho (and that is your only choice). The surroundings are very genuine Vietnam (ie it looks somewhat like a tiny, grubby school canteen!) so don’t go if you want luxury. But it feels like a true Vietnamese dining experience with genuine local food.

reviews.author: Heguang Z
reviews.title: Best Pho
reviews.content: Simple place not far from Hanoi Opera. Fairly busy with both locals and tourists. The soup has deeper flavor than most others in the area. Definitely worth a visit. Also the place is not far from Bun Cha Obama.

reviews.author: Felix S
reviews.title: excellent portion - very simple place
reviews.content: This place was interesting to find. No overhead sign or something, just a small sign at the "entrance" with the cooking place next to it. The bowl of Pho was stuffed with noodles, meat and other ingredients, really a nice filling meal for little money.

reviews.author: Vienne Lam
reviews.title: Very good Pho. All trash on the floor.
reviews.content: Very good Pho with comparatively less MSG. When staff clean the table, he simply took away the bowls and wiped all the left over tissue papers on the floor. So you somewhat feel like you are eating in a pile of trash, but truly authentic local taste and experience.

reviews.author: EddieDean99
reviews.title: Best beef Pho in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Hands down the best beef pho I’ve ever had. From the broth to the noodles to the meat to the veggies, everything is fantastic. The beef somehow maintains its smokey flavour. This places only serves one thing and they do it extremely well. Definitely worth the trip out of the Old Quarter to try. 

Order when you arrive and then get a seat. A bowl costs 55k and the donuts are 10k for 6 I believe.

reviews.author: Clarence T
reviews.title: Best Pho ever!
reviews.content: Went there with a HanoiKids tour. The best pho I have ever eaten. Fresh local vegetables, thinly sliced beef, generous portion of rice noodles and tasty chilli sauce. All adding up to a great food experience!

reviews.author: Brooks T
reviews.title: Best in Town?
reviews.content: Walked in. Ignored. Found a spot. Ignored. Walked to the counter. Was told to come back in 5 minutes. Went back. Ignored. Looked and was unimpressed by hygiene. Left. Service is terrible. Highly unimpressed. This place seems to be coasting on its reputation nothing more.

reviews.author: Brenna Q
reviews.title: Great pho
reviews.content: Googled a good pho place and was not disappointed-didn’t know we had to pay first but it was fine anyways.

reviews.author: Geraldine E
reviews.title: Delicious Pho
reviews.content: Very good pho. Fast and fun. Friendly atmosphere with community seating. Chopsticks and condiments on the table. You’ll have a true local experience.

reviews.author: MshackW
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.content: We were in Hanoi with a tour, and went with our tour leader to have some Pho. It was fabulous. I highly recommend Pho Thin for the tourist that wants authentic Pho!!!

reviews.author: Jasey Ong
reviews.title: Best pho in Old Quarter!
reviews.content: The best pho I had in Hanoi! We try multiple outlets pho but this is just so accommodating! The soup and the beef is soo refreshing.

reviews.author: mattwalters94
reviews.title: Excellent pho
reviews.content: A convenient location to get a tasty bowl of pho. A great way to experience traditional Vietnamese cuisine.

reviews.author: flodahl
reviews.title: Great Pho
reviews.content: Go and try it at least once while you are in Hanoi! Pho using fried garlicky beef might be the best thing you will eat during your stay!

reviews.author: rachy135
reviews.title: Best pho during my trip!
reviews.content: Easily the best pho I had during my time in Vietnam. While the service is minimal, it’s efficient! The amount of herbs they put in the soup is delicious and the broth is outstanding. Highly recommend

reviews.author: An Doan
reviews.title: A traditional noodle of Hanoi
reviews.content:
I have been here for several times and this is my thoughts:
1/ You pay 50, 000 VND (2,3 Usd) for your noodle.
2 /  You can seat any where with local.
3/ Add your chilli sauce, garlic, fish sauce if you like.
4/ Quick eat and go because it’s very hot and very local.
5/ Don’t expect the best service here.
6/ They only serves Beef noodle soup and it’s very good for the price.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Does not taste like normal pho to me
reviews.content:
Yes its flavorsome, yes the beef is stir fried... but it just does not taste like 'normal' pho to me.... 

Good to try once to see what the hype is about.

Service zooming fast, pay first, find a seat (difficult at peak times a place is small). You get the food once you sit down :) 50k a bowl.. add eggs and bread sticks for a little more!

reviews.author: TimothyCCS8
reviews.title: Good local Pho for Breakfast
reviews.content: Had it first time with couple of friends yesterday. Food is good and the dough is delicious. Price is approx VND 50,000. So far the nicest Pho I had tried. Many locals and foreigners eat there. Just have to put up with tissues on the floor.

reviews.author: kiwilisa8
reviews.title: The only place where the food reaches the table before you do
reviews.content: Excellent pho, typical hole in the wall eatery, beef not as good as what you’d get in Australia but great for Vietnam. Strong flavour with lots of onions and greens.

reviews.author: Radu P
reviews.title: Very good pho for a cheap price
reviews.content: We went to this local restaurant on a recommendation from a friend. It was well worth the walk. Very good pho, big portion, with loads of noodles and tasty beef. The service was quick (although nobody spoke English) and quite cheap (45.000 VDN). Would definitely recommend as it’s off the beaten path

reviews.author: Shycourgette
reviews.title: A very good pho
reviews.content:
The place reminds me of Seinfeld's Soup Man. 
The guy serving is super professional and very fast. The beef broth is very tasty and comes with noodles, greens, raw egg plus pieces of beef. The only down size was that the beef was a bit overcooked.
Definitely an authentic place to try a great local dish.

reviews.author: maree150765
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content:
Amazing Pho, local restaurant. around 50,000 for the best Pho I've ever had!
Beef if really tasty and lots of spring onions.

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.title: The best Pho!!
reviews.content:
Amazing pho soup in this place, the beef broth is fantastic, the place is packed with locals.
Best pho so far in Hanoi!

reviews.author: jongjs
reviews.title: Famous, local pho place
reviews.content:
Another highly recommended spot but not the most amazing pho I have had. The dish itself has a lot of spring onions, which is a plus if you like them but a huge negative if you don't. I like spring onions so all is good.

The broth is pretty alright, come with this unique 'wok-hei' taste but yea, the meat can be a bit too tough. I remember the meat option was beef only, if I am not wrong. The serving itself is huge and I like that. Not the cheapest Pho option in Hanoi, but still worth trying out.

The shop itself has no signboard so keep a look out! We had it during a rainy day, the hot soup makes it felt extra nice and comforting.

reviews.author: Rathan K
reviews.title: Amazing Pho - off the beaten track
reviews.content: This place is a little away from the old quarter but is worth the extra walk. It was full of locals which is always a good sign. The Pho was heaped with meat and veggies although I would have preferred a bit more noodles. Order a bowl of fried dough to soak in the broth and squeeze some limes to add an extra kick to the Pho. Would highly recommend this place for anyone is search of delicious and cheap (VND 50,000 per bowl) Pho which is frequented by locals

reviews.author: DevinFarren
reviews.title: Stability!
reviews.content:
The quality of the dish is quite good only this point to note:
+) Meat hard to chew
+) I can not eat fresh onion, so it's hard to eat
+) Consumers should serve a little steam
=> slightly scared because the smell of the woman sitting next to

reviews.author: mooglemoon
reviews.title: Amazed by Pho
reviews.content:
Located near my hotel (hilton garden inn).
Recomended by hotel's receptionist.

Just random breakfast with my family, walked around 5 minutes from my hotel.

Place was so simple with several table, sit down and ordered pho.

No expectation or anything, just want to fill my empty tummy.

Once i took the first bite, it was just WOW. I amazed, beef was tender, broth was spiced perfectly and cakwe was good.

What a great breakfast!

Will i come back? Definitly!

reviews.author: MingZhuLiu
reviews.title: Fantastic Pho
reviews.content:
It's simple, you step in and pay for the bowl (50 000) 
Huge bowl of pho, full of spring onions and beef. Extremely filling and absolutely delicious! Best pho in Hanoi that we had.

reviews.author: meteorite10
reviews.title: The best Pho Bo I ever had.
reviews.content: The best Pho Bo I ever had. The atmosphere was the another thing I really appreciated. Definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Amalia C
reviews.title: Eat like a local
reviews.content: The Pho was amazing!!! That is all they serve. A big bowl of yummy broth with a perfect balance of noodles, meat and veggies. You get lots of sauces on your table to add your own touch.

reviews.author: Misael G
reviews.title: Still Dreaming of Pho Thin
reviews.content: I don't know what everyone else is saying about "just okay" but this was the best damn pho I had in Vietnam. I'm still dreaming of it - it's unique to this restaurant, as they sautéed the meat I garlic before adding it to the pho. I'd definitely go back here if I were still in Hanoi!

reviews.author: vivwanders
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.content:
Not worth extra effort to get there. But good enough if you're in the area.

Soup base a little oilier than I like, and not quite as a beefy a I wanted. And a little too much spring onion (but you can request less, I would do this next time). Beef pieces itself were good.

Lots of locals here. Easy to order as they only serve pho, owners/staff are friendly enough.

reviews.author: carlosbiazotto
reviews.title: Local eatery
reviews.content: When in Hanoi you will probably find thousands of Pho places, which is the most traditional vietnamese dish, but this one specifically is worth the visit. It is not a tourist spot, there is only one choice of food (which is delicious) and it is very cheap. Be prepared to pay in cash as credit cards are not accepted.

reviews.author: krysten_gibson
reviews.title: Amazing Pho and Great atmosphere
reviews.content: It was love at first Pho. It was sooo amazing. The flavor was so good and the owners were so amazing. Smiles all around. There was a family near by us that had a baby that was crying and one of the owners took over holding and comforting the little guy so the mom could eat. Cannot wait to hopefully be back here again soon!

reviews.author: Silviactwilson
reviews.title: Awesome food!
reviews.content: Restaurants seem to specialize and serve a limited menu. This was limited to pho. But it was exceptional and so well priced. A perfect evening for $10 for 2 (including beer)

reviews.author: Stefanie H
reviews.title: Authentic experience
reviews.content: I ate here twice in my week in Hanoi. First time with a friend I was travelling with. Really fun atmosphere and pho was good. Not mind blowing. Went again when she was sick one day and loved the experience squeezing into a table of locals and enjoying my pho while I poured with sweat

reviews.author: Allyse H
reviews.title: Best pho bo I had in Ha Noi
reviews.content: No nonsense pho bo outfit serving up deliciousness. Best bowl of pho I've had in Vietnam yet. (And I did a lot of googling for "best pho Hanoi," followed by a lot of slurping.) Relatively lean meat, which is my preference, delicious broth, generous portions.

reviews.author: hk_asiapearl
reviews.title: The soup for the pho
reviews.content: Wow, as great as it can be.  The pho and the soup is great, the beef is very good too.  Too bad there's only one thing to order here, so if you are not really in the area, I recommend you not to go to this area just for this

reviews.author: HanumI
reviews.title: Not as good as I thought it will be
reviews.content: Not as good as I thought it will be. We went there because of the reviews and blogs but we think the taste was just average. Not really special.

reviews.author: oroclom
reviews.title: Worth the Visit
reviews.content: Pho Thin was one of those places I was pretty sceptical about (having seen reviews on youtube about it), the place was pretty dirty and run down, the staff weren't particularly friendly but if you can get your head past all that - this was one of the best bowls of Pho I've had in years. Make sure you put some of that vinegar(?) chilli sauce in and soak your fried dough bar thingies in your soup before eating. It makes ALL the difference. Worth making a trip to if you're staying in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Janis K
reviews.title: Delicious, authentic and cheap
reviews.content:
Delicious, authentic and cheap. Really hit the spot on a hungry Saturday afternoon.
Thanks for the yummy food! see again

reviews.author: morganjacob924
reviews.title: Yummy
reviews.content:
Delicious dish. A bit different from the old style pho with the meat being stirred fry before. The soup is a bit fatter but the mix is so good.
The price is also fix so no need to worry about being unfair with Western people

reviews.author: Travelmax71
reviews.title: Delish Pho Bo
reviews.content: Hands down, the best Pho Bo in Hanoi. They use  braised beef which I guess adds some taste. Always very busy ... don't give up, wait for your turn and you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Waratahers
reviews.title: Worth the visit
reviews.content:
We were staying in the French Quarter so only a short walk. It would be so easy to walk past as it is only a small entrance so look for the 13. We were there around 6pm so it was not too crowded, but still a few locals eating. You pay at the entrance 50,000 I asked for no beef and it was only 30,000. The no beef is not suitable for a vegetarian but I am only semi vegetarian. We were seated along the wall and served very fast. There is no explanation of what to do so jut ahead and eat. The soup was wonderful, you can add sauce but be careful as the chilli slice is hot.
As I was leaving I bought a bottle of the chilli sauce for home. Took a bit of signe language but the cook told the severs what I wanted. 
One tip is to take a drink with you, I think they had drinks for sale but we could not work out how to get one. We walked in with our own water and beer.
This is a not a relaxing sit down, but more of a local experience.

reviews.author: rangakmurthy
reviews.title: Best Pho!
reviews.content: After reading reviews on TripAdvisor, I had to try this place despite some concerns of cleanliness by reviewers. Yes, it’s not the most aesthetically appealing joint, but their Pho is worth it. I wandered into the place and realized I was among locals (no tourists at all). A local gentleman sitting in front of me said he loved this place and it’s very famous among the locals, and rightly so. I will confidently say that this was the best Pho I’ve had in Hanoi.

reviews.author: LuchinoBrooklynNYC
reviews.title: A winner!
reviews.content: Recommended by our tour guide, a lifelong resident of Hanoi. Superb beef noodle soup, on one  of the most fascinating, not touristy streets you will encounter in Hanoi. The soup broth, in which bones are steeped for hours, is outstanding.

reviews.author: OurManIn
reviews.title: Our guides favourite Beef Pho cafe in Hanoi
reviews.content: Off the tourist track, a fabulous steaming hot beef Pho. Place was heaving at 8am with workers on their way in to work. Scruffy, ramshackle, but apparently a gold mine for the owners. For us, very tasty- added chilli and sauce woke up the morning taste-buds. A good cut above. Probably a taxi ride or motorbike pillion ride from the Old Quarter, some distance from the other end of the lake. Sorry about the crap pictures.

reviews.author: Al M
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content: The pho itself is ok, nothing special. The place is very full and popular among locals. Be aware:  it is very dirty.

reviews.author: Judy L.
reviews.title: Authentic and tasty beef pho, great local place
reviews.content: I rode on the back of an UberMoto moped at 6 in the morning to get to this place from the Old Quarter to make sure I would be breakfasting with locals.  The 10 minute ride was so worth it just to see the two chefs smiling, wondering what some tourist was doing in front of their restaurant at this time of day.  I've seen some reviews where people said the staff was rude or just ignored the tourists, but I find that a greeting in a country's native language usually helps to break the ice.  So, in my terribly accented Vietnamese I asked for one bowl of pho, "mot bat pho."  Please note that this restaurant does NOT serve pho ga (or pho with chicken), only pho bo (pho with beef), so it makes ordering much easier.  I got a thumbs up, and then I sat down on a long bench at a long table, where I shared breakfast with 8 other locals -- not a tourist in sight.  The broth alone justified the early visit -- great beefy flavor, not greasy, and a tad sweet from the meat and green onions.  I threw in some fresh chilis, a couple squeezes of lime juice and a lashing of the special chili sauce.  This is truly the breakfast of champions!

reviews.author: Dominic N
reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.content: I can eat Pho Thin ALL DAY. The food was amazing and cheap. The place is a bit small but the food was amazing.You know a place is good when it is popular with even the locals.

reviews.author: Marco L
reviews.title: WOW!!!
reviews.content: Just fantastic, flavorful and very authentic! You would sit right next to Vietnamese people. That's when you know that the food is gonna be the best!

reviews.author: georgeu761
reviews.title: They sell beef pho and chinese donuts!
reviews.content:
This place is a no BS place.  They sell beef pho and you can have chinese donuts (油條) to dip into the soup.  That’s it.  They do both extremely well.  You pay first, you sit down, and then they give you a bowl of hot Pho Bo (beef). Pho will cost 50k VND and chinese donuts (油條) will cost you 10k VND for a basket of 5-8.  [these prices reflected as of 2018]

You’ll see a mixture of tourists and locals - which generally signifies that tourists see it as safe, locals see it as affordable, and both as good.

reviews.author: ryantravelor
reviews.title: A bit far from old quarter Hanoi
reviews.content: The food is decent, but the location is a bit far from the old quarter Hanoi.  Its definitely a taxi ride from old town so it makes it less desirable being there are so many other options closer.

reviews.author: Travel235640
reviews.title: Good Pho but Cruel
reviews.content: I went here alone and ordered one pho to eat in, and one to go. Very little English spoken. Pho was good, but when I left and waited to pick up the to-go pho, there was confusion and I was blatantly ignored for 15 minutes. I was also subjected to invasive stares and comments directed at my bare legs (I was wearing shorts). I was then asked to pay again, very rudely. I refused, explained I had already paid, and was ignored again. Left without the second order. If you come here be ready to possibly be treated quite badly.

reviews.author: jackiejg
reviews.title: Simple and delicious Pho Bo.
reviews.content: We visited this place following a recommendation on a couple of different travel sites. It was worth the walk. We got there not long after midday and just in the nick of time as it turns out as we were the last to be served before they sold out! Tasty and delicious street food at its best.

reviews.author: TMLee2014
reviews.title: Wonderful pho
reviews.content: Simply yummilicious! Smooth yet firm rice noodles, light yet fragrant soup, tender beef strips 👍 Add in the home-made chilli sauce & u get a new wonderful spicy taste. Great to go with the deep fried dough stick (yau-char-gwai).  One minus point: very difficult to get seats & have orders come due to language obstacles.

reviews.author: Nixek2810
reviews.title: Best pho ever
reviews.content: It’s the best pho I have ever eaten. The broth is clear yet sweet. The beef is actually nothing special but it’s the pho and broth that stand out. Went back to eat a second time before leaving Hanoi. Addicted!

reviews.author: MWoo
reviews.title: Good Pho, poor hygiene
reviews.content: While it surely looked like the restaurant had a good mix of locals and tourists, which is usually a good indication of a authentic restaurant. The hygiene was extremely poor, my kids ordered to bowls of dishes but no one tried them as sighted something not sanitary in the process. Will not be back

reviews.author: J Russell W
reviews.title: Limited Pho Choice
reviews.content: It is kinda a cross between a street food and a small greasy spoon. Communal tables, noise and local flavor and tourist alike. When we went, they told us no Pho Ga (chicken) only Pho Bo (beef). I could of swore I saw a chicken parts being boiled for Pho stock So be prepared to know and order what you want quickly, not much tolerance for us tourist.

reviews.author: Tung Dao
reviews.title: Overpriced and overated
reviews.content:
I'm an Hanoian and has been here for several times and while the Pho here was good it's nowhere the best Pho place in Hanoi. Too many green onion and the broth is too fat, the beef is stir fry before adding so this is absolutely not the original way of making Pho.
And you can buy 2 bowls of Pho from other vendor for 1 bowl here.

reviews.author: Danielle S
reviews.title: Best Pho!
reviews.content: We came here as our first meal in Hanoi and were not disappointed. It had set the bar for all other Pho. You walk into this tiny cramped aromatic spot and are ushered to a seat where you are quickly served a bowl of steaming hot pho.  They give you a really generous protein helping which is super important to us who are used to getting in a lot of protein and less carbs in our macros and suffer a huge inverse of this in Southeast Asia. So the big portion of meat was a wonderful surprise and it was delicious! I added the various spices available and I almost wish I didn’t because the broth is so perfect as it is. Find time to go here during your stay!

reviews.author: Jocelyn H
reviews.title: Above average Pho
reviews.content: It's pretty good. Unfortunately, there's no menu only one type of pho (tai) and its well done when it's arrives your table. The fried donut comes but is extra. A small and narrow joint for most locals its a quick stop for a fast bite. They even bottle and sell that hot sauce. Worth stopping for If your in Hanoi

reviews.author: Jessiekan
reviews.title: Best pho
reviews.content:
During this trip, I have been to 3 famous pho shop, Pho Gia Truyen,  Pho 10 and Pho Thin. I personally like this the most, also because I like spring onions, this pho has lots of spring onions on top. And I found this soup base more sweet, I mean the sweet taste from the beef. And it has more beef than noodles ! 

One thing is the shop rather difficult to find , they don’t have a shop sign at the top. At first, we kept looking up at the top of the shops, but we couldn’t find and after that we realised there was just a little sign standing there.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Best pho in all of Vietnam
reviews.content: We absolutely loved this Pho.... the broth was so delicious that we didn't really need to add anything but some chilli. The taste is so different than the pho we had in ho chi Minh and hoi an. We were also told to order some fried bread like sticks and dunk in the pho till it soaks the juices and omg it was absolutely delicious and I have not seen this anywhere! If you are in Hanoi, please try and get to this place as it is Amazing!

reviews.author: luckybemery
reviews.title: Just walk in holding up the right number of fingers
reviews.content:
Sought out this place after arriving in Hanoi. Came with solid recommendation and didn't let us down. We stood outside sheepishly waiting for some attention before copying the locals, walking in, "xin chao, three please".

Delivered in seconds, quickly followed by green lemons and cold "Churros". Fish sauce and chilli on the table. 

Really amazing authentic experience (so busy following school pick up time). In slurp it down, then out! No beer, no plesentry, efficient. Even refused a tip of a couple of quid and retained a tip of local appropriateness. 

Very friendly on the way out - hopefully because we all, including my 12 year old, demolished the lot.

Recommend!

reviews.author: GM8868
reviews.title: Pho Thin
reviews.content: We had a good pho dinner here in this very authentic pho restaurant and all was very tasty with good service and basic bench seating

reviews.author: angusm9410
reviews.title: Authentic Pho!
reviews.content:
We were recommended this place as one of the best places in town for authentic Pho. The recommendation did not disappoint! The Pho was the best we have had so far!

The restaurant is bare bones and more of a street food style with common tables that can be shared.
 
Highly recommend to visit during your stay in Hanoi! The price was excellent aswell, approximately 2 USD per Pho.

reviews.author: Sarah F
reviews.title: Amazing Pho!!!
reviews.content: Don’t be scared off by the seeming lack of hygiene in the place lol the food was amazing, best pho I had in Hanoi. Only one type so just sit down and they will bring it right away. I’d recommend to add the chili sauce!

reviews.author: R K L
reviews.title: It was not faux pho...
reviews.content: We were staying at the Hilton Garden Inn Hanoi and were turned on to the Pho Thin Restaurant by one of their excellent front desk clerks. The restaurant was literally across the street, looked like just another small local store front but was an absolutely amazing culinary surprise. It was not faux pho in even the smallest way. We had never tasted better! The service was friendly, fast and efficient...the restaurant just casual and fun. There was nothing that could be pretentious about this place. They just had GREAT pho! We actually returned multiple times for a late night snack during our Hanoi stay, even when we were staying at the Hanoi Hilton a few more blocks away. Their prices were incredibly inexpensive so don't tell them!

reviews.author: Spring T
reviews.title: OMG good
reviews.content: This pho is definitely in the top five for me. The broth is delicate and delicious, with lots of yummy meat and spring onions. Ample limes on the table, and a great chili sauce. They only do one dish so just find a seat, sit down and they will bring you a bowl of deliciousness - no need for ordering! 50,000 a bowl, great price for great food.

reviews.author: Kamil
reviews.title: Unexpectedly good pho in simple place
reviews.content: Full of taste pho, delicious pasta. Pretty difficult to find, but worth to look for. Good, fixed price.

reviews.author: hannostamm
reviews.title: One of the better Pho places
reviews.content: I have lived here for 20+ years and during that time have had a Pho or 2. I prefer Ha Noi Pho and would rate this as one if the better ones I have had. Disregard comments about lack of hygiene, it is a regular local restaurant with a turn-over ensuring the food is fresh. Pay at the entrance (VND 50,000), grab a plate of bread sticks (VND 5,000), add a dollop of their excellent chili sauce (free) and have some Pho bliss head your way.

reviews.author: David O
reviews.title: Simple breakfast
reviews.content:
I really enjoyed my Pho Thin at the Helio cafe at Ly Thường Liet and Phan Chu Trinh Road junction.
The stock, stick dough and chicken are fresh and it is not salty non sweet.
Enjoy watching the morning rush while sitting on the elevated terrace under the bright red umbrella.

reviews.author: Stektan
reviews.title: Great street Hanoi pho
reviews.content: Not all Pho are created the same.. The north and the south have different styles of Pho and its often a debate about which is better. In the north however, there's one street pho that dominates here. Very popular with both tourists and local alike, this place has been around for a while. It's not the typical Vietnamese restaurant that made it good and now renovated itself to tourist standards. The place is still dirty and the extension comes with low tables, low chairs and dirty floors. Not recommended for the fussy tourist looking for a clean, hygienic place. But if it's the food that you only care about, the Pho is very tasty. It's very unlike the ones from Saigon but the meat is juicy and the soup delicious. You pay slightly above the average for the street food but way below restaurants and hotel. Recommended for a stop over if you're not fussy about hygiene and cleanliness.

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Just good pho. Just worth to try it.
reviews.content:
Just a good pho bo. Dunno difference between 
Soup was great, but lil bit sweet and sour to my taste. Kinda think soup, strong flavour, chewy beef and soft noodle. If you guys prefer mild soup and chewy noodle like us, find the otherwhere else. 
I heard here is really famous among Korean community and ma Korean friend recommended here but actually nothing special. However, we totally understand that this pho is Asian people-prefer-flavour. We actually saw so many Koreans and Vietnamese here except for just one western guy (and he left most of food). 
If you like spring onion, try to go there.

한국인 친구가 한국에서 유명하다며 추천을 해주어서 엄청 오래 걸어서ㅠㅠ (20분?) 왔어요.  Pho Thin Bo Ho와 Pho Thin 이 무슨 관계인지는 모르겠지만, previous one이 닫아서 여기로 왔어요. 

국물은 대파때문에 새콤한맛이 나고요, 고기국물 자체의 단맛이 있어요.
다른 집에 비해 국물이 thick하고 간이 쎄서 아시아인/한국인이 확실히 좋아할 맛이었어요. 대파 많이넣은 갈비탕국물이랄까? 저희 맛은 아니었어요ㅠ

실제로 손님 10팀중 4팀은 베트남 5팀은 한국인 1팀은 서양인이었어요. 국수먹다가 서양인하고 친해졌는데 웨스턴사람 맛은 아닌가봐요.ㅋㅋ 저희처럼 간 센거 싫으시고 싱겁게 드시는분, 마일드한 국물좋아하시는 분들 비추천이구요.
면이 부드럽다고 하시는데, 저희 입에는 불은 면 이상 이하두 아니었어요.. 호불호 갈릴듯 하네요.

튀김빵은, 맛없다는 평을 듣고 왔지만 정말루 맛이 없어요...ㅋㅋㅋ 

가게는 깨끗하지 않고, 바쁘면 테이블도 치우지않고 그대루 두니까 알아서 치우시고 앉아야하는점 기억하세요ㅠㅠ
확실한거는, 너무 기대하면서 오래 걸어서 찾아오지는 마시라는거...

reviews.author: s b
reviews.title: Late lunch
reviews.content: Went here based on reviews. Did not disappoint. Set price 50 000 dong for the best pho in Hanoi...so far.

reviews.author: Aliza D
reviews.title: Proper street food
reviews.content: Amazing pho down a tiny alley in Hanoi, almost would have walked past. Sit at the one table and pick a size of bowl and they'll provide you with delicious food!

reviews.author: Duc Huynh
reviews.title: Taste is good
reviews.content: Not a fan of Pho but this Pho is good, I like it. But the environment is not: small, hot, crowded and untidy. This is just a place for eating, you cannot stay for chatting coz there are always lots of people queuing and staring at you.

reviews.author: Jadex3
reviews.title: Good pho (beef)
reviews.content: You walked in and pay up front when you make an order (Cost 50,000VND). Be sure to request for the fried bread. They are free and you're supposed to eat it by soaking it into your pho soup.  Definitely must visit and try when you come to Hanoi. (Warning: The place lacks a bit of atmosphere and hygiene)

reviews.author: HidehikoMURAO
reviews.title: "Phở Bò" is very good !!
reviews.content:
I was brought to a store by a friend living in Hanoi. Most of the customers are Vietnamese. 
I arrived at the shop around 9:30 am, but already a lot of people were eating phở and it was full. 
I ordered "phở bò". The soup is very tasty, the noodles are thick and delicious. 
Vietnamese people were eating "quay" soaked in phở 's soup. It looked very delicious, so I want to try it next time. 
I ate on the outdoor seating. If you squeeze the lime after eating about half, you can enjoy a refreshing different taste.

reviews.author: Huy L
reviews.title: good Pho bo
reviews.content:
yeah a good taste of Vietnamese famous Pho bo (beef noddle) that attracts many locals and tourists. maybe some still concern about the hygiene, the quality of the pho thin is confirmed through many years. 

you should try Pho Thin when you visit Hanoi

reviews.author: Joshua D
reviews.title: Pho-sure!
reviews.content: Good Pho! The atmosphere is very simple with benches & no air conditioning other than fans. However, the Pho is worth the lack of atmosphere.

reviews.author: Khiem Vo
reviews.title: Not hygiene, may use MSG
reviews.content:
Firstly the chef and the staffs used the same hands they touch the money to touch the food and serve you.

The soup is delicious because maybe they used MSG. We're both super sensitive with MSG, it makes us super weak and sleepy instantly so we know.

reviews.author: jfavril
reviews.title: Excellent soup but only soup
reviews.content: It is a fix price of 50k for the pho that you pay before you enter. Typical Vietnam canteen, so not very nice decoration neither very clean but the Pho is one of the best ever. Includes meet so not good for vegan

reviews.author: Sue Ann L
reviews.title: Delicious cheap Pho - must try Vietnamese street food
reviews.content: Was introduced to this place by the local tour guide. Easy to miss entrance, very basic set up. Very cheap and flavourful bowl of Pho for $2. Pots of broth boiling over burning coal. Rumoured to be the 1st ever Pho stall in Hanoi since 1956. No upset tummy after - big win!

reviews.author: Andrew G
reviews.title: Great food, what a place!
reviews.content:
We got advise to go here from a local.

It was fan-bloody-tastic !

So ... we saw the sign and thought it was down the alley. We didn't realise that it was the alley!

We sat and ask for 2. They brought us the most delicious pho that we had ever had. Huge bowl each with spices, corianders and greens that we could add if we wanted 

It was dead basic but super yummy. Proper food!

reviews.author: Cornelius L
reviews.title: Excellent Pho, friendly people
reviews.content: A family run stall that serves amazing pho. The owner was super friendly and advised us on how to properly enjoy pho. Great food great experience

reviews.author: Zoe S
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: One of my favorite Pho in Hanoi. Pho with beef was delicious, I like the broth very much. It is more tasty with the sauce, everything just simply melted in your mouth. However, the alley is quite hard to find but still highly recommend!

reviews.author: misspink1976
reviews.title: Local food, family run, good prices.
reviews.content: We went to this restaurant as part of a food tour. The food was amazing. The Dough Bread was delicious. The restaurant has been open since the 50's and was one of the first pho soups. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Davie_T_Edinburgh
reviews.title: Wow...worth seeking out
reviews.content: Our first proper street food experience that fulfilled our expectations. An easy to miss alley that you should make the effort to find. Small, standard or jumbo Pho Bo with a beer and a massively tasty and spicy jar of sauce on the table is a thoroughly satisfying experience. Be brave, street food is not for the faint hearted. You will be rewarded with delicious steaming hot soup and beer for little cost and a memory of food that will never leave you. Hanoi would not be Hanoi without it.

reviews.author: Benjamin O
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: We had an amazing experience eating here. You go in and just ask for two as the only food they serve is Pho. It is packed with locals and you find a seat on the busy tables and the food is served to you very quickly. Location wasn't amazing but it is very cheap to get an Uber or I would say it is worth walking. I would definitely recommend this place if you want to fully experience the culture.

reviews.author: Crystal N
reviews.title: Simple yet pack with flavor
reviews.content: This Place is a hidden gem. They only serve one type of bowl here and once size. Beef with noodles. Its hot in the restaurant but you get pretty used to it. Restaurant is clean and service is fast and friendly. Definitely worth a try when you are in hanoi.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Hands down, the best pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: My wife and I love pho and we ate at many places in Hanoi. And this was the best. The. Best. The owner does something a bit different - instead of raw round or flank steak, he sautees the beef with garlic BEFORE adding it to the piping hot broth, and the meat becomes both chewy AND tender. It's wonderful. Add to it a bunch of flavorful green onions and a few spoonfuls of their chili oil / sauce...and you've got the best pho in Hanoi. We ate their twice...in less than 24 hours!

reviews.author: CoryMay
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content:
I'm no master of Pho but I know when I stumble upon deliciousness. My airport taxi recommendes this place to me. After checking into my AirBNB, I walked right over to this place.
It was fairly easy to find, but the sign isn't above the door. It's a metal sign board as you can see in my photo.
You go in, just say how many pho bo you want, and if you want the bahn quay dough sticks. It's literally all they serve. You can also get tea and other drinks there.
The staff were super kind and service was super fast. On the table are condiments to add to your bowl. Vinegar with chillies, a spicy pepper paste, and slices of red chillies. Also some black pepper if you like. Make sure to also squeeze a wedge of lime and mix it all up!
The rice noodles were very light and nice. The meat was slightly tough, but had that good smokiness flavor to it. The broth is clean and light but had a depth to it. I wish I knew the recipe!
As you're eating, just drop a whole dough stick in and let it soak up the soup while you eat the noodles.
It was a great lunch! Highly recommend it!

reviews.author: HungoverTT
reviews.title: Eat like the locals
reviews.content: street side eating experience and its very affordable. You shouldnt miss this when you are at hanoi.

reviews.author: Bazzamat
reviews.title: Authentic Hanoi experience
reviews.content: Hand in your 50000 Dong, scrabble to find a seat and wait for the only thing on the menu to be served. An amazing Pho Bo eaten shoulder to shoulder (literally) with the locals. Great find thanks to our guide and well worth a visit. My only advice - go steady on the Chilli sauce!

reviews.author: Christian G
reviews.title: The local experience
reviews.content:
Nice experience,  the entire communication with the staff was limited to holding up fingers and nodding appreciably.
The result: most delicious Pho Bo we had. Not a comfy place but very well invested 2  bucks for a local experience.

reviews.author: HamidDR
reviews.title: Really simple but delicious food
reviews.content:
The place is small and would not win any design contests, but the service is quick, food is fresh and delicious. 
Great place for a quick bite.

reviews.author: sorrycoffey
reviews.title: Phở ăn được
reviews.content: The things are good, but it's rather expensive. Anyway i usually choose to eat whenever i go to hanoi.

reviews.author: anjakeen
reviews.title: Straight forward, delicious, satisfying.
reviews.content:
Came here for my dose of Pho for breakfast. 
You sit. They bring your Pho. You eat. You pay. 
The best there is and very inexpensive. 
Not to be missed!

reviews.author: Marjorie E
reviews.title: Dirty but good
reviews.content: It's sad to see people that just throws out their rubbish on the floor, when they have the bin right next to them. The person that stand at the door collects the money upon entering and was quite rude. A good place to have a quick pho despite the mess & ambience. Pho was very delicious though, even without the vegetables that usually come with it on the side. One of the most tasty pho we have eaten here in Vietnam.

reviews.author: spibzy
reviews.title: Pho sho
reviews.content: Very tasty pho at a very tasty price. It is not a fancy place - no aircon. Be advised, sanitary conditions are not like they are in the United States or in Europe - but everyone's eating it so it can't be that bad for ya right?

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Great First Meal
reviews.content:
This place is open at 5A and we were stir crazy so we went for a stroll, didn't regret it.

I mean, listen, this place won't get an A from the Health Inspector, so don't expect it, but the food was great (they only serve one dish...Pho w Beef), and great price.

reviews.author: Kevin W Chan
reviews.title: Very Authentic Pho! Local Style!
reviews.content:
This Pho establishment is very 'family style' - so do not expect fancy environment, or fancy setting. You might have to share the long table with other customers, or even 'sharing' condiments on the long table!
But the taste is so authentic that you might come back for more!
One thing different between Vietnam northern region Pho and southern region Pho is that: In the north, they won't provide you with a lot of raw veggies by the side, unlike Southern region where a lot of fresh veggies will be provided by the side and you may add-as-you-like!

reviews.author: CHTrips
reviews.title: Pho Thin
reviews.content: The Pho here was absolutely delicious until we saw the lady clearing and cleaning off the tables pick her nose and flick her bugger on the floor.  We completely lost our appetite and left and hoped she had nothing to do with food prep, cleaning dishes or anything to do with the food we just consumed.

reviews.author: Jhoanne S
reviews.title: Super flavorsome!
reviews.content: Found this place via a recommendation on TripAdvisor and it is awesome! Great value (large servings) and so authentic. The broth is so flavorsome!

reviews.author: JonoMichaelL
reviews.title: One of the best pho in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Executive summary:

Pros - proper chairs and tables, great pho, clear prices

Cons - none

Top tip
1)Go and eat here during off peak times to avoid queues. 
2)Look for the metal plate, there are some other pho thins around the area

reviews.author: anhminht3011
reviews.title: Trust me, I grew up on this street
reviews.content:
Go for the "phở tái lăn" (pho with sauteed beef), it's the signature dish. Broth is traditional beef broth with souce from the sauté, rich and greasy. May make you feel full - squeeze some lime to balance then 🍲

Order right at the entrance (where they make the food) before you enter the dining area. Waiters speaks little English so talk to them loud and clear. The place is super crowded and dirty in peak hour (especially in weekend) and closes after lunch until before dinner (12pm-6pm I assume). Mind your time 🕐

reviews.author: Camila D
reviews.title: Great Pho!!
reviews.content: Great place to eat amazing pho in Hanoi, reasonable prices and friendly staff. Totally recommended!!

reviews.author: Hanh L
reviews.title: Traditional food
reviews.content: The taste of food is delicous. They have a lot of customers. The restaurant is not clean. It's old, small, noisy.

reviews.author: Jeffrie T
reviews.title: Essentially Hanoi.
reviews.content:
Essentially Hanoi.

You just cannot missed this place.

A rendition of Pho that was a joy to eat and experience at 50,000 dong A$3.

Comes with Chinese Donuts, Beers 15,000 dong A$1

As fresh and historically as it can be.

reviews.author: thibbs1955
reviews.title: Average
reviews.content: I guess after a month of Asian cuisine this noodle restaurant was not that impressive. It was actually a little dirty.

reviews.author: Sophia T
reviews.title: Best Pho of our trip!
reviews.content: Tried a couple of highly recommended places for Pho while in Hanoi, but this place topped it for us! Really delicious and fresh, packed full of locals so you know it's good! Add some fresh chili and squeeze some lime in for an extra kick!

reviews.author: NhungNguyen811
reviews.title: Best "pho" in town
reviews.content: This is probably the one that serves the best "pho" in Hanoi. The taste is soooo delicious and different from other restaurants. This place is small with signature "local" style. I haven't eaten here for awhile since I moved to HCMC. Though the taste is yummy, but the service was bad, the sellers acted like we were craving for food. Hope they're getting better now.

reviews.author: MiddlemLeeds
reviews.title: Loved our Pho
reviews.content: The food here was great. We found it through trip advisor and being near to our hotel we searched it out. The meal was tasty and cheap. Not much to add from the other reviews on here. If you are nearby and in search of tasty, well made Pho then. Check it out.

reviews.author: Henry M
reviews.title: The Best Pho Ever!
reviews.content:
I absolutely love this place and always return on my first day back to Hanoi on my frequent business trips to this enchanting city. The broth is exquisite and a lot of care and expertise is involved in making this, believe me! 

Pho Thin is an absolute must when visiting Hanoi and I couldn't recommend it more! Enjoy!

reviews.author: gigant09
reviews.title: Best place for Pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: The most authentic Pho in Hanoi. Super fast service. 100% to recommend. Please order some Quay, without it only taste half as good.

reviews.author: Humanitas D
reviews.title: Satisfying comfort food
reviews.content: This place sells one thing and one thing only: beef rice noodle.   It's a small and unpretentious place, but the portion is big and delicious.    It's a must for anyone visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: desparatehousewife07
reviews.title: Inexpensive noodle shop.
reviews.content: We had an amazing experience in this very well attended restaurant attended by lovcals.   The food was pleasantly prepared and unhurriedly served to us.

reviews.author: Jen729
reviews.title: Amazing pho
reviews.content: Amazing pho.  The broth was the best part.  So flavorful! Would definitely recommend to anyone, but don't be like my husband and ask for a spoon 😀

reviews.author: Nur Alia Ahmed A
reviews.title: A fresher touch to a classic dish.
reviews.content:
We had read about Pho Thin, and decided to give it a go instead of our usual Pho 49 Bat Dan one morning. We were not disappointed.

Pho Thin only serves one kind of pho, so when you get there just find yourself a spot at the table, catch someone's attention and you'll be brought along a bowl of pho shortly. The pho is prepared a little differently from the most traditional pho we've had - here, the slices of flank steak are quickly and lightly sautéed with a generous heaping of spring onions before being dropped into a light and tasty beef broth, which is then topped off with a handful of fresh spring onions and herbs. 

The dish as a whole is a little lighter than your usual meat-rich broth, but it's still full of flavour and has a fresh taste to it. Still a great, comforting breakfast on a cool winter's morning, and very satisfying.

I wouldn't put this down as the best pho in Hanoi (49 Pho Bat Dan takes that), but this is a close second and nice for a change. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Y&SFOOD!
reviews.title: Perfect Pho Bo
reviews.content:
This place was chosen for our Hanoi Food Tour special video for our blog yandsfood

We have eaten different Pho Bo around Vietnam, but this was simply exceptional.

Clear broth made with huge beef bones, amazing fresh rice noodles, tiny beef pieces perfectly cooked to keep tenderness and juiciness.

Probably the best Pho Bo ever tried, hands down!

You must taste this one if you visit Hanoi, cause only here you will find this type of Pho Bo.

reviews.author: MRFOODIE84
reviews.title: The legend of PHO in Hanoi
reviews.content: Have been here for many times & I will keep coming back to this place! This is one of the most famous quality of pho in Hanoi! Their service style is remind me about the time vietnamese people used to lived with coupon period! The taste of this pho will be not similar like the other pho which you used to have, stronger flavours! This is one of top PHO destination you must to come when you visit Hanoi

reviews.author: bird415
reviews.title: Real local Pho
reviews.content:
This is the best Pho in the area, see the endless customers queue even though they have 3 shops already.
You need to place your order in the shop which have several giant stoves, and find a seat inside or another shop next to it.
The soup tast a bit light but sweet, they'd put a lots of meat in, maybe more than the pho.

reviews.author: pagesixtyone
reviews.title: Rich Pho for a Low Price
reviews.content: This was the first pho place we tried. It's a very basic place down the street from the Hilton Garden Inn, where we stayed. We liked the pho so much that we were tempted to keep going back. Order and pay at the front; a bowl of pho is 50,000 VND. The broth was rich (saw a big bag of bones in front of the shop) and the pho was delicious and satisfying on a cool January day. It is high on our list of places to go to on our next visit.

reviews.author: daikin
reviews.title: Really good Pho
reviews.content: They have only one pho and its Pho Bo and it cost 50k.  Perhaps one of the most popular pho in the city it was extremely crowded the food was also good they really load you up on the green onion though

reviews.author: shengwenchua
reviews.title: Great Pho! :)
reviews.content:
Amazing beef pho, deep broth topped with loads of  fresh veggies (spring onions & their usual local produce)! Buy their dough fritters that you can soak into the soup, makes the meal so much more delicious!

Had to use google maps to find the location, very local place which is what makes it great! Paid 50,000VND for a bowl of noodles. Must try if you are in the area! :)

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: I honestly cannot say how great this place is. The pho is delicious. The actual place does not look great, in fact we were skeptical about even going in but after reading so many good reviews we braved it and there were absolutely no regrets. I could eat this pho 3 times a day for weeks, its fantastic. Do yourself a favour and give it a try if you're in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Omar I
reviews.title: Simple and basic location with yummy beef pho!
reviews.content:
This place is listed in guide books as a great place for beef pho. I searched it out on that basis to feed my newfound beef pho addiction! 

The restaurant is very simple, shared tables, plastic stools (as is typical in the loca places here). You walk past the open air kitchen into the restaurant and tale a seat. Ordering is easy, how many beef pho you want and whether you want a plate of fried dough to dunk in it! 

There are fresh limes, chilli sauces etc so you can spice it up to taste. The pho ia great and very cheap if you are coming from the west.... a couple of dollars or a pound etc...

Worth looking this place up.

Regards
Omar

reviews.author: Marty J
reviews.title: Perfect Pho
reviews.content: This tiny kitchen serves a wonderful Pho for  only 50,000 VND.  Fresh and hot with a delicious broth.  If you can't get a seat inside, go to either of the flanking coffee shops.  Order a coffee and Pho.  The Pho will come from Pho Thin through a working together arrangement.  We saw bowls flying out the door.

reviews.author: misterzhoux
reviews.title: Great northern style Pho
reviews.content: No frills, great yummy pho.  Different from your usual as there are herbs covering the entire soup, delicious nonetheless.  Get the accompanying fried dough.

reviews.author: foodandwine28
reviews.title: More of an experience
reviews.content: With all the reviews I expected the most amazing Pho.  First they serve only one kind of Pho, beef Pho.  It is basically a hole in the wall type place where diners sit together on communal picnic type tables.  The food comes quickly .  You sit down at available seat and the pho arrives.  There are chopsticks on the table along with cut limes and sauces.  The pho was warm and the broth tasty : the meat was a little tough.  Not a pho expert ,   Seemed average to me.  When you finish, you pay the guy 50,000 dong at the entry.  Anyway more interesting was the conversations that can happen with the people sitting next to you.  A very local place to eat.

reviews.author: AntietamCreeker
reviews.title: Wonderful Pho
reviews.content: Very tasty bowl of pho bo and a bargain at $50k VND. I will go back before leaving Hanoi in a few weeks.

reviews.author: Motomitsu S
reviews.title: good place to have a meal for full of energy day
reviews.content:
Vietnamese food always make me feel so curious about, especially Banh My or Pho. This restaurant is quite old with a lots of guest, but somehow this place is quite small compare to the amount of people whom eating in there. 
Pho quite good, with the main noodle tasty. But they have a lots of oils, like the soup have full of oils. But in the ends, i come up with a solution which is reduce the taste of oil is lime.

reviews.author: Max P
reviews.title: Pho With Yau Char Kuai
reviews.content:
Another famous Pho shop in Hanoi. The soup is a little more on the oily side however milder on the herbal and meaty taste. Very good crunchy "Yau Char Kuai" basically deep fried pastry which goes really well with the soap.

Open throughout the day in a proper restaurant/shop. 50k each bowl.

Run by a husband and wife - cleaner, better seating compared to Bat Dan. Only reason 4 star is because i prefer Bat Dan.

reviews.author: Kate K
reviews.title: First Pho in Vietnam
reviews.content:
It was my first pho in Hanoi.
I often go to Vietnamese restaurants in Korea.
But, this is totally different!
Broth is really amazing!
And it costs just VND 50K!
(This was the cheapest pho during my trip)
Ah! there is "Obama Bun cha-I forgot the name-" nearby.
It's like killing two birds with one stone ;)

reviews.author: André R
reviews.title: Typical pho
reviews.content:
This is a typical spot to eat your pho! Eat like the locals in the small blues benches, spice it up and have a beer along with it just by 60 baht!

Good soup and nice portions. You won't be disappointed, but don't expect something terrific if you aren't a spicy fan (without spicy it will taste a bit bland)

reviews.author: ManInABlueHat
reviews.title: Good basic Pho restaurant
reviews.content: Pho Thin serves only one dish, Pho Bo Hanoi style.  They do it well.  Just drop in sit down and the pho appears within minutes.  At 50,000 VND no complaints whatsoever.

reviews.author: alreadypacked001
reviews.title: Awesome Northern Style Pho
reviews.content: Came to this place based largely on recommendation of TA and it was spot on.  Place is a one trick pony with one item in menu but they do it well. Broth was flavorful but light.  The surprising thing Was how the vegetables makes the noodle and beef all come together.  We really enjoyed the food.  This place received its deserved confirmation 3 days later when I was brought here by the CEO of a medical implant distributorship company in Vietnam for what he considered as the best Pho in town.  Of course the meeting went well since we agreed already on the food choices.  Funny how little things in life like a dish costing less than $2.50 USD helped paved the way of business meeting.

reviews.author: ChubbyHubby
reviews.title: It's pho, Jim, but not as we know it
reviews.content: tucked away on the fringe of the french quarter, we were looking forward to breakfast here as our hotel was only a few minutes walk away. It was full of locals and service was friendly and quick. The bowl of pho came full of delicious vegetables and herbs (much to to dismay of our daughter!). It was topped with fried beef rather than the usual rare beef or cooked beef which was different but delicious.

reviews.author: Meredith S
reviews.title: Best pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: We had awesome beef pho at Pho Thin, where the restaurant is mostly locals.  You can buy hot sauce to take home as well.

reviews.author: K l
reviews.title: Excellent one-dish restaurant
reviews.content: Very good beef noodle soup. The is no sign outside. It is at the exact location as marked on Google maps. Be sure not to go to the one with the same name at the intersection.

reviews.author: willzhong
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.content: Hoping to find some glorious pho I was really disappointed at the experience. True, the place itself was filled with locals, however the food itself was disappointing: the noodles were silky and the spring onion was fresh, but the broth was unrefined, oily and the meat was of horrible quality. To make matters worse the price of 50,000 VND per bowl kind of made it seem like a premium that tourists had to pay in order to fulfil their romanticised "authentic" pho experience.

reviews.author: 89MET89
reviews.title: Best pho in Vietnam
reviews.content:
We traveled Vietnam South to North and this was the best Pho Bo we had in the whole trip.
A must eat. 50k dong per dish which is a bit more expensive than usual but totally worth it!

reviews.author: imsrlutz
reviews.title: Best Pho in Vietnam!
reviews.content: I just returned from my 12 day tour of Vietnam and Thailand, via Gala Tourists (Highly recommend this tour group based in Hanoi) I was assigned "Giap" as my local guide in Hanoi - I asked him to take me to HIS favorite restaurant in Hanoi, and this was it. When we arrived, there was literally a 40 person line out of the door into the street - with patience, we made our way in, and for a very nominal $$, I sat amongst what appeared to be 99.9% locals at long tables as they just kept bringing bowl after bowl of the most heavenly Pho I've ever had.  A must if you're in Hanoi! I hope you enjoy as much as I did!

reviews.author: Cameron F
reviews.title: PhoTastic!
reviews.content: This was hands down the best Pho my partner and I had in Vietnam, 50.000 for a bowl of amazing Pho sitting down at shared tables with a heap of locals was definitely worth it. A little bit of a walk from the old quarter but you'll not regret making the effort to find this place and enjoy Hanoi's best!

reviews.author: Kou X
reviews.title: Amazing pho
reviews.content: This was by far one of the best places to have pho in Hanoi. The broth was rich and the size was perfect. Must go if pho is on your mind for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

reviews.author: Lin
reviews.title: Absolutely Phò-bulous!
reviews.content: A taste of Vietnam is in Phò and this is simply the best I've had! We went on a cold winter's night in which the warm broth - fragrant, rich and hearty; coupled with the fresh noodles, a generous portion of spring onion greens and beef, was true satisfaction. One huge bowl for 50,000 VND (~2.5 USD) and served within 5 minutes of taking a seat on the mini benches. Gold stars all around!

reviews.author: WorldTravellerMoscow
reviews.title: Pho Thin is the real thing!
reviews.content: PHO THIN - This kitchen is well-known across Hanoi as being one of the best places for large healthy serves of pho. We had the beef pho and it came strewn with lots of meat, generous greens (such as spring onions), a DELICIOUS broth which develops in the bowl, thankfully no sign of msg. The cost was 50,000 VND per bowl (under $3.00USD). They even sell their signature hot sauce for 20,000 VND a bottle. You can watch them make it. Huge bones are boiled into the finest stock. This is a must-do activity in Hanoi, the pho capital of Vietnam!!! It's good safe eating. Pho Thin wins on simplicity alone. Less busy after the lunch rush.

reviews.author: Indrayani
reviews.title: Best Pho!!!
reviews.content: The soup is very fragrant and tasty. Price is very reasonable. A must try in Ha Noi! We hope to be back!

reviews.author: Bornean
reviews.title: A big bowl of pho, authentically Hanoi
reviews.content:
Pay VND50,000 for your pho, 20,000 more than elsewhere, and you won't regret it. The soup is delicious, the generous serving of beef tasty, and the pho smooth.

You may even be thanked for bringing your business partner here.

reviews.author: Fina F
reviews.title: Big bowl pho
reviews.content: We Came slightly after lunch time so still can feel the crowd. Here you pay first before you eat. Many locals eat here they served a big bowl of pho with plenty of cooked beef in a clear soup. Eat it with the free ca-kwe (fried dough) yummy. If you dont want to queue you may want to come earlier or after lunch time and you would likely sit with other people or in different table with your group

reviews.author: VSeah
reviews.title: Simple yet delicious
reviews.content:
it's a little far out from the city area and we reach there by taking a cab from the old quarter. It was worth the trip.

The soup noodles was cooked nicely and it goes really well with the fried fritters! All of those with a really low price! We were super full after that meal!

reviews.author: lse2g10
reviews.title: Fantastic Pho!
reviews.content: This was our first meal in Hanoi and it was fanstastic. We arrived, sat down and ordered 'two'. They only seem to serve one dish here - beef Pho but they do it extremely well. Very tasty, filling and cheap! We paid afterwards but in hindsight I'd say pay beforehand. Very casual but excellent food.

reviews.author: Kieu Trang L
reviews.title: Always my favorite since childhood
reviews.content:
My house is so near to this shop before so my whole childhood was eating Pho in this shop. It tasted extremely rich in taste with the smell of sauteed beef with garlic. Only one thing is that the price went up as well as the amount of meet being decreased make me a little bit sad. 
But still!! A must-try for anyone goes to Hanoi from a local like me. Typing about this makes me feel so hungry and crave for one hot bowl of it now lol

reviews.author: Shig1970
reviews.title: Best Pho Bo in Hanoi
reviews.content: Definitely this is one of the best Pho bo in Hanoi. The broth is tasty and as some locals call them 'beef bowl' the pho is topped with beef, beef and beef.

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Tasty and original Pho
reviews.content: Staying in Hilton Garden Inn, I was brought to this restaurant by a local. The place is nothing to look at but it is packed with people especially during meal times. Best time to go there is in between and you will be more likely to find a seat. They only sell one type and that is beef Pho. It is different and soup taste really good. I will be here for the next few days and will certainly be going many more times before I leave

reviews.author: mwoods0
reviews.title: Best Pho We Ate
reviews.content: Pho Thin is a simple restaurant - they only serve one dish but they do it better than any other place.  Also a great price at 50.000 VND for a bowl.  You walk in past the kitchen and sit at a long community style table.  They bring you a bowl of Pho very quickly after you sit down.  There are jars of fish sauce and hot sauce on the table along with bowls of chopped lime and chiles.  The hot sauce is made there and you can buy a bottle for 20.000 VND.  It seems to be a local favorite as well - we didn't see any tourists in the restaurant both times we visited but it was always packed with people slurping noodles and walking away satisfied.

reviews.author: Justin S
reviews.title: First night in Hanoi! Yum!!
reviews.content: Delicious bowl of noodle soup with meat. Had no idea what we were doing but ended up with a great meal!! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Anthony L
reviews.title: Love this pho place
reviews.content: This was recommended by the hotel reception where I am staying as I am trying to find a good authentic pho place. This is very near my hotel which is Hilton garden inn less than 2-3 minutes walk. They only serve beef pho and quay... quay taste and looks like a bread but the reception in my hotel says it's not ... anyways it's cheap for a huge bowl of pho ... I eat here every night if I am just by myself or eating around the hotel ... 50k vnd for a bowl of beef pho and the quay is 5k ... I think only one guy speaks English and he is really nice ... and the blower fans are nice too even if it's hot does make it comfortable or bearable ... you order and pay first then you sit and they will serve your order

reviews.author: loek_de_beer
reviews.title: Best Pho Bo of Hanoi
reviews.content:
They serve one dish and they serve it well. Best pho bo in Hanoi, also according to my vietnamese colleagues. They prepare it in a village sized pan on a huge fire.

You just go in, sit down, and you're served a bowl. Also order some bread sticks for dipping.

reviews.author: Ross
reviews.title: Authentic
reviews.content: Too good! Very authentic restaurant with only one thing on the menu... Pho! Don't miss out on this lakker chow! Wooden benches and fast friendly service. Also grab some of their special chili  sauce

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: Must eat!
reviews.content:
And so one hot afternoon while we were searching for the best pho in Hanoi, this place popped up in our search results. Off we went to look for the shop vie an Uber. 

True to many who have attested, the pho here is hearty and delicious with beef streaks and veges full to the brim. It took my husband and I less than five minutes to clean the bowl. If having this pho in hot weather is delicious, imagine having it during winter!

Interior of the shop comes bare with metal tables and tiny wooden stools, as expected and can be seen in all of Hanoi. Condiments and utensils are placed at corners of the table and are within easy reach. Can be a bit stuffy once you walk inside during the day, but hey, a little sacrifice is nothing if you're having the best pho ever!

reviews.author: The_Chos
reviews.title: One of our top two pho experiences - different...
reviews.content: We asked our tour guide for the day where his favorite pho is, and he brought us to Pho Thin.  It has been in business for over 4 family generations and they only serve one thing... so it must be good!  When our order arrived, the first thing I noticed were the greens on top - they were plentiful.  The first sip of broth was surprising.  It's not like the pho we're used to in Westminster, California.  The broth had the heartiness of an oxtail soup.  The staff was so friendly.  Open air restaurant, so expect to be warm.  But it's worth it!

reviews.author: DayTrip655950
reviews.title: Back up Pho
reviews.content: It's not bad but not the type of pho I'm used to. But that said its still cheap, clean, filling and not bad if you feel like pho. Btw around this area there's also Bun Cha Huong Lien and there's also Bun Ca(Fried fish soup). Both on Le Van Huu.

reviews.author: Stefanie_Aseervatham
reviews.title: You MUST go
reviews.content: The best food I've probably ever eaten, if you like pho there is no other place to go in Hanoi! Don't expect fine dining, but expect authentic, simple but absolutely delicious pho. Hanoi is not my favourite part of Vietnam but I would go back there just for this.

reviews.author: Matt_and_Ash
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content:
Their Pho Bo is simply delicious and a nice contrast to other Pho (northern and southern) we've tried. 
The broth was subtle and the meat plentiful. I particularly enjoyed their chilli sauce, which was hot and fiery. So add gradually.  
We found this little gem at the recommendation of our hotel and would certainly go back if we're ever in Hanoi again. 
At 50,000 VND you can't really go wrong.

reviews.author: SI3104141
reviews.title: Simple but great pho
reviews.content: No need to write a lot about this famous pho. Definitely listed as one of the lunch places that I'll regularly come back with close friends and colleagues.

reviews.author: usfscuba
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.content:
We are at the end of a 3 week trip through Asia during which we ate a lot of Pho (love it). This place was recommended to us and it was by far the best Pho I hv ever eaten. 

The place is bare and simple to the bones, filled with locals, eat and go. 

Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: ThuTrang92
reviews.title: The best Pho Bo in town!!!
reviews.content: I have tried Pho Bo in many places in Hanoi, but Pho Bo here always is the best. The fresh noodle with delicious soup creates the very good dish!

reviews.author: DonatoMelchiorre
reviews.title: Very tasty Pho Bio
reviews.content:
Typically Vietnamese street restaurant where mostly locals eat. We were the only westerners there when we went.

Food wise there was not much choice and we were brought three pho bos immediately which we all found very tasty. These beef noodle soups are served with fresh limes, chilli sauce and pickled chillis on the side.

You sit on benches and at large metal tables. Overall, it is a tasty soup and the place is what you expect.

reviews.author: arjun_stc
reviews.title: Good beef noodles
reviews.content:
We visited this place on recommendation of the staff at the hotel we stayed at.

The pho bo is different from others we have had in Hanoi. The broth is thicker and oilier, and there was more garlic. Overall it tasted more like a good Chinese style beef noodle soup than the clear broth we associate with pho, and I enjoyed it very much as such.

We ate here right after eating at Bun Cha Obama, which is just a block away, so you may want to bundle the two together too.

reviews.author: tomandanna2016
reviews.title: Wonderful authentic experience
reviews.content: The only restaurant which we visited where we were the only non-Vietnamese diners. We asked for a table for two at the entrance and the owner pointed to a space on the long trestle tables. Ther is no menu, and no drinks, and a couple of minutes later he placed down two bowls of the most amazing pho we had on our trip to Vietnam. It is a quick eats place - with no drinks and a busy atmosphere, we only stayed for about 30mins to eat our food. A fantastic experience though. Pho cost £2 each!

reviews.author: TIGAsia
reviews.title: Real Pho
reviews.content:
My usual favorite Pho place on Bhat Dan has been closed for renovations so I tried Pho Thin based upon some random research. I like the real thing, not candy coated tourist places and Pho Thin fits the bill.
A real hole in the wall frequented primarily by locals you can almost miss if you are walking down the street. The fire heated caldrons of broth are in the front window as are all the pho ingredients. Small bench style tables and a long counter against the wall fill this basic narrow room. 
The pho is straight forward and extremely hearty and tasty. The large bowls are filled with noodles, greens and a good amount of beef. The fixings include home made hot sauce, fish sauce, vinegar and it all awesome. The taste is great and a $2.00 bowl is an amazing breakfast (lunch or dinner). Also get an order (or 2) of the fried dough sticks. A must to soak in the soup. While minimal English is spoken, there is only one thing on the menu so no worries. I will be back!

reviews.author: limyinghao90
reviews.title: Great Pho! Especially for vegetable-lovers!
reviews.content:
The location of Pho Thin is pretty easy to spot, and most taxi drivers would be able to navigate there with ease, as its a very popular place.

My friends and I visited Pho Thin after coming back from Sapa on the overnight train around 6am in the morning. Having read reviews of the popularity of Pho thin, we are glad we chose to visit so early in the morning, as there was minimal crowd and the place was much cooler.

Overall, the Pho was great! It was one of the better Phos we have had throughout our stay in Vietnam! The kueh was great too (the fried dough thing that we dip into our soup), really soak up the flavour of the broth. We would definitely visit again when we are back.

The place is indeed hot and stuffy, as the kitchen is at the front of the restaurant, so do be prepared to combat this. Also, we need to make the orders and payment before entering the restaurant, so just get ready too. 

Hope this is useful!

reviews.author: ewtravelblog
reviews.title: Best pho in hanoi
reviews.content: This is no doubt the best pho you can find in hanoi. Generous portion of pho, beef & spring onion. Dont miss it. Opens from 5 am til 10 or 11 pm. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Kath O
reviews.title: Mmmm delicious
reviews.content: Simple set-up, fresh, delicious. They are friendly, the place is popular and costs £2 for delicious pho. There are several dessert places along the same street.

reviews.author: Alessandra13875
reviews.title: street pho!
reviews.content: if you like the vietnamese soup (pho) you have to try this one: don't expect nice lovely or luxury restaurant, this is really street vietnamese food, but one of the best pho we tasted. you just have to enter and take a sit in the wood bench. nobody speak English but it's not a problem because they serve just pho, so five minute and you'll have your soup in front and...bon appetit!

reviews.author: Pablo
reviews.title: Great authentic Pho
reviews.content:
This little restaurant was just round the corner from my partners family and has been serving pho for many many years.
We went for breakfast and I must admit it was absolutely delicious.

reviews.author: SharonLeeMarshman
reviews.title: First experience of authentic Pho!
reviews.content: Pho Thin was recommended to us as an authentic place to have the traditional dish 'Pho'. Our first authentic  'pho experience' was a good one. We enjoyed the communal dining and the busy buzz of the locals but most of all the flavors of the big bowl of pho were very good. The dining experience isnt a long one as the diners come and go within 40 minutes max. We would certainly recommend a visit to Pho Thin!

reviews.author: szkut
reviews.title: Cheap and tasty
reviews.content:
Quite good pho. Was it the best in Vietnam??? Well maybe not but it was good and was good value. 

The fried bread on the other hand was quite plastic like and almost inedible.

reviews.author: StephCaliforniaBound
reviews.title: Good pho but not the best.
reviews.content: This place maintains a more local feel than the famous Pho 10 with an open cooking station and head pho maker greeting you right by the entrance over large pots of steaming soup. The broth is solid, the ambiance just right, and the price is favorable. The beef is boiled and thus a bit tougher; so for me wasn't my favorite beef noodle joint in Hanoi but overall worth a stopover and a bowl. Top with the juice of a few lime halves and you're set. Better to try several pho places and ascertain which one you like best!

reviews.author: jetfueljunkie69
reviews.title: Phobulous!
reviews.content: A favourite with locals and international diners, this little restaurant serves the best Pho in Hanoi. There may be a queue to get a seat on the communal tables in the mornings, but the wait is not usually long. Best to visit during mid-afternoon where there is less of a crowd. Order the Pho as you enter and pay upfront, don't forget to also order the fried dough sticks to dip into the flavoursome soup. It's so good that we visited twice during our stay in Hanoi.

reviews.author: retroZ_9
reviews.title: A simple lunch
reviews.content: A simple lunch. Eat where the locals go have lunch. The place is teaming with customers and the huge vats of soup at the front of the shop is a good sign that the restaurant is well visited

reviews.author: April Choi
reviews.title: Delicious but too beef taste
reviews.content: It was delicious and I like green onion on the top, but the soup was too beef taste, I prefer light taste like pho10 in Ly Quoc Su street, but that's depends on your preferences, and a bit far from center

reviews.author: KawehiCorrea
reviews.title: Great Pho
reviews.content:
When I spoke to a local on the streets they told me that there is no "one" best place for pho. You must try all and determine that for yourself. 

I gave this place an excellent review because it wasn't trying to conform to anyone. It was either eat here or don't. I ate there and the pho was excellent. I have no clue if it was the best- but worth the try.

reviews.author: Jemma D
reviews.title: Photastic!
reviews.content: Not only was the pho great but it was a fun cultural experience eating late at night with the locals. It's a cheap delicious meal that everyone should try when they come to Vietnam. I've had lots of pho on my trips to Vietnam and this is definitely up there!

reviews.author: doctorse7en
reviews.title: Good value pho
reviews.content: This is supposed to be the best pho in Hanoi and it doesn't disappoint. The beef is juicy and tender, the noodles are not too soft but the broth is brilliant. I didn't find a hint of taste of MSG. The portion size is good. The only minor point is service. Don't expect great service, considering the pho is only VND 50000

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: I'm not even a Pho fanboy, and I thought this place was good
reviews.content: Normally I don't go for Pho all that much - it's fine, but it wouldn't normally be my go-to on a hot day with extreme humidity. That said, this place had all the cred in Hanoi, and I had to make a pilgrimage. It's very much from the old school - they bring you in, sit you down at a bench with the napkin dispensers and hot sauces and peppers, and give you a bowl of the good stuff. The meat is tender, the broth savory, and the greens fresh. Pair it all with a good Hanoi beer and you are good to go. This place is a must visit when you are in the city, and I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: libuska16
