reviews.title: The best Pho is here
reviews.content: They just serve only 1 kind of Pho and you need to pay before being served, small place but it worths the price. Full of beef and the soup is delicious. I'm Vietnamese, have lived in VietNam and have eaten Pho all of my life but here is the best I've ever had. They still keep the traditional taste of vietnamese Pho while more and more tourist come here,which make me really happy. If you are looking for a nice restaurant where waiter serve you well, don't go here because this place is only for nostalgic people who love Pho and don't ask for high standard service here.

reviews.author: Kevin L
reviews.title: Really great Pho
reviews.content:
This place is further away from the main part of the old quarter, and not really convenient to go to, but it was worth the trip to me. You don't have to order; you just walk in and tell the person at the entrance how many bowls you would like, then go and find a seat. Do note that this is not a restaurant, and like any typical hanoi food establishment, it is not very clean. There are pieces of tissue on the floor, with some food scraps. However, you get what you pay for, so paying only 50000VND for the bowl of pho, I didn't expect much of the cleanliness and ambience.

The pho was really great. The beef pieces are not the usual slices of beef, but more of small pieces so it is much easier to have a piece of beef with every bite. The soup was tasty as well, and the different vegetables added different kinds of texture. All in all, worth a second visit in the future!

reviews.author: traveller1968
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.content: I'm no pho expert but it was really delicious. I loved that there were huge quantities of condiments on the table so you could season away to your heart's content. It was a sweltering experience between the lack of AC and the steaming hot soup, but worth it.

reviews.author: Eunice M
reviews.title: Not like expected
reviews.content:
The Phố thin is not like expected, 
The taste of the Phố is different from the normal one 

And we found that quite many Japanese business man eat there, I think there is near a business center

reviews.author: EazyDPitfield
reviews.title: Phonomenal
reviews.content:
Lived in Hanoi for 2 years and now in Hoi An but always visit this place when in Hanoi, famous amongst locals the for good reason, it's ace! 

Order tai chin and get 2 get kinds of beef and order quay which are great when dunked in the broth.

reviews.author: trvlnsandy
reviews.title: one dish done very well
reviews.content: We were a bit unsure about going here, but it's a very busy place, so  high turnover, which gave us courage.  Very local.  When you enter, you tell them how many (I held up two fingers - one for me and one for my husband) and where you want the 'donuts' - point, and pay.  They'll tell you how much.  You find a seat, and your Pho comes soon after.  Dip the fried bread in the broth.  Season your broth with lime, chili, fish sauce and whatever else you want.  Yum.  Slurp.

reviews.author: Ahidyn
reviews.title: Pho with the locals
reviews.content: We went to this fast food vietnamese restaurant because it was close to our hotel. They only have one ithem on their menu : Beef Pho. It tasted pretty good, with a good amount of beef and green onions. It was a good experience because you get to be close to the locals. If you are looking for a fancy place to eat, thi is not the one. I think is worth to give it a try. Recomended

reviews.author: Guiyang26
reviews.title: Tasty!
reviews.content: Super tasty where the beef is stir fried rather than normal pho where beef would either be served raw or lightly drained in hot water.  Very busy eatery with many locals.

reviews.author: Laura Z
reviews.title: Best pho every
reviews.content: Best pho we have ever had! Very small store front though so it's a bit tricky to see.  Beef was stir fried with loads of green onions.  Super tasty!

reviews.author: ikitaitokoro
reviews.title: Wasn't blown away.
reviews.content: We walked for 30 minutes to find this place expecting an amazing experience. I was disappointed because we could have eaten the same quality nearer our hotel. Save your time and only go here if you're close by

reviews.author: Aram K
reviews.title: Excellent Pho!
reviews.content: 50,000 VND per bowl, Pho Thin is worth the visit.  Pay as you enter, sit down, and have a wonderful bowl of pho delivered in minutes.  Both tourists and locals were present while we were there.

reviews.author: Chris T H
reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.content: A well- known brand name in Hanoi. I decided to go there because of its reputation. The noodle was good, a little bit expensive than other stores but the quality is higher. However, the store was quite crowded and the manager was shouting at one staff's face when I was coming in. So I didn't feel very comfortable at all.

reviews.author: LovinLifesJourneys
reviews.title: Eating like a Local Delicious Pho!
reviews.content: This is a very local joint making pho right in front of you as you enter. It was delicious!  No its not fancy. Its wood benches and stainless steel tabletops.  Fast service and super reasonable price.  For sure a interesting experience for soothing pho.

reviews.author: tochimami
reviews.title: Awesome broth
reviews.content: Said to be no.2 pho in Hanoi and it's not an overstatement, the broth is been simmered for a long time that the sweetness of the ox bones and brisket all came out into the broth. Beef in this shop is not in slices but chopped briskets and tendons which gives more texture. Remember to order the fried dough to soak into the broth. Add fish sauce, lime and chili, then when you are halfway through, add the chili sauce to get a different sensation in just one bowl of pho.

reviews.author: Gracie O
reviews.title: Far from the town , Good pho
reviews.content: Quite a  good pho, but overpriced compared to other vietnamsese restaurants which are also famous for the pho soup VND 50,000 per bowl ,taste good with basic set up

reviews.author: VR747
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: Our hotel map has Pho Thin listed as the place for the best pho in Hanoi but we didn't agree and had better elsewhere. Good experience eating with locals though.

reviews.author: RichH75
reviews.title: Good food with basic setup
reviews.content: If you're not a fan of eating down an alley way in what appears to be less than clean surroundings (by London standards however some of them are questionable) then don't go. The food however is great and gave us no stomach problems. Essentially you sit down where there is space on the bench and a short while later you'll be bought a bowl of steaming beef noodle soup (pho bo). Add extras from the table (lime, chilli etc) and then pay 50,000 VND per person when you leave.

reviews.author: hanh v
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.content: I am not a big fan of pho. My boss liked to have it and we did. The propotion was big (compare to a bow of pho in the South). It is okay to eat.

reviews.author: TheAusTravellers
reviews.title: Best pho!
reviews.content: Located in the French Quarter, the entrance is unassuming and this no-frills restaurant is filled with locals. Not your typical pho as the beef is sautéed during the preparation. While saying this, it was the best pho we had on our Vietnam trip!

reviews.author: Cedric L
reviews.title: Best Pho in town!
reviews.content: This place is full of locals, and they serve only 1 thing. Pho. Best I had in Hanoi. You have to go there if you are in town and need a quick, unexpensive, high quality lunch. Totally worth it.

reviews.author: Tram N
reviews.title: Tasty PHO in HaNoi
reviews.content: I dont have any idea if my friends ask me to go there. The soup is tasty with tender beef. Nothing special but nothing to complain. Maybe if it is convenient for my way, I will go there. But if I have many time, I will go to another place, such as: Bat Dan

reviews.author: nosniv
reviews.title: Standout Pho
reviews.content: The broth here is unreal and the best Pho we had during our 3 weeks in vietnam.  It is a bit different from others, the meat is cut a bit thicker and they sautee with garlic prior to adding it to the soup, so it is not your traditional bowl.  However, it was savory and delicious.  It is a short taxi ride from the old quarter but definitely worth seeking out if you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: sunshower
reviews.title: Best pho we had in all of Vietnam
reviews.content: Surrounded by locals in this tiny sidewalk joint, you really get a feel for the place. Homey, welcoming, no frills. Just damn good soup. A bowl of pho is just as cheap here as everywhere else but has a deeper flavor, the broth is less clear from the meat being roasted first, and the whole bowl is packed with green onions. Really a treat and worth hunting down.

reviews.author: Will_Diggles
reviews.title: Delicious PHO in HaNoi
reviews.content: Stopped in at this place for breakfast after reading some of the reviews and so happy that we did. Didn't have to wait for too long for our spots. The Pho bowls were full of flavour and the price was cheap. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: yuhsin81
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content:
As soon as you order, in few minute the Pho will show on the table very quickly. And there is a lot of green onion which is one of my favorite.
After you taste the first one bite, then you can put some lemon juice, chili paper, that's so match!!! Let's give it a try them you will love it.

reviews.author: -HK-Davey-
reviews.title: Local and Authentic Hanoi Pho
reviews.content: Pho is reasonably tasty, and slightly different than pho that you may have tried in the South of Vietnam. Beware this place is not clean, but adds to some of the charm. Also the restaurant doesn't smell good - probably because the beef broth has soaked into the walls. While we were there it was mostly locals eating.

reviews.author: Merlin081
reviews.title: The Real Deal! Authentic Pho
reviews.content: Great to eat with the local people. Cheap and tasty pho just up the street from our hotel.People happily made room for us on the benches and passed along the limes and sauces. Thoroughly  recommend.

reviews.author: katherine2409
reviews.title: Tasty Pho, glad we found it
reviews.content: Hidden behind the many scooters on the foot path is this great little place to eat. Very busy and you must be pushy to get your order in. Have been back a few times since arriving in Hanoi. Get used to dirty tissues all over the floor and general untidiness of the place but the staff are run off their feet getting the pho out to everyone!!!

reviews.author: Malin W
reviews.title: Best pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best Pho I've had in Vietnam. Tip: bring your own water or drink. Really authentic surroundings. If you want real Vietnamese food, visit!

reviews.author: CHandGT
reviews.title: Cheap, local and great noodles
reviews.content: Excellent noodles very local experience, it is open to the side of the street and quite dirty, the owners don't speak English and you only have one type of beef noodles. However you get a big bowl which is very filling and the noodles are delicious. Go here for a quick rough and ready local experience for EXCELLENT PHO.

reviews.author: Stu B
reviews.title: Truly outstanding pho
reviews.content: This is easily the best pho we ate in Hanoi, and we ate lots of it... Located to the south of the French Quarter, recognisable from the two huge pots outside. The flavour is spectacular. 50k dong gets a large bowl of delicious broth, with good quality beef, fresh coriander, noodles, crunchy spring onion and garlicky undertones from the frying of the beef. Add lime, chilli sauce and the searingly hot chillies for an outstanding bowl of food. As I have said elsewhere, if you only eat two things in Hanoi, make it this and banh mi at Banh Mi 25. I may have to book another trip to Hanoi, as I'm sad I may never get to eat this again... Highly, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Tran D
reviews.title: Great Pho
reviews.content: On the corner, and actually not on Lo Duc street, but just nearby around the corner. Very delicious.

reviews.author: MLTnature
reviews.title: Simply the best "Pho Bo" in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Our friends took us here in a cold night of November for the first time.

It's kind of interesting when you must pay at the entrance first then sit down and wait for  your"pho." (About 2.5 USD- $50k VND per bowl)

Even though the whole setting isn't very clean or fancy, the quality of "pho" totally made up for that.  Bon Appetit!

reviews.author: baldeagle46
reviews.title: YUMMY
reviews.content:
Tiny restaurant with WONDERFUL Pho. No choice of Pho but no worries since the fried beef is so DELICIOUS!
Tables with benches are all shared and very hard to find a seat during peak times.
Will probably go back once more before leaving Hanoi.

reviews.author: leecy2016
reviews.title: Must try noodles in Hanoi
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I stayed in Hanoi during Tet festival for 1 week. We had lunch there for 3 times. The beef noodles were tasty. Many local people had meal there as well. This is one of the places you have to go if you stay on Hanoi.

reviews.author: Hồng Anh N
reviews.title: You may like it at the first try
reviews.content: This restaurant is very small and crowed. You need a tour guide or a Vietnamese friend to take you to this place. They serve only 2 things: pho and quay. Quay is yellow sweet cake made by flour and it is crunchy. You should try it with pho, it is very good. Different from normal pho restaurants in Hanoi, at pho Thin restaurant, they sell pho with fried beef, not boiled one so the taste is very special. This restaurant is very popular and crowed so you should go in the early morning.

reviews.author: Jake R
reviews.title: Fast tasty pho in the French quarter
reviews.content: Straight forward pho served up snappily in a busy vibrant local restuarant. Hint of garlic as the beef is fried with some. Vegetables, noodles, beef and stock is all in there all that is left for you to do is add the chilli and line at your discretion and cosy up with whoever is sharing your bench and table whilst you scoop it up with your chop sticks and spoon

reviews.author: 965_ngp
reviews.title: Very good pho
reviews.content: My friend said that it's the best pho in Ha noi so I came here and I didn't regret. The broth is very flavorful. A must try in Ha noi, especially in the winter time

reviews.author: Mary K
reviews.title: The Best Pho of our Vietnamese trip
reviews.content: Our tour guide told us this tiny restaurant had the best pho bo in Hanoi and I agree!  It's a funny little place where they sell 2 things - bowls of pho for 50,000 VND and a cruller-type bread. We didn't know about the bread so we didn't ask for it. You pay your 50,000 dong and then look for a seat at one of the long, family-style tables.  Although you could miss it if you blink, it's very crowded with locals and some tourists.  Rich broth, plentiful beef, noodles and chopped green onions make for a delicious soup.  It's well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Philippe M
reviews.title: Amazing Pho
reviews.content: This doesn’t look like a restaurant, it’s a family cooking in a very small street.  Sit down, and wait. You’ll get one of the best Pho ever for 50.000 Dong.

reviews.author: Issakito
reviews.title: One of most loved by locals
reviews.content: This place is always filled with locals and tourists. Accoring to many local friemds, Pho Thin is one of the best place Pho Bo or beef noodlr in a traditional way. You pay 50,000vnd as you enter and look for seat or wait till someone stand up. As you sit Pho will be thrown onto your table. Broth amd noodle are covered with full of spring onions and a lot of beef. One of Viet friends says this used to be one of the celabration place once or twice a year when he was a boy, the time 50.000vnd was a big deal for and such rich beef was a real treat for most of Hanoi residenys. Now, this pho shop sells 80,000 bowls of pho everyday. It is not sanirary at all, so be ready for bringing your kids.

reviews.author: Lauren B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: My most memorable dining experience in Vietnam. Just sat down next to locals at a long table and out come two delicious bowls of hot pho. Amazing!

reviews.author: Thanyarat D
reviews.title: Superb pho
reviews.content: Don't think twice. Just walk in and order whatever the locals who sit next to you had ordered. You can't really go wrong here.

reviews.author: Keith T
reviews.title: Really Tasty - Unique Experience
reviews.content: I stopped by this small spot about three months ago and was very satisfied. I tried it again today and the food was just as good and, if it's possible, the portion was even larger than before. This is a very small restaurant in a tiny alley. It's hard to really describe it as a restaurant - it's really more like a street stall. Don't let the location or the appearance stop you from eating here. The pho is really good and the atmosphere is, well, unique! I won't hesitate to return.

reviews.author: 0Bossa0
reviews.title: Hits the spot and authentic setting - not for the squeamish
reviews.content: As some reviewers have noted, this is definitely local street food so the feel of it is not, shall we say, in keeping with western standards of sterility. That said studies have shown that the rapid rise in autoimmune disease incidence in the western world is associated with the overly antiseptic environment. Embrace some germs once in a while, people! I personally noticed no flies or other critters to be concerned about. And as for the pho, it was delightful! And the tiny setting very entertaining as motorbikes and regular bikes would zoom through the two foot alleyway.

reviews.author: Nguyen B
reviews.title: Phở Hành Lò Đúc
reviews.content: This is one of the best Phở in Ha Noi. If you visit Ha Noi, go there now. The special about this Phở is that the beef is fried with onions before it's put in your bowl. The chilli sauce is absolutely hot. The place is really small, but it's family traditional one. Highly recommeded for everyone.

reviews.author: wholefood
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.content:
Went because of trip advisor recommendations. It is only one dish that is served. 
Be aware it is pretty dirty. But the Pho was quite good.
While most street pricing is good we just didn't know about the honesty of pricing here because all the signs are in Vietnamese. We ate inside where a sign said 20K, but in leaving we were shown a sign that said 50K each. Happy to pay, but with the language barrier, not sure if we're having the wool pulled over our eyes so to speak.

reviews.author: Fujen
reviews.title: Might not be my type of pho
reviews.content: I like pho and this is local friend recommend. However it is just not my type. Lots of local come here so it might be authentic.

reviews.author: AtlantaResidences
reviews.title: Good Beef Pho
reviews.content: Always a good choice to have a hot fresh beef pho soup with some breadsticks (quay) in the cold morning. The price is affordable and they have inside seating, which is more than you can ask for while eating at places like this in Hanoi. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Neil D
reviews.title: Very tasty pho
reviews.content: Found this laneway after strong recommendations. We were not disappointed by the meal or the pleasant way we were treated by host/cook.   Pho Bo and beer for two people was just 130,000 VND

reviews.author: BUNYIP58
reviews.title: Great Pho
reviews.content: We went here on a recommendation from a Vietnamese man. Like many Pho joints Pho is all they do, so language is not an issue. It was very busy when we went - a local there said the place is famous. I can understand why, the Pho is excellent. It is not that great a stroll from the old quarter, say a gentle 20 minutes.

reviews.author: Diana T
reviews.title: Good PHO Hanoi
reviews.content: IT is great to try PHo Hanoi in the winter. It so interesting. This place had a long time about PHO. Good service.

reviews.author: Thuat Pham
reviews.title: Great PHO
reviews.content: One of the bests PHO restaurants in Hanoi,  A great thing for breakfast and explore the local cuisine of Hanoi. I love PHO

reviews.author: Rose D
reviews.title: Maybe not the best
reviews.content: Maybe not the best but very good Pho. Maybe skip the fried stuff the nice smiling gentleman wants you to buy.

reviews.author: Traveler121708
reviews.title: Awesome joint and the fastest meal ever
reviews.content: Got here with a colleague,  sat down and bowls of Pho appeared 2 seconds later. No menu, no options, nothing asked. Absolutely brilliant! The place was full of young and old, people wearing formals to t-shirts and flip-flops, and a couple of foreigners like us. The soup was tasty, food plenty, and VND 50,000 per person. It's the most memorable of all meals I have had in Vietnam during my two week-long trips there.  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: USCThersa
reviews.title: Best Pho we've had
reviews.content: This is a little out of the old quarters, so you'd have to take a cab to get there.  But totally worth it!!!  I live in LA with lots of access to pho, and this being the 2nd time in vietnam, I've tried my share of different pho restaurants. I can easily say, this is the best I've had so far.  So go, you wont regret it!

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: tiny lane near Hoan Kiem lake
reviews.content:
Introduced by hotel staff to this stall nearby.  keep a lookout for this roadside stall, not a restaurant.  Get seated on a long wooden bench and have your bowl of vnd50k pho.  You may choose to have a plate of fried fritters but it's already a big bowl of noodles to conquer.  tasty.
located on the left side of water puppet theatre at the lake.

reviews.author: Peter391
reviews.title: Basic Hanoi experience, just what we wanted
reviews.content:
We found this tiny cafe from a lonely planet suggestio. Not easy to find.

It's a tiny long and very Hanoi cafe ,local and basic much more fun than the restaurants. Motorbikes run through the cafe and you sit on ti y blue chairs next to the locals.

Lovely Pho. 50000 for a large bowl.

Happy to go to the Pho Tinh rather than a flashy restaurant.

reviews.author: Barry Breasley
reviews.title: REAL VIETNAMESE FOOD
reviews.content: Visited this restaurant on a Tripadvisor review. Very much a place for the local folks but our group of eight seniors enjoyed the pho which seemed to be the one and only dish available. I think everyone enjoyed the experience and we all survived.

reviews.author: Kevin T
reviews.title: Really great when enjoy "PHo" in this restaurant
reviews.content: Really great when enjoy "PHo" in this restaurant. The pho bo here is incredible and the others don't compare at all!

reviews.author: Farrah A
reviews.title: Amazing Pho!!!!!
reviews.content: The Pho here was amazing! Bowl was much bigger then I had expected it to be. All locals there which we thought was a good sign, you tell them how many bowls you want and they bring it to you within a minute or 2, for less then 2 USD a bowl. MUST VISIT!

reviews.author: Land A
reviews.title: The pho bo here is incredibl
reviews.content: Beware the imitators and always check the street number! Accidentally went to a knock off the first time and it was not good. The pho bo here is incredible and the others don't compare at all!

reviews.author: 6Mileshigh
reviews.title: Good Northern style Pho
reviews.content: Massive pots cooking broth out the front, heaps of tasty lean Bo, good chili sauce. No extra herbs or sprouts like in the south but tasty enough nonetheless. Small cosy seating area inside, with a mix of locals and tourists. 50D.

reviews.author: BobVirginiaUSA
reviews.title: Very Local and Very Good
reviews.content: Sit on small plastic stools, pick chop sticks from the communal canister, not see another Westerner in the crowd!  This is an authentic, Vietnamese food experience while eating the best pho in Hanoi (and maybe all of Vietnam).  If you want to eat very local and very good, you must visit Pho Thin.

reviews.author: mickras
reviews.title: Amazing value for money
reviews.content: After 5 years in Vietnam I have had my share of pho, but no doubt that Pho Thin serves one of the best pho's I have ever tried. It's a typical, crowded, quick in and out Vietnamese style place, so don't expect it to be neither clean nor comfortable. They serve only pho bo, portions are rather large and at only 50.000VND/bowl, it's really great value for money.

reviews.author: Candy E
reviews.title: Best Pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best Pho in Hanoi for the winter months. Rich, flavorful, smokey. Busy enough to feel reasonably sure what you're getting is fresh any time of the day. Open all day. A classic stop for a reason.

reviews.author: Lee J
reviews.title: The pho is amazing
reviews.content: The best PHO in Hanoi, for sure. I always eat here when I need something good for lunch. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marti W
reviews.title: Where the locals eat
reviews.content: If you want to eat authentic, and safe Pho, and eat with the locals.... this is the place to go.  Its a tine place with long, low communal tables...and the best Pho we found!  They serve only one thing, beef Pho as well as some delicious breadstix, but you need to ask for them.  You sit down and before you know it a steaming bowl is in front of you with plates of sprouts, mint, cilantro and an assortment of hot sauces.  The cost is only $2.50 USD....a real deal.

reviews.author: starfire888
reviews.title: Great Pho Bo
reviews.content: We went here as it is only 300m from our hotel.  They don't speak English but it is not an issue as they only serve one food, Pho Bo (Beef Rice Noodle).  Two fingers get us 2 big bowls of noodles and five fingers from the vendors for USD$5.  The pho is very tasty.  The best Pho in our 6 days in Vietnam (Hanoi, Halong Bay, Lou Cai and Sapa). We do eat pho every day.

reviews.author: 현진 정
reviews.title: The best pho
reviews.content: During hilton garden inn, we just have walked there. I loved a smoked meats pho. In a soup i tasted a strong smoked meats. 50,000vnd a pho.

reviews.author: CK Chung
reviews.title: Best Pho
reviews.content: Location is near to Hilton Garden Inn. Our favourite place for breakfast. Restaurant opens early and close late at night. Nearby is the morning market with plenty to see. A few steps from the restaurant are s few nice cafe shop serving authentic Vietnam coffee.

reviews.author: Bradford K
reviews.title: Best pho of my life, authentic experience
reviews.content:
Busy with locals at 11AM, my fiancee and I sat down and were brought two bowls of the most delicious pho either of us have ever had.  $2.5 US per bowl, paired with a $0.5 US local beer.  Can't wait to go back.  This is an absolute MUST.

The other reviewers complaining about it being dirty and having poor service are frankly laughable.  What do you want from a glorified street food stand?  Ignore them, go and eat this delicious pho!!

reviews.author: Anthony G
reviews.title: Excellent Pho
reviews.content:
This is the best Pho we have had on Hanoi. Discovered it on our last day unfortunately. We took a taxi from the Old Quarter. 

The broth is second to none very flavourful and filled with greens.

For westerns, this is a no frills place. You walk in pay, try and find a table and get your food. When we went there were no seats in the establishment so they sent us two doors down and we ate there.. Note: You will be sitting with the locals, which is a testament to the kind of food they serve..

reviews.author: WanderingJustice
reviews.title: Best pho!
reviews.content:
This place served the best pho we had during our stay in Hanoi. The pho is unique, with lots of greens and garlic. But while flavorful, the broth was clear and crisp -- no heavy aftertaste.

The location is a bit out of the way, and the restaurant itself is not very fancy, but the pho was delicious! The place is packed with locals during lunch, but it is easy to find a seat at the communal tables. 50,000 for one bowl was a great deal. Don't expect any service; just pay and sit down. They only serve one dish, so no need to order.

reviews.author: Voyages_and_Wingspan
reviews.title: Busy pho shop
reviews.content:
It was our second time to Pho Thin in many months. It's great quality and very unique. One of us felt it wasn't as good as our first time there.

We didn't have to wait for too long for our spots. The Pho bowls were full of flavour and the price was cheap.

The owner thought we're teachers from a language school and almost offered us a job as a her daughter's private tutor.

reviews.author: Gauguin
reviews.title: Beat pho
reviews.content: It really good pho, but need to wait so long in the morning for the pho, its worst to wait but if u are busy or don't want to wasted your time, other place would be better

reviews.author: hoahip144
reviews.title: Good pho but dirty
reviews.content:
The place is dirty, and the service is awful. Pho is quite expensive in comparison to the service and to other restaurants.

But the soup of pho is really really nice and unique, and it seems to be the only reason this restaurant stands out.

reviews.author: Eugene H
reviews.title: Supposedly highly rated but we found it to be average
reviews.content:
Was supposed to be highly rated by local and international review sites but we weren't blown away, perhaps it was a matter of taste/opinion as we were probably more used to the southern style of pho. 

It was decent value for money but the surroundings could have been cleaner. There were paper napkins and lime peels all over the floor and the internal parts of the shop were incredibly warm and humid due to the raging fire going on at the entrance where the soup was being boiled.

We spent around 110k VND for 2 bowls of pho and a bowl of fried dough fritters

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Best Pho!
reviews.content: Pho Thin specialises in Pho and do it perfectly. The place is small and very rustic, they don't speak any english, but it was a really interesting experience ordering, it was definitelly worth it.

reviews.author: Renee J
reviews.title: Worth a try
reviews.content:
The pho is quite nice, but the leaks are a bit too many for me.
The beef is stir-fried before putting into the soup, so it tastes special.
No bean sprouts or lemongrass because this is northern pho!

reviews.author: Samson
reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.content:
A really dirty place 
Can't swallow any thing in that smelly environment
And the food is really suck!please don't go it will let you stomachache

reviews.author: Kien N
reviews.title: The number 1 Pho in Ha Noi
reviews.content: Pho Thin is very different from others Pho in Ha Noi or all over Vietnam. I have tried all kinds of Pho for more than 30 years but this is still the unique that you can not find any similar one. They serve only 1 type call "Pho Tai Lan", fried beef with garlic and onion in very strong fire and mixed with special noodle. You have to queue up, pay money upfront (the shop sell only 1 size) and find seats by your self but it will make you want to come back Ha Noi

reviews.author: kapitanchina
reviews.title: Amazing broth
reviews.content: The best pho we have tasted so far.  This makes all other pho items served elsewhere a pale comparison.  Fortunately, the plce was not crowded when we visited and hence were able to enjoy the item in peace without feeling hurried.

reviews.author: Kyle K
reviews.title: Best Sauteed Beef Noodle Soup
reviews.content: Arguably my favorite bowl of Pho Bo in all of Hanoi.  They serve only 1 style, called Lăn, where they stir-fry the beef quickly before adding to the noodle soup.  Finshed with a heaping of spring onion.  Absolutely delicious, and for only 50,000 dong (~$2.50USD).

reviews.author: mhpif
reviews.title: Lives up to the hype
reviews.content:
Simply amazing.  Yes it is that good.  Do not visit Hanoi without eating this Pho.  
For the New Yorkers out there Pho Thin is the Ray's Pizza of Hanoi. This however is the original.

reviews.author: ProfAllison
reviews.title: Amazing Pho
reviews.content:
Ok- do not get confused because I did.  In the pictures there are 2 different restaurants with the same name.  Yup....same name.
I went to the one with the Red sign.  The owner was polite when I found her.  She was somewhere in the back.
The food came out fast and super hot.  And it was AMAZING!!!!! The meat was cooked perfectly.  The soup had obviously been simmering for a LONG LONG time.  
Now this is my first taste of Pho in Hanoi so I can not type if this place is the best.  But it is damn good!!!
SIDENOTE:  this is a street stall.  plastic stools and open air.  This is not a place for the faint of heart or obsessive germophobs.

reviews.author: oykel
reviews.title: Tradition in Hanoi
reviews.content: A Pho is a Pho, except when you have it here which all my Hanoi friends believe is the best. You can spice it up with lime and chillis to suit your taste.There is no allowance made for tourists and you eat communally like all the locals, sometimes on benches inside (where it is very hot due to the huge cooking vats), next door (smarter) or on the pavement crouched down on little plastic chairs and low tables. As advised by a previous contributor, make sure you go to the right one (see photo).

reviews.author: Kelley H
reviews.title: Very good Pho
reviews.content: I wanted to try a new Pho restaurant and found Pho Thin on Tripadvisor. They only have Pho here and it's served to you as soon as you sit down. Many locals were also eating here. Its a quick, in and out, place as there are many people coming and it's community-style seating. I was disappointed that they charged 50k. Almost double the usual price for Pho. Not worth the extra money.

reviews.author: Steve I
reviews.title: Best Pho Bo we had in Hanoi!
reviews.content: After a week in Hanoi we had tried many Pho Bo across the central part of the city (Old and French Quarters) so we decided to check out Pho Thin before we departed. It was a bit difficult to find as there are a lot of restaurants with "Pho Thin" signs out the front so check the address before going inside. The technique used in this restaurant (beef is quickly fried with garlic before going into the broth) makes the pho have a much richer flavour, and it's amazing. If you're staying in the Old Quarter I would definitely recommend making the trek out to this little gem!

reviews.author: Giangtho
reviews.title: Don't take the wrong restaurant
reviews.content:
There're 3 or 4 restaurant that called "Pho Thin" so don't take the wrong one. One is next to Hoan Kiem Lake, one is at the corner of Lo Duc and one is at the 13 in Lo Duc Street. All of them are "Thin".
However the most delicious one is at the no 13 or Lo Duc. The one if corner is not good one.

reviews.author: Penny C
reviews.title: The best Pho in Hanoi
reviews.content: There is one food on the menu Pho! Absolutely the best noodles and soup I've tasted and at a very good price. This is food served immediately and with lime, chilli and pickle to be added to suit your taste. For a real Vietnamese pho this is the place!

reviews.author: dallydd
reviews.title: Quite an experience
reviews.content:
I read about how good Pho Thin's pho is so I was looked for it in earnest.  It really was a hole in the wall - I almost walked right past it. 

Frankly,  I was a bit take a aback when I entered the 'hole' and saw a big cauldron of steaming broth cooking on the left.  The tables were set up along an alley and there were already houses at the end of the alley and I couldn't help but wonder if I was in the wrong place but the girl by the cauldron said yes, I was in Pho Thin. 

I joined a table of youngsters at the back since the one near the entrance was full. 

The pho tasted pretty good, although how the place looked might have dampened my enthusiasm a bit.  The surroundings didn't help make for an appetizing meal.

reviews.author: kaldort
reviews.title: Did you say noodle soup...
reviews.content: Like Vietnamese noodle soup? This hole in the wall delivers nothing but. Get in line on the street (popular), pay for your soup as you enter (only item available, there’s no menu), seat yourself on a bench (same for everyone, Communist style), and in 25 seconds your soup is slapped down in front of you. You might have seen it being cooked as you walked by the soup wrangler amid flames engulfing the huge pot with piles of meat, noodles and veggies arranged on a prep plank. Flavour it yourself with seasonings scattered on the table. Don’t sit back, as you sip the hot bowl, because the bench has no back support. You’re facing your fellow Viet guest nose to nose gulping from your bowls. What? The soup? Well, aahh, it’s ok. Whaddya expect for $3. If you enjoy this manner of supping (it’s not dining, bro) you need go no further; I went 2 or 3 times. If you don’t, you need to go further.

reviews.author: Victoria Wing
reviews.title: Great pho
reviews.content: Beautiful noodles in a wonderful stock! The whole meal was so tasty. The service was great and it cost 50,000 per bowl. I would definitely recommend stopping if you are in the area.

reviews.author: Ho ching wee
reviews.title: Excellent beef noodle soup
reviews.content: The green spring onion and other vegetables sprinkle on top of the beef noodle soup blends the soup and the noodles perfectly. It's very fast serving as you order and pay at the entrance and within 5 mins your order will be served no matter how crowded it is. Walking distance from Hilton Garden and I will come back for lunch each time I am in Hanoi

reviews.author: Vacation545020
reviews.title: Hanoi favorite
reviews.content: We checked out Pho Thin based on Graham Holliday's book (Eating Viet Nam, which I also recommend) and it did not disappointed. We were the only non-locals in the place and there was no menu. Both good signs! We sat down and were served the best pho we have ever had. Delicious broth and beef and piled with green onions. If you can get past the grime of the place (no ambiance it's all about the food) it's definitely worth the trip to the French quarter. It's easy to spot as they post the address on a sign right out front. 13 Lo Duc Street.

reviews.author: bencj88
reviews.title: Delicious fresh pho
reviews.content:
Tried out this outlet pho and like it very much with lots of fresh greens and coriander (see my attached picture), thinly sliced tasty beef and great rich tasting broth. 
Upon entering pay first 50K VND to staff at the kitchen located in front of this outlet. 10K VND for small plate of fried dough sticks, good to soak inside the broth before taking it. 
Choose any vacant seat inside this small outlet and your bowl of pho will be served shortly. On the table, slices of lime are available as well as fresh slices of small hot chillies and hot chillies sauce. I prefer the slices of hot chillies and add some lime juice to spice up rich broth. 
Like this delicious pho so much we went back again to eat the big bowl of delicious pho the day before we left Hanoi. First time we were there was around lunch time and it was very crowded and the second time around mid afternoon where there was less people. Checked and told their operating time is until around 6 pm and open early in the morning.
The look of the entrance for this outlet and the cleanliness of the floor inside might put some people off but the delicious pho served here is too good not to try.

reviews.author: David N
reviews.title: Delicious Pho
reviews.content: I would like highly recommend this area, it is good restaurant and delicious in Hanoi. I love it and i want to come back again

reviews.author: Mark A
reviews.title: Great pho
reviews.content:
Really great pho in Hanoi, just South of the Opera House.

Massive serving, great tasting broth, and some thinly sliced beef, lots of greens and coriander as well.
Limited English spoken, just handed over 50k vnd and was directed to sit down.

Substantially better than the pho I had on a street food tour a few nights later

reviews.author: NgocPhamVan
reviews.title: Great Pho in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Pho is one of most specialty of Hanoi. There are too many many Pho restaurants (shops) (Quan Pho) in Hanoi like Pho Thin (Bo Ho, Lo Duc...) Pho Bat Dan (Bat Dan street), Pho 10 (Ly Quoc Su, Hoang Minh Giam street) or Pho 24 (chain) and small shops at anywhere in Hanoi streets. I love Pho, and tried many Pho places. Each place has different taste of own-shop, but I want to recommend Pho Thin at 13 Lo Duc street, delicious  and clean :)
Pho Thin at 61 Dinh Tien Hoang is delicious too, but smaller.
Maybe foreigner prefers to 13 Lo Duc :D
Should try to enjoy Pho Hanoi!

reviews.author: akhil_ravi
reviews.title: Excellent Pho
reviews.content: Best pho I have eaten in Vitenam, went back there twice for lunch. Basic hole in the wall place but worth the effort to get there

reviews.author: Tu_Hoang
reviews.title: One of best pho places in Hanoi.
reviews.content:
One of best pho places in Hanoi. I eat there from time to time.

The surround is a bit chaotic though.

reviews.author: tupham3366
reviews.title: The perfect pho
reviews.content: I often go to this place with my boss in the morning. We both enjoy this Vietnamese traditional dish so much. Can't get tired of eating this

reviews.author: PrettyShane
reviews.title: "Pho xao" and "Pho ap chao" is awesome.
reviews.content:
They service a very big bow of "Pho". You can choose "pho xao" or "pho ap chao".
"Pho xao" without broth, and "pho ap chao" use with broth. Both of them are yummy.

reviews.author: marytogo
reviews.title: very rustic but great fresh pho
reviews.content: Walk in and pay 50000 ($2.50) dong for pho.  Sit down at a long table and they immediately bring you a large steaming bowl of pho with slices of beef and fresh green herbs.  They sell a lot of it so it is very fresh and delicious.  It's okay for our American digestive systems even though you may be taken aback by the surroundings

reviews.author: Rebecca J
reviews.title: Great phở
reviews.content: This is probably the best phở I have had in Vietnam. It is a very local restaurant and I've never seen any other tourists there. They only sell phở, and it is very cheap (eg $1). Very popular with the locals which is always a good sign.

reviews.author: KazeMoon
reviews.title: Simple and nice
reviews.content: Simple beef rice noodles....with "you tiao" is delicious..the owner doesn't know English but when u step in ...she just know what you want

reviews.author: Valerie N
reviews.title: Unimpressive flavor
reviews.content: All the stellar reviews are a mystery. After eating quite a bit of street food in Vietnam, this is among the most forgettable. Both the beef and the broth lacked flavor and complexity. I've had much better pho in both Vietnam and abroad. I also did not get change back, but was not going to deal with chaos at the counter for US$1.50.

reviews.author: Marc H
reviews.title: outstanding pho
reviews.content:
On our third trip to Hanoi, we wanted to eat street food. We've always been a little intimidated about it because we just didn't know how to navigate the process. We found this place listed on a 'street food tour' list -- the best pho in Hanoi -- and found our way there for breakfast. We weren't sure how to order, where to sit, or how to get our food, but we're so glad we persisted. Here's what we did: we stood at the kitchen and held up one finger, paid 50,000dong, and then took a seat at a table in the little sitting area a couple of doors down the street. Eventually someone brought the pho to us. We grabbed condiments from a nearby table.

I think we should've just taken a seat and someone would've taken our order; you might try that first, but the way we did it worked out.

The pho was magnificent. The broth was rich and complex, the beef was so tender and tasty, and with a ladle of hot sauce, a spoon of peppers, a squeeze of lime, it was divine. No pho will be as wonderful ever again, and of course that's partly due to the experience of eating it there.

reviews.author: Martin Vesterga... K
reviews.title: Inexpensive, good tasting pho.
reviews.content:
Inexpensive, good tasting pho. Nice people and slightly more comfortable chairs than most Hanoi street kitchens :)

The Pho is served with lime, chili and koriander condiments.

reviews.author: yan1007
reviews.title: The soup is to die for
reviews.content: We just happened to walk by this small little place one lunch time and decided to give it a try. It is one of the best pho you can have in Hanoi. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: TravelingR0ck
reviews.title: Great find
reviews.content: The pho at this restaurant was excellent and very tasty. If you're looking for ambiance, this isn't the place for you but if you're interested in delicious, safe street food then definitely stop in for a meal. The staff were friendly as well. I'd definitely recommend the restaurant to friends and I would return to eat there again.

reviews.author: AnnaCandy
reviews.title: Delicious local food
reviews.content:
I eat Pho Thin many time with my friend, nearly 1 time/week for 4 years in Hanoi.
You can absolutely taste the stir fried beef. it is great  with some hot sauce and garlic added. The price is acceptable, 30k/a bolw.  nearly $2
Staff is friendly and the service is quite quick. Let's try.

reviews.author: Yummydelight
reviews.title: This stall totally changed my impression of Pho
reviews.content:
We took at cab out from Old Quarters to try this Pho stall at 4pm. We want to make sure that the stall is opened before we make our way there. Luckily a staff member at the hotel we were staying in said he was just there for lunch earlier. That goes to show that even locals visit this place. Due to the odd timing, the stall was pretty empty, no queues nor crowd. Plenty of seats available. The Pho here had light broth, the other condiments are left on the table for guests to add ourselves. Beef was tender, rice noodles were al-dente.  
For details: http://yummydelight.wordpress.com/2014/05/20/pho-thin-hanoi/

reviews.author: gborotraveler
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.content: Went with some local friends from hanoi    Wow. Probably best pho I have had. Only dish they do.  Full of locals.  As others say. Long tables and benches.  Give u some fried bread to soak up broth.  Cost like $10 for six of us drinks included.

reviews.author: Avy L
reviews.title: Original taste
reviews.content: It is very different with the pho we had in Sydney, it is much better! The herb they use are different, you also have to try the fry bread sticks with it. It was nice. The lotus tea is nice too....

reviews.author: AlKo33
reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.content: Only serve beef noddles Pho and inexpensive around $2.50. Pay cash and is crowded with lots of locals. Sitting by the bench and share the long table. It was a good place to eat if you need something quick and filling.

reviews.author: Joowick
reviews.title: Look nowhere else for Pho!!
reviews.content: Takes a little bit of an effort to get to, since it isn't directly in the old quarter, but it is definitely worth the effort. One dish only.. Pho and it'll be the only one you need to try in Hanoi. 2 of us had 4 bowls. The soup base was tasty and the noodles were made perfectly. Beef could be slightly more tender, but good enough for me at this price. The staff were very friendly to us being foreigners, they even taught us all their different ingredients outside their store where all the cooking was done. Yum Yum!!

reviews.author: Michseitz
reviews.title: Must try!
reviews.content: This restaurant is not in the old quarter, so we got a taxi and walked around there to find it. Not that easy but we were happy and hungry when we finally found it. The pho we had was really yummy. All people were locals, so that's normally a good sign for a street-food place. However we felt that we had to pay a foreigner price as one pho was 6 USD. Still okay, but doesn't feel right.

reviews.author: Justthetrip
reviews.title: Best Pho you'll ever have
reviews.content: Imagine a place that only serves one dish...and that dish is pho...and it's the best pho you'll have in Vietnam and maybe in you're life for $2.50. Then you know you're at Pho Thin.

reviews.author: Ben R
reviews.title: One of the best dishes I've ever had
reviews.content:
Just go.  It's amazing.  Order the pho bo (beef pho), sit with locals, throw in some chilis, a little lime, maybe some chili sauce, and enjoy the extremely fresh pho with perfect rice noodles, incredibly flavorful broth, crunchy scallions, lean and tender beef.  It's one of the best dishes I've ever had, anywhere.  We went twice in 3 days and each time it was spot on.  Oh, and it's like $2 or 2.50 per order.

Has me reconsidering my breakfast routine back here in the states.

reviews.author: L T
reviews.title: Don't get it
reviews.content: The place is indeed packed everyday during meal times. But what i had is so different than all the pho I've ever had, and not in a very good way. The pictures of the food and dining area on TA are much better than what we saw. I didn't expect 5, or 4, or 3, or even 2-star dining establishment, being Vietnamese myself. But this place is not that much cleaner than the street food stalls. The pho is just simply greasy broth pour on top of noodles and few pieces of minced beef and a ton of thinly sliced scallions. The straw that broke the camel's back for me was when i pulled out some napkins and wipe my mouth, i smelled cochroach droppings (cức gián). Had to squeeze many lime wedges and still couldn't get the smell off. Ran right back to the Hilton Garden Inn to wash with soap!!!

reviews.author: Yoni G
reviews.title: Best Pho we tried in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Why are reviewers here purporting to know where is the best Pho in Hanoi?  It's a big city with plenty of Pho restaurants/stands.  I certainly haven't tried enough to know, and would do the city a disservice to claim otherwise.  But of those we tried, Pho Thin was definitely our favorite.

Rush hour lunch with a group of 7 was including 2 young children was not without stress - cafeteria style seating with constant flow of eaters.  We finished at different times and were compelled to wait outside as throngs were waiting for seats.  But it was worth the effort.  

Broth is complex but not heavy or overwhelming with salt/oil.   
Noodles cooked just right and breadsticks really worked well.  Plenty of condiments to play with to get the right flavor for your bowl. 
Beef pieces not cooked to my liking but I haven't really found a place in Vietnam yet (only been here for 2 weeks) with truly rare brisket served like in NYC. 

Breadsticks (read: you tiao) for the win!

reviews.author: Phung M
reviews.title: No.1 Pho in HN
reviews.content: I like its taste, so far it demonstrated the distinct taste ( quite different as compared to others) and I firmly believe that no one can cook Pho noodle like they did in Vietnam. High recommended and must try for anyone who loves Pho. However, sometimes being patient is required. Bon appetit

reviews.author: 272Mckee
reviews.title: Awesome Pho
reviews.content: Trust me !!! this is the best pho in Hanoi if you looking for the real Hanoi Pho, the traditional famous food for Hanoi. Just $3 for a bowl of beef Pho. Amazing and cheap price.  If you had a much drink last night, this Pho is a highly recommended for you.

reviews.author: TravelwithAndre
reviews.title: a hole in the wall with the best Pho ANYWHERE
reviews.content: I have eatten the best Pho in little Saigon (OC Calif) and man, this little whole in a wall (you will miss it the first time looking for it), with ONE item on the menu, has to best food in town (Hanoi), or anywhere....$2.50 for a bowl of beef Pho.....you don't have to order, they only have one item, and they bring it for you when you sit down....enjoy!

reviews.author: Avantikai
reviews.title: Stirfried beef pho!
reviews.content:
Awesome pho. Very nice. Really one of the best around. The doughsticks are very well done as well.

Hard to find, but at least it is open for dinner.

reviews.author: Han Ju K
reviews.title: No.1 Pho restaurants in Hanoi
reviews.content: The price of pho is a litttle bit expensice than others but it is very resonable to enjoy Best Pho in Hanoi~especially if you had a drink too much last night, this restaurans is recommamdable for you.

reviews.author: tissu
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.content: I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the food here.  going by myself, not speaking the language, all i had to do is find an empty seat, and indicated with my finger "1", and viola, a hot steaming pho bo was delivered to me within minutes!  The stock had depth, the bowl was full of greens, and the noodles were very light and also fluffy!  I would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Tuan Tran
reviews.title: Best Pho Bo in Hanoi

reviews.author: FAhonolulu
reviews.title: Light and Healthy Pho Bo Must Try
reviews.content:
This place is small but with a high-ceiling.....feels airy.
It's quite easy to find.  Only 7-8 minutes short walk from the Opera House, though it's worth to even take a cab to get this place.
I had a bowl of Pho Bo (rice noodle soup with cooked beef and green vegetables) with fried bread sticks...not like Italian bread sticks, but more elongated soft donuts.  You supposed to dip it into your soup and eat as snack while having soup.  I was watching how locals ate.
Pho/noodles are outstanding, soup delicious & fresh and beef and vegetables taste very fresh.
Pho Bo 50,000VND (about US$2.30) and bread 10,000VND.

reviews.author: tessababy
reviews.title: Must try !
reviews.content: While we were thinking it would be easy to find a good noodle soup just almost at any corner of Hanoi , it appeared to be not or we just unlikely by having all average ones. Pho Thin is really above average , worth for you to even take a cab to go there.

reviews.author: Solexius
reviews.title: Great Beef Noodle Soup
reviews.content:
We were quiet surprised when standing in front of this restaurant because it is a usual street food place. The soup is really delicious and taste very fresh. One of the chefs speak little english and was frendly. 
I am not sure if they sell beverages or not but we could not order any.  Try this place for probably the best beef 'pho' of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Trek65101204085
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: This is the most popular and my local agent took me to eat breakfast here.  I thouroughly enjoyed it, and they do an excellent job of making Pho.  However, I have had just as good at many other places around Hanoi.  This is probably the most famous, and there is nothing to argue with really.  The food was outstanding and I left with a full belly and very little dent to my pocket.  There is fantastic foot massage place across the street and I would certainly not mind doing that everyday.  Terrific Pho with a foot massage to start the day!!

reviews.author: Zouzou333
reviews.title: "Return your change later" SCAM
reviews.content:
Demand that you want your change RIGHT NOW if the person taking your money claims that he is too busy and will return your later.  He is only just trying to rip you off.

When we arrived, there were only 5-6 clients eating and no line up. We paid for the pho then immediately ordered drinks too. When paying for the drinks, the man taking our money (who also was the same person who prepared the pho) claimed that he was now "too busy" to give us our change and that he would return it later.  However, just a few seconds earlier, he returned our change for the pho. Also, at this time, there was only 1 new client behind us. So what does he do when there is a big line-up!? He keeps all the change!?

We reluctantly sat done anyways, but after a few minutes, we went back to demand our change. We didn't trust him.

If you decide to go, give exact change. 

Pho was flavourful, but I would not go back or recommend Pho Thin to others due to this bad experience.

reviews.author: Ogimoto
reviews.title: the best pho in Hanoi
reviews.content:
I was taken to this place some years ago by a local friend, but could not find it again.  Now, one of my colleauges "discovered" this place and we became loyal customers.  The pho here is just a good volume and thickness for lunch.  The price as VND 50,000 per bowl is way expensive compared with other places, but it worths. The place is open almost all day.  You can come here for breakfast, lunch or dinner.  Locals have beer with the pho here, too.
The place provides good atmosphere of a very local old style house. 
This place remindes me of many noodle shops in Japan where people focus on the noodle.

reviews.author: Golds72
reviews.title: Never judge a book by its cover
reviews.content: Pho Thin is one of those places that need to be visited while in hanoi. I was lucky that my business associate was a foodie himself and insisted on lunch at this place. The beef noodle soup is to die for.. This place is like a fast food joint with quality of food of a fine dinning restaurant. Do not get mixed up by the simplicity of the restaurant..it is very practical but gets all the points which matter the most.. i.e. FOOD... Superb flavours...the ingredients used are so fresh that you can get the flavours...I wish this place was located where I reside..

reviews.author: Maker H
reviews.title: One of the best Noodles in Hanoi
reviews.content: Pho is one of the most famous and delicious foods in Vietnam. There are plenty of brand name that people could enjoy and one of them is Pho Thin. Being appeared from drozens of years ago, Pho Thin kept Hanoi taste through time. It hided some things pure inside which only could you realize when you made a try. With some secrets in cooking methods, Pho Thin created a magic to remind in people's memory about one of the best taste in Hanoi. Nowhere could you enjoy both traditional Pho and sit in old scene rather than in Pho Thin. Let take a try and experience Hanoi through foods.

reviews.author: Elena1010
reviews.title: Impressions taste
reviews.content: Every time i came Vietnam,in immediately upon iam arrival that i think about Hanoi Noodle (Pho). The way they do this food here is very special. There onions,cilantro,gevetable,garlic,especialy for fresh beef and delicious flavor. I traveled at many places but Hanoi Pho leaving me plenty of impressive and unforgettable. Kind recommend everyone come Vietnam and do not missing Hanoi Pho.

reviews.author: David Ham
reviews.title: Best Pho Ever!
reviews.content:
It was about a 10 minute motobike ride from the old quarter where we were staying, but it was more than worth the drive. 
We went around 2, a bit past the local work hour, and thank goodness. 
The atmosphere is as local and "real" as it gets. 
And the food.. my god, the food.
I've had pho for almost every meal since I've been in Vietnam and this is the best by far. 
Going back tomorrow for some more. 

100,000 dong for two.

reviews.author: Lydia_Salman
reviews.title: Big bowl of Pho
reviews.content:
A friend took us to this Pho restaurant, he order a bowl for each of us....when I saw the bowl, OMG it's a big bowl, even my husband cannot finished it.

The taste is awesome, with chili and cakwe it's perfect combination.....

reviews.author: michellegaojie
reviews.title: Pho!
reviews.content: We wanted to have pho for breakfast and found this one on tripadvisor. True as the other reviewer said, a lot of meat!! Pho Bo (beef rice noodle) is highly recommended! Only 450,000VDN, which is only 3 dollars!

reviews.author: SueRainham
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content:
Probably my 6th pho for the trip but was well worth the hike in soaring temperatures.
Lucky they only serve one dish so   was easy to place an order

reviews.author: Alvin_Zeragorn
reviews.title: This restaurant has a nice touch
reviews.content:
For being a Vietnamese, I have been eating Pho ever since I was a kid. In Vietnam, there are many different Pho styles, and Pho Thin is my favorite.
First of all, they have more beef. I love meat and high protein meal. Their soup has rich taste thanks to the stir fried beef. Other Pho style has boiled beef in them so the taste cannot as tasty of Pho Thin.
Secondly, even with a meaty bowl of pho, they are still able to balance the flavor with the herbs. Pho Thin is like a harmony of beef, herbs, and rice vermicelli.
Lastly, the restaurant has same design with pho restaurants in the past. It hit my nostalgic side. So it is another plus for me.

reviews.author: Chanh C
reviews.title: Cant miss this if you are a Pho's fan
reviews.content:
It is truly delicious. I love Pho especially when I eat here because the restaurant know how to make real Pho. 
People think that this dish is easy to make, yes it is easy to make, but it's hard to MAKE IT RIGHT! And they know how to make it right here.
Quick service, kinda clean (well you cant complain about hygeine here much) but the food just help you sweep out ur mind all other things, you come to a restaurant to eat anyway.

reviews.author: CarolinaTravelers2
reviews.title: Only one item--beef pho--hearty, tasty, and cheap!
reviews.content: The kitchen is in the front of this simple restaurant, and there is only one choice:  beef pho (hearty beef-noodle soup).   We paid our 50,000 ($2.50) Vietnamese Dong each on the way in and sat down at a long metal table with other diners.  Huge bowls of soup were placed in front of us.  Lime wedges and chopped red chili peppers were on the table along with chopsticks and napkins. Diners tossed their used paper napkins in little wastebaskets under the tables. Because it doesn't look too clean, we probably wouldn't have ventured in if it had not been recommended by our Vietnamese tour director.   Definitely a great choice, for the delicious, rich soup, the local ambiance, and the low price.

reviews.author: LCI3
reviews.title: The Pho Experience
reviews.content:
If you're looking for ambiance, conversation, or service, make another selection.  If you're looking for some of the best Pho in town (many say the best) this is the place.
 
This is a small restauant, the front of wich is dominated by a huge grimy pot.  The tables are steel and communal; the jars of condiments look questionable, used napkins and squeezed limes go on the floor.  This is also a place for a quick meal -- people don't linger and there's very little talking. It's not cute, would make a western health inspector cringe, but the food is wonderful, tha combination of delicate and tasty that exemplifies Vietnamese cooking.

reviews.author: Vu Kim Oanh
reviews.title: Pho with stir-fry beef
reviews.content:
Its one of the best Pho in Hanoi. Pho Thin in 13 Lo Duc street is stir-fry beef, different with boiled beef in all most other Pho Bo (Beef) shops. You can have it in any time, for breakfast, lunch or dinner, is up to you.
Other best Pho Bo with hard-boiled beef in Hanoi (I think is the best) is Pho Ly Quoc Su (Ly Quoc Su is the name of the street which that shop used to locate). Now they move to 27 Phung Hung str (the real one, othes named Ly Quoc Su are fake). You have to queue and prepay for it.

reviews.author: solarize_uk
reviews.title: The best pho I've ever had
reviews.content: I wasn't in Hanoi long, but this place stood out for me. Had a quick pho lunch and I can honestly say it was the best pho I've ever had. Will be hard to return to the pho restaurants that I have access to at home!

reviews.author: seanjpsmith
reviews.title: Tasty Pho
reviews.content: This place has amazing pho, much better than pho24. It makes me hungry just writing about it. A little hard to find, so keep an eye out.

reviews.author: Lilia_Phan
reviews.title: Delicious but the it's not a nice and clean restaurant.
reviews.content: I love Pho Thin :) In my opinion it's the best Pho in Hanoi. Anyway, if you are not used to eat in a restaurant with "Vietnamese style", you shouldn't try Pho Thin (you should be in a cleaner restaurant like Pho 24) The restaurant of Pho Thin (in Lo Duc street) is always crowded and you have to serve yourself. Besides, Pho Thin is absolutely good in winter, not in summer, when the weather is so hot for you to enjoy such dishes.

reviews.author: heydana
reviews.title: Great pho with a very beef-y broth
reviews.content: Usually Hanoi/northern style Pho has a clear, light and aromatic broth. At Pho Thin, the broth is much darker and has a distinctly beef-y flavor. I quite liked it, and many of the locals do as well, but it is different and can be a bit off putting if you prefer a more subtle broth. Just south of the Old Quarter, it's worth a taste if you're on a hunt for the best pho in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Long N
reviews.title: Best Place for Pho Thin
reviews.content: Highly recommended for anyone visiting Hanoi. It is always crowded for a reason and it is the taste. You can't miss this. The bowl of full Pho (rice noodles) and stir-fried beef in garlic, tenderloin and few herbs, hot soup. Well, you have to try it yourself!

reviews.author: Tareq M
reviews.title: First Class Pho
reviews.content: Great street style atmosphere, it gives you a taste of the real city.  With only one dish on the menu, they can't get it wrong.  The rest of the crowd makes the place, and the Beef Pho hits the spot for those that want a real taste of local cuisine.   It beats the rest.  Highly recommended for anyone visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: ECKLKualaLumpur
reviews.title: Less is More Part 54 - An Absolute Original
reviews.content:
Pho Bo or Pho Bo Tai (rare version) I have tasted aplenty. And I have always asserted that HCMC (Pho Hoa on Pasteur) was the very best until......... 

The southern and northern forms of Pho Bo have subtle differences. I have found that the south tends to use more varied fresh herb condiments and vegetables with a clearer broth while the northern version has a richer deeper flavored soup base, less herbs and more meat.

Pho Thin adds another twist to the preparation by browning the meat first with garlic in a scorchingly hot wok. This step renders a WONDERFUL SMOKINESS to the thinly sliced tenderloin before it is added to the rice noodles as the last topping. Pho Thin is very generous with their meat and at 40,000 dong per bowl, its a deal that is hard to resist. After tossing in fresh chillies, thinly sliced spring onions and a squeeze of lime, its a taste that impossible to resist.

The narrow shop on Lo Duc is way south of the Old Quarters in a 'newer' part of town not too far from Cho Hom (market). The gigantic blackened soup pots sits on flaming stoves right at the front of the shop. It is not a pretty sight and inside the messy floors strewn with tissue, squeezed lime and toothpicks add to the unsightliness. But (breakfast) crowds clearly don't come here to enjoy the aesthetics (although I personally feel that the 'unsightliness' adds to the charm).

REALLY NOT TOO BE MISSED.

reviews.author: tuddn
reviews.title: Not the "best" but tasty
reviews.content:
Pho was tasty but different from what I'm used to in Australia -- maybe this is true Hanoi style? :)

Went there around 3pm and the place was quiet -- plenty of seating! Place was dirty e.g., tissues all over the floor and sauces in jars on the table tops did not look appetising at all so didn't touch those...

Don't expect any service here! We rocked in and sat down only to find everyone paying at the door on the way in -- oops! Anyway like everyone says... there's no menu! They only serve one dish which came promptly soon after!

In any case, cheap bowl of still tasty pho ($45,000 VND)! Also tried the deep fried bread sticks ($10,000 VND) but they were a little stale so didn't finish them :(

Worth a try but I'm sure you can find better!

reviews.author: csh68
reviews.title: Great Vietnamese Beef Pho - Must Try
reviews.content: Had lunch here with 10 colleagues, they serve only beef pho as well as dough sticks (you tiao). Add a dash of lime juice, spice it up with chili sauce or pickled chili. Dining area quite crowded, cleanliness will need some getting use to if you are not used to local conditions, but definitely worth trying it!

reviews.author: HangGabbie
reviews.title: Great beef noodle
reviews.content:
They only have one receipt: noodle and beef but the taste is excellent. If you want to taste Vietnamese Pho Bo - then this cannot be missed out! 
However it is very crowded at dine-time and the seating area is not tidy.

reviews.author: pnsl
reviews.title: Best Pho in Vietnam
reviews.content: Our family, a couple with 3 teenaged childred lived in HCMC for 2 and a half years. We have tried Pho 2000, Pho 24, Pho Hung (Quan7 Phu My Hung) and Pho Hoa (Pasteur str) all and I still think Pho Thin is the best. The broth is good that we had 4 meals here during our 3 days stay in Hanoi. We have Pho Tyuen once, it was good too but we preferred Pho Thin anytime. For those Pho lovers out there, try Pho thin.  My youngest son 16 yrs old had two at 1 time.

reviews.author: Jackie & Puru
reviews.title: A real taste of Hanoi
reviews.content:
We had pho here at 5.45am one morning after arriving back in Hanoi from Sapap as it was very close to our hotel and our guide had recommended it. At that time of the morning there were very few people there and we were given huge bowls of pho which was delicious, despite not being the type of breakfast I would normally have.
This is a very basic, typical street cafe frequented by locals, unlike most of the other tourist ones, so we were really glad that we had the opportunity to have this authentic experience as part of our visit to Vietnam.

reviews.author: Ha Luong
reviews.title: The Best Pho in Hanoi - Only Pho with beef
reviews.content: As the talk of my tour guide, Mr Ha - asiatravelline com pany. I found to Lo Duc str, that is long street with many big trees was planted by French. I came there by bus and the bus stop is on the other way of the street. I got off the bus at the bus stop which is in front of the hospital, then walked back to find the No 13 on the billboard. after 10 minutes walk under the sun - lucky day because of the winter season. I walked to the end of the str, but could not see any No13. then a count back, the fist house on the left is No1 and so on. I saw a house with many motorbikes in front of it - on the vendor. so at the fist time I walked by, I could not walk on the vendor so I had to step down on the street so I did not see the restaurant. ok, right now I got it. I came in the restaurant. The fist thing I saw a cooker with a big pot on the top. Suddenly, a waiter stopped me and say "money" I did not understand. then her say again, thirty thousand Dong. I say "oh, understand"  I show her 50.000d. she refunded me 20.000d. then she took me to inside and sat on the long wooden char. In 5 minutes a waiter servers me a big bow of Pho with beef I added lemon juice, a litter chili sauce mix them and enjoyed. that is the best Pho I've ever eaten, fantastic and very delicious. Compare with 24 Pho, I prefer Thin Pho than 24 pho. Thin Pho is more delicious and more local, not noisy, clean and more local people come than 24 Pho and cheaper one.

reviews.author: hemmelzz
reviews.title: Unique food of Vietnam
reviews.content: It was super delicious .It is a mix of noodle , beef, soup and some vegetables. I ate this almost everyday when I have been to Hanoi. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: patrickgoalld
reviews.title: Come and try hanoi truly taste
reviews.content: In here, I just want to talk about the quality of the meal only but if they can improve their service that could be much more better. It was hard for us at that time to find someone who can speak English and help us to make our order. We just picked randomly choice but fortunately it was very tasty. The soup was so nice and I cannot find an exactly word to describe it. The price was almost nothing with us , it just cost only around 2 or 3 bugs depend on your type of meal. Anyways, it was a great meal, a great Hanoi’s taste. Just find and try it!!!

reviews.author: Hoi-an-photo-tour
reviews.title: a hanoi classic
reviews.content: lived in hanoi 10 years, love pho and i had two favourites for the vietnamese national dish, one is pho thin and the other closed 5 years ago.....actually pho thin has several location as sons of the legendary pho maker. one you could try is on an alley on hoan kiem lake. just walk around hoan kiem lake and ask for tho phin.

reviews.author: PaulEmily
reviews.title: The great Vietnamese food
reviews.content: Come to Hanoi if don't try noodle soup , THIN noodle soup actually you're wasted one of many special food in the world. The soup it made from bone. It gives to people a wonderful flavor. I think it's a food that's people must try once time in their life.

reviews.author: russellmel
reviews.title: traditional Vietnam food
reviews.content:
I very like the taste of this noodle. The Vietnamese people like to eat noodle with the cake they call Quay. The taste so delicious. I love it. This will give the real taste of hanoi. If come to Hanoi u must try Pho. 
I would highly recommend this to tourist

reviews.author: gt123
reviews.title: beef noudle
reviews.content:
I very like thwe beef noudle in this restaurant. It so nice
I love beef noudle.
The service is quite ok not very good

locationDesc: Hanoi’s lively Old Quarter comprises nearly 40 streets packed with shops selling all kinds of goods, each street named for its primary good or service.

reviews.author: Igor Alexeev
reviews.title: Old Quarter of Hanoi: colorful...
reviews.content: The Old Quarter of Hanoi, also known as "36 Streets of Hanoi," is located north and west of Hoan Kiem Lake. Many tourists start their acquaintance with Hanoi from the Old Quarter. Including to ensure that the Old Quarter is a multitude of architectural, historical, and other attractions, public spaces, shops, stalls, restaurants, cafes, and other tourist attractions. And, of course, a huge number of people, especially in the evening. So, while walking through the Old Quarter, it will not be unnecessary to keep an eye not only at the sights but also at your pockets...

reviews.author: COM Service Private Car Chauffeur Hanoi
reviews.title: Impressions of Vietnam's ancient towns
reviews.content: Hanoi’s Old Quarter is not merely a tourist destination but a living museum, preserving the heartbeat and soul of a capital city with a thousand years of culture. Spending a day strolling through its narrow alleys and enjoying a summer evening meal is the best way to truly immerse yourself in the pulse of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Rae L
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnamese charm in the streets
reviews.content: The avenues are stunning, offering a genuinely immersive experience of true Vietnam.

reviews.author: Patty B
reviews.title: A Nice Walk

Shop and places to eat are plentiful.  We were just browsing and didn’t buy anything.  We just enjoyed people watching and seeing vendors and their wares.

reviews.author: Luggage Storage IO
reviews.title: A vibrant family adventure, but one crucial tip for the sidewalks!
reviews.content: Visiting the Hanoi Old Quarter with our family was easily one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The atmosphere is completely electric—our kids absolutely loved the traditional water puppet show near Hoan Kiem Lake, riding in cyclos through the silk streets, and stopping for authentic egg coffee and fresh spring rolls.However, a big heads-up if you are visiting with young children: the sidewalks in the Old Quarter are narrow, uneven, and often packed with parked motorbikes and tiny plastic street-food stools. You need both hands free just to navigate the busy street crossings safely with kids. Do NOT attempt to explore this area dragging large suitcases behind you.On our final afternoon, we had an 11:00 AM hotel check-out but our sleeper train wasn't leaving until 9:00 PM. Instead of being stuck or hauling bags through crowded alleys, we used Luggage Storage IO to drop our heavy family suitcases at a verified hotel front desk right in the Old Quarter. It was around $2.40 (50,000 VND) per bag for the day, monitored by 24/7 front desk staff and CCTV, and arranged in two minutes on WhatsApp without needing an app.Being totally hands-free made wandering the night markets and eating street food completely stress-free for the whole family. Highly recommend taking a slow walk through the 36 guild streets, just make sure you store your heavy bags first!

reviews.author: Saracen Groyper

reviews.author: Snus Ha Noi
reviews.title: Snus Ha Noi
reviews.content: If you're looking for snus in Hanoi, Snus Ha Noi is definitely a place worth checking out.The shop is small but clean, bright and nicely organized. The space feels comfortable and relaxed, with upbeat music that gives it a young and energetic atmosphere. It’s a nice place to stop by while exploring Hanoi.They have a good selection of popular brands including **VELO, ZYN, ICEBERG, PABLO, KILLA, LOOP** and more. What I really liked is that the products are kept refrigerated at around **8–15°C**, which helps maintain their freshness and flavor.The staff are friendly, helpful and easy to talk to, which makes choosing a product much easier if you're trying something new.Overall, **Snus Ha Noi is a great little spot for anyone looking for snus in Hanoi**, especially if you're visiting the city and want to check out a local shop with a good selection and friendly service.Definitely worth a visit while you're in Hanoi! 🇻🇳

Food stalls, sitting on plastic stools, you will eat hot phở for a dollar, alongside the locals. The scent of fresh cilantro, red lanterns, and hidden temples, so much smog. A blender. Hanoi enchants you.

reviews.author: bebeThionville
