reviews.content: The lake itself is nothing special, it's the Tran Quoc Pagoda on it that is worth visiting.  A pleasant place to walk around on a hot day.

reviews.author: TravellerJeffLee
reviews.title: Nice Sunset
reviews.content: Glad to catch a beautiful sunset at westlake. Quite a lot of things here and there is the famous coconut vanila ice cream. Most local came here for ice cream and I'm excited to watch the sun set and manage to take some great shot of the beautiful sun set..

reviews.author: Vivndhugh
reviews.title: Smells of Dead rotting fish
reviews.content: We were stunned to see so many dead fish in the lake which was stinking of rotting fish  which had started to rot and was attracting flies. The lake is also full of rubbish which was sad as it looked beautiful on photos we had view before our trip. After seeing so many dead fish and the smell becoming worse, we left the lake and went back to Hanoi

reviews.author: Jeff Slo
reviews.title: Neglected city asset.
reviews.content: ok, this is a nice area and well designed space, but this lake if filthy, filled with trash, gross water, stinky dead fish, and shoe shine guys and trinket sales people attacking you. hanoi needs to aerate this baby, clean the water up, remove the tons of litter and industrial trash, and then you will really have something to be proud of. it is NOT nice to walk around, unless you like strolls around waste treatment plants. i dunno what people are talking about. No one would tolerate this filth in their own town, so unsure why they think it is so enjoyable to visit while in vietnam.

reviews.author: CardiffMaddie
reviews.title: Great views, but a bit run down
reviews.content: We thought we'd visit here as it seems to be a landmark.  It's divided by a causeway into one very large and a smaller lake. Think they must have a problem with pollution here as they seem to be aerating the large Lake and there are lots of dead fish on the smaller one.  Some floating restaurants on the one side but again a little run down. If you walk along the causeway you can enter a pagoda.  Free entry.  Worth a look but don't rush there.

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: A Stroll
reviews.content: Best to visit on a weekend when there are people out and about in the park and the streets are car free.

reviews.author: JetLSy
reviews.title: Nice place to walk around
reviews.content: It's a lake. Nice view though. There are plenty of shops around the area too where you can just sit and chill. Watch people doing something interesting. If you want to just relax, then this is the spot. :)

reviews.author: Rob S
reviews.title: Only if time to spare
reviews.content: I knew I'd have time and someone day I decided to walk around west Lake. When I started out it looked a long way....I should have googled it first.5 hours and 20km later !!! Stopped for a couple of beers mid route !

reviews.author: riahijihan14
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.content: YOu can enjoy Vietnamese coffee ,Beer and some nice restaurant around the lake.Not many tourist and fresh air here

reviews.author: Corinne D
reviews.title: Peaceful and pleasant lake
reviews.content: We had lunch at a cafe overlooking the lake and it was a wonderful surprise. Owned I am told by Aussie chef and owner, the menu is varied but well thought of. I starter with a avocado smoothie while my husband enjoyed beer. We had the ribs with sides of corn on the cob and creamed spinach and the crumbed camembert with tasty chutney. All very satisfying and reasonably priced. A happy experience.

reviews.author: craigrwhite
reviews.title: Tour with Hanoi Kids
reviews.content: A good way to see what the locals do. Reminded me very much of a rural coastal town in my home state of Victoria Australia.

reviews.author: jnkwilliams2016
reviews.title: Hanoi, a city on a lake
reviews.content: Stayed beside West Lake enjoying glorious views over West Lake. Lovely to walk around, opportunities to take a sailing 'swan' onto the lake. Unfortunately the Lake was poisoned in some way so the fish all died and floated on the surface. In the heat the smell soon permeated the adjacent area but officials were working to clear it up quickly. Stop for a meal or coffee in some of the surrounding cafes to enjoy the Lake.

reviews.author: worldtravela69
reviews.title: Beautiful large body of water but clearly polluted
reviews.content: Obviously being in the middle of an urban center aquatic life doesn't stand a chance in this water but it is big enough to create a beautiful scene and view from the surrounding area.  A lot more peaceful than staying in the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: wellycaro
reviews.title: Grey and dirty
reviews.content: Don't think for a moment that this is a tranquil or beautiful setting.  Dead fish washed up, noisy traffic, smog and fumes.  Interesting, but I wouldn't recommend staying in this part of town.

reviews.author: 917jodi
reviews.title: Massive lake
reviews.content: It was pretty but there were dead fish on the day that we visited. The locals sell turtles for you to place into the lake for luck.

reviews.author: vm1981
reviews.title: Huge!
reviews.content: West Lake is the largest lake in Hanoi, and is a big lake in general. A good way to experience it would be to visit the Sunset Bar at the Intercontinental hotel.

reviews.author: Fadamos
reviews.title: Great for a walk or run around
reviews.content: Staying at the Sofitel right on the lake, the lake was central to our visit with many local food vendors and shops along the roads, leading down to the Old Quarter. There are a number of sights to see along the way, making this site a great one to see for those lacking time in the city. Head to the roof of the Sofitel for cocktails and brilliant sunset views across the lake and city.

reviews.author: _rg_palmer
reviews.title: A quiet spot.
reviews.content: A walk during the day is a blissful spot away from the honking cars and motor scooters. A night it is where locals and visitors enjoy food and activities.

reviews.author: Phillip O
reviews.title: A great place to walk, day and night, with not traffic to hear music and people watch.
reviews.content: It is a great place to get away from the busy traffic and see where to locals and their families and dates go to get a little exercise and entertainment.  The block of traffic so you can stroll in the middle of the street with no worries.  I heard several street music performances with a city block.  Very nice place to visit for free.

reviews.author: julierayhancock
reviews.title: great for people watching
reviews.content: this was a nice spot to sit and people watch - we grabbed some street food and sat on a bench and watched every ne goin about their day.....

reviews.author: teacherpaja
reviews.title: Beautiful place worth of visiting
reviews.content: Nice walk around the lake, but don't expect anything extraordinary. :-) Hovewer there are lots of nice cafés near the lake, try them. Pěkná procházka okolo jezera, ale nečekejte nic výjimečného. :-) Ale kolem jezera se nachází spousta pěkných kaváren, určitě stojí za to vyzkoušet.

reviews.author: Marcus Vinicius P
reviews.title: its ok
reviews.content: it is just aplace that you can go and take pictures and see the night life, but nothing so diferent.

reviews.author: jeff1955malaysia
reviews.title: 2 small lakes with a thru way
reviews.content: it is located after the ho chi minh mosuleum. there are 2 lakes on either side. it is shaddy and alot greenery. nothing much to see but to admire the lakes and its beauty.

reviews.author: VinceBocquet
reviews.title: Wonderful view!
reviews.content: Quiet and peaceful area with a lot of good restaurants and bars with lake view. Hotels are nice in this area too. Less crowdy than the old quarter. Good soul.

reviews.author: JB0642015
reviews.title: Quiet and pretty!
reviews.content: We stayed one night at the Hotel Intercontinental West Lake. It was such a change from the hustle and bustle of the Old Quarter. It was peaceful, tranquil and left me with a different impression of Hanoi.

reviews.author: j0hnniem64
reviews.title: Great setting for a walk....
reviews.content: A nice setting for that early morning walk, or why not grab a gelati from across the road while enjoying a sunset stoll.!

reviews.author: MilkChocChip
reviews.title: Should be renamed "Dead Fish Lake".
reviews.content: The first thing that hits you is the smell of dead fish. You then see the amount of dead fish everywhere and they are dying in shoals, it's odd. Then there are the hawkers selling you turtles to "throw" into the lake for good luck. It's all a bit sad really. We took the electric golf buggy looking vehicles on a 1 hour trip but really it only last 40 minutes. This was also odd as we dropped locals off at the water park en route. This cost 2 of us 330k VND which isn't much but i'm wondering if the locals paid this or anything at all as they seemed to just get on - perhaps an unspoken agreement?Overall, only visit the Dead Fish Lake if you like to see an abundance of dead fish and enjoy the delightful smells that accompany this too.

reviews.author: Candace
reviews.title: Peaceful and tranquil
reviews.content: Nearby our hotel and we passed by the lake each time we go out. Quiet and peaceful, nice for a romantic evening stroll.

reviews.author: Wilson S
reviews.title: Beautiful views, dirty lake.
reviews.content: Great lake to spend an afternoon walking around. Unfortunitaly it is quite polluted as is evident by the hundreds of floating dead fish. Nice sunsets and cafes in the surrounding area. Good place to read and relax.

reviews.author: Mauna D
reviews.title: Another amazing lake!
reviews.content: This lake is much bigger than expected and very well used by the locals for walking, running and biking.....early in the morning lots of exercising by not only the locals but expats. It is between 5 and 8km all round, depending on whose story you believe! Also beautiful by night with coffee shops everywhere....sit on a rooftop with your friends and enjoy, not only coffee, but chatting in a cool environment.....must do and I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lara B
reviews.title: Big lake
reviews.content: Relaxing place, far from the noise of the city. The best way to see all the lake is by motorbike. If you have time, there is a nice water park too.

reviews.author: mfres0n
reviews.title: Great suburb but not especially touristy
reviews.content: Great area if you're staying there but not somewhere to go specifically. It's a suburb, an area and has no major attractions apart from the lake. If you do find yourself there, there are some superb restaurants...Lebanese, Indian and Mexican for example. It's hasn't got quite the same feel as the Old Quarter, it's far more residential, and a firm favourite with expats.

reviews.author: Shane C
reviews.title: What a large lake
reviews.content: We did a motorbike tour around Hanoi, we circled the lake (which does take some time).  On the lake is a temple and a pagoda which are worth visiting.

reviews.author: AussieAnniversary
reviews.title: Peaceful and relaxing
reviews.content: Very nice place to take an hour away from the hustle and bustle of Hanoi. We saw some old fisherman trying their luck but it was the serenity that was precious

reviews.author: Ji10101
reviews.title: just passed by. but it looked awesome
reviews.content: just passed by. but it looked awesomewhen I was joining the bike tour, I happened to pass by hereit looked pancy area. beautiful resorts and cafes were there.good to see

reviews.author: Nas S
reviews.title: Relax Atmosphere
reviews.content: This was probably the only place where it was relaxing and quiet from the city's noise. Enjoyable restaurants too.

reviews.author: Mark M
reviews.title: Definitely worth walking around a bit.
reviews.content: Beautiful West Lake - there is a temple at the top of the lake that is also worth seeing. Get your cyclo to drop you off and just walk around the lake.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Very good palce
reviews.content: The view is perfect . This area very nice , all of people stay here so friendly and helpful .I love this place and will come back

reviews.author: Richard D
reviews.title: My hometown
reviews.content: West Lake (Ho Tay) - Tay Ho... etc Is where all or most expats live including myself. Its a nice large lake, can stink of dead fish sometimes but at least you will find some trendy places to drink around it. Better access with your own motorbike, or go biking around it. Feel free to ask me anything about this location if you need help.

reviews.author: sorbomanabroad
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: Lovely stroll around the lake or just sip on a lime juice and watch the most interesting world go by. You can see the local people enjoying a tranquil time in their city. Touts abound but most do not accept a "no thank you".

reviews.author: Richard E
reviews.title: beautiful,
reviews.content: peaceful, and very nice to walk around at night time, very relaxing especially with all of the traffic.

reviews.author: beebaybay
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: If you visit Hanoi, you must see the West Lake. This is quite a large lake. One side is larger than the other as lake is on both sides of the road. There are great views across the lake and you can see how Hanoi is developing with larger buildings and establishments appearing around the edge.

reviews.author: JohnFoster68
reviews.title: Beautiful lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: Great Lake to do kayaking in the summer. Stay at a hotel around the lake and make sure they have a rooftop from where you can simply admire the beauty of the lake

reviews.author: Takahiro Y
reviews.title: Relatively calm place in Hanoi
reviews.content: There are many good cafes, restaurants, etc. nearby west lake. These are all good place to relax for those who are tired with noisy life in city center.

reviews.author: RodGowrieSmith
reviews.title: Open space - great to cycle around
reviews.content: I live on west lake and it provides a nice open space to escape the city's crazy traffic. Cycle around west lake on a regular basis - worth doing if you can get your hand's on a bicycle.

reviews.author: Karl L
reviews.title: Such a gorgeous walk
reviews.content: Definitely a must do if you are in the West Lake area.   Gives you a great perspective of the city.  And loads of cool bars and funky shops.

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Beautiful morning run
reviews.content: Smashed out a quick 5km run around part of the lake. Absolutely gorgeous. Such a tranquil way to start the day! Lovely to watch the fisherman starting their day and life in this sleepy and quiet part of the lake start to wake up!

reviews.author: Deetraveladdict
reviews.title: Great place for sunset
reviews.content: If you have such a long day visiting busy Hanoi, this is a very good choice to spend your sunset moment and if you have a motor bike, take a round of the lake to see how people live, fishing, having coffee or even meal in front of the lake

reviews.author: amadeus11190382
reviews.title: Do it in an electric buggy!
reviews.content: A bit more upmarket than Lake Hoan Kiem ,more affluent expat area with international hotels and nice housing surrounding lake . Take a buggy as it is a big walk! If you have been  to uncle Ho house the start of the lake is only a few minutes away.

reviews.author: Michelle G
reviews.title: Enjoy the Hanoi life with a great view
reviews.content: Are you visiting Hanoi, you must see the West Lake. A great way to observe life in the capital of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Gary F
reviews.title: Worth a look
reviews.content: We were staying in the old quarter of Hanoi so a visit to the West lake seemed very peaceful and serene. There are great views across the lake and you can see how Hanoi is developing with larger buildings and establishments appearing around the edge. Makes a great panorama shot on your camera. Yes - if you look closely the lake is not as pure as we would like but look past this and see the positives.

reviews.author: Ondertoon
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: We did a boardwalk at south side of the lake. Nothing spectacular. There was the temple on the south side which we could not visite because we were according to the guard at the entrance not dressed appropriate (uncovered shoulders).beware of the taxis in front of the entrance; they have crooked meters. We had to pay 5x more than on the way in and became very agressive when questions were asked.

reviews.author: Aruna Gunawardena
reviews.title: Dead Fish lake
reviews.content: Nothing spectacular. I did all my morning walks from Sedona Suites. All I saw was dead fish in the morning. I also saw Vietnamese swim & bath. The water is so poluted

reviews.author: RonandJean-IrvineCA
reviews.title: A look at the Lake
reviews.content: We went here in search of a particular restaurant that we never found, however it was a nice respite from the business of the City Center. A bit of a mixture of older, newer residential neighborhoods and some older hotels, it looks like a district that is in transition.

reviews.author: tubefeed
reviews.title: Unremarkable lake, don't rush to fit into your itinerary
reviews.content: It was steaming hot when we went to West Lake so perhaps that influenced us.There was an old lady selling turtles to return to the lake 'for good luck' out the front which horrified us somewhat. Poor turtles.Looking into the water of the lake revealed rubbish and unclean looking water.We visited the pagoda by the lake, then went to a nearby coffee shop to cool down.We hailed a taxi to return to the old quarter. Turns out the taxi had a very fast running meter...we were so ripped-off but what can you do? Beware!

reviews.author: Linda L
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL SERENE LOCATION
reviews.content: Take time to visit West Lake. I was staying in Old Quarter and booked a taxi for the lake and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. We drove around the perimeter of the lake and it was so peaceful. People having morning coffee local men fishing, and great vantage points for photos.

reviews.author: Gary H
reviews.title: Good for a walk and immerse in Hanoi daily life
reviews.content: If you have a spare hour or so take a walk around westlake and Truc Bach lakes, littered with an eclectic mix of hotels, restaurants both Western and Vietnamese ,and local residencesThere is always something new and memorable to see. highly recommended

reviews.author: wgavey
reviews.title: Stayed here as found Hanoi city too busy. Great area to stay,
reviews.content: Loved it here as there are lots of English speaking people who work here and visit the local pubs and restaurants.Great party place here and nice restaurants with good food.

reviews.author: jennifer G
reviews.title: A lovely walk
reviews.content: Our hotel overlooked this lovely waterway, so we awoke every morning to a beautiful view. The roadway past the pagoda was always filled with varying forms of traffic( buses, cars, cyclists, taxis, bikes etc) The fishermen on the bridge are entertaining to watch, jagging  their catch. At the lovely pagoda, the vendors selling turtles or goldfish so u can throw them into the lake for good luck. Loved the stroll across to the botanical gardens. From the top floor of our hotel, we had a spectacular view of the lights and activity at night.

reviews.author: Ed D
reviews.title: Neat place to walk around
reviews.content: Bit of a hike from the old quarter, but it is worth seeing this part of Hanoi. Also there is a dynamite Italian restaurant on this eat r. Cannot remember the name but great food and great prices.

reviews.author: Divya P
reviews.title: Great views!
reviews.content: It's a nice place to walk around, nice views and very peaceful. Be sure to visit the pagoda nearby, was peaceful and a real temple (not a temple museum, did not require entrance fee), so you could see the authentic Temples and people praying. Also drink coffee from cong caphe which is just a short walk from west lake!

reviews.author: kcslkcsl
reviews.title: A Large lake
reviews.content: I came only because it was walking distance from my hotel. My Vietnamese colleague said 1 round is 12km. Did not want to run (as the air is a bit polluted otherwise it would have been nice lake side run). Around parts of the lake there are bars and eateries. You'll see some couples hanging out together too :)

reviews.author: MiaLeeD
reviews.title: The modern West Lake
reviews.content: After many trips to Hanoi, this was my first trip to the West Lake. We did nothing more than ride around the lake and stop for a cool drink, but it was nice to see the architecture and people exercising and enjoying the great outdoors.

reviews.author: francessanpaolo
reviews.title: Bike around
reviews.content: Rented bikes for my entire stay. This is a great bike route with lots of little interesting places to stop and have a beer or a coconut drink.

reviews.author: inabanana
reviews.title: Home to most foreigners
reviews.content: Basically, I lived here during my long stay in Hanoi.The area is a mixture of corporate and residential, and the west lake seems like the place where most foreigners are at. At night, you can sit by the lake over some beer, and in the morning, you'll see a lot of fishermen around.

reviews.author: kristiekeever2
reviews.title: Grab a seat and enjoy the view!
reviews.content: Students approach English speaking tourists here each night to practice their English.  This was a highlight for us. We got to help students and learn more about their culture.  It's amazing what you learn from 20 year olds compared to reading the Lonely Planet!

reviews.author: Lee P
reviews.title: Walk around the lake is very interesting.
reviews.content: As you walk around the lake you can stop and eat or drink every few steps. The houses range from very basic to millionaire mansions each with its own unique architecture.

reviews.author: Deb W
reviews.title: Nice area
reviews.content: A lot of locals and tourists enjoy this lake. There is another lake across the street that is the site where John McCain was captured.

reviews.author: Kevin_One_Man_Show
reviews.title: really enjoyed this attraction
reviews.content: My daughter and I used to walk along the shore on our holiday here  - great views, relaing and also nice to stop into some of the cafes for a coffee and treat!

reviews.author: Brenda C
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.content: The location of this hotel is fantastic.  Beautiful setting on a lake and about 15 minutes from the old quarter.  We were club status and enjoyed the privileges that go with it, enjoying breakfast, afternoon tea and cocktails and canapés in the evening.  The pool area was small but looked very inviting with sun beds and day beds round the area.  The rooms were spacious with a good housekeeping team attending them.  Management was very visible ensuring your stay was pleasant.  Club staff very nice and attentive although service was a little slow at times.  Sunset bar is located in the middle of the lake rooms were we enjoyed some nice food and drinks.  All in all a very pleasant stay.  The club reception staff were very attentive and efficient.  Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Kakatina
reviews.title: not big, not clean
reviews.content: the name is as same as the west lake in China, but totally different view. it is just a small like in Hanoi, with buildings around.

reviews.author: KhongLoon
reviews.title: Ideal Spot for Morning Workout
reviews.content: You could have 2 lake here, it was ideal for morning run or walk. The smaller lake will be about 2.1KM per loop whereas if you have plenty of time you could do the big lake loop which is 21KM :)

reviews.author: james p
reviews.title: the water is clean enough to drink
reviews.content: Great place to swim, you can drink the water, its taste awesome.  Go fishing here also, eat the fish raw sashimi style.  I hear there is a submarine tour and dolphins.

reviews.author: Mr_Luong88
reviews.title: Gorgeous Lake
reviews.content: Hanoi is a city with a lot of lakes but West Lake is the biggest and most beautiful.  Most tourists don't visit West Lake because it's far from the touristy district of the Old Quarter but it's definitely worth a visit and is best seen from a motorbike, in my opinion.

reviews.author: WispyRobin
reviews.title: The hippest area in Hanoi
reviews.content: This area surrounding the lake is considered the trendiest part of the city to hang out in. The best way to experience it is via electric golf cart which you can hire for about $4 pp outside the pagoda for an hour ride around the lake. We took a few beers with us and sat back and just enjoyed the scenery. There loads of restaurants and pubs and shops as well as an amusement park. At night, the area is packed with young people enjoying a meal, drinks and strolling around, listening to music. It's great here!

reviews.author: zoevu81
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: One of biggest lake at Hanoi. We enjoyed sightseeing and banh tom at West Lake. We traveled cross the Lake

reviews.author: TheShis
reviews.title: A regular lake.
reviews.content: At the end of the day, this is just a big lake with murky water.It's not that impressive and during our visit, the was heavy haze all over the water.Still, worth a visit if only to visit the nearby shrines.

reviews.author: Robert K
reviews.title: Alright Walk by the Lake
reviews.content: We walked out to the West Lake and by the pagoda. The lake was alright but appeared to be quite dirty. There wasn't a ton of stuff to see out there. The lake is much larger than the one near the Old/French quarters but not as nice. If you're looking to kill some time then it might be worth walking around but I wouldn't put it at the top of my list for Hanoi.

reviews.author: ganmeister
reviews.title: Nice lake north of Hanoi
reviews.content: We stayed at Sheraton and hence had a good view of this lake. There is a nice serene feel and nice lights at night. There are plenty of shops and food outlets around here. Kim Lien Pagoda also is in close proximity. There are 2 hotels, Sheraton and Intercontinental here.

reviews.author: Janet S
reviews.title: One hour walk and visit to the temple
reviews.content: We walked around the lake and took in the sights. Saw some fishermen fishing with small nets fishing. Stopped for a beer, and had a look at the tall temple.

reviews.author: Franklyn E
reviews.title: Great area to be in
reviews.content: This is an OK area to stay in. I stayed at the Soiftel Plaza Hotel and it is in walking distance to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. Some great coffee shops are around as well as some boats on the lake serving drinks and food in the evenings.If you use Uber you are only a $2US ride from the old quarters. So all in all a great location.

reviews.author: trupianodausa
reviews.title: Great lake in the town!
reviews.content: It is very good for doing exercise by food or bicycle in the morning and afternoon or late evening around the lake. You als do Kayaking or fishing there!

reviews.author: ComplicatedDisaster
reviews.title: Really Big Lake
reviews.content: It's just a lake.  A really big lake.  But it has a car free path round the outside that is ideal for a morning run.  It's got to be a good 20km round so you'll probably not want to do more than one lap!!  There's at least one small beach where some of the locals go for a swim.  Around the Sheraton there are a number of bars and restaurants but the area is generally very quiet.

reviews.author: euralla1
reviews.title: Careful of the pickpockets
reviews.content: Pretty average and a bit smelly.  Had my mobile phone pinched by a slick pair of women seeking money for an unmarried mother. Good move you conned us.

reviews.author: Rigoberto S
reviews.title: Excellent area for a walk
reviews.content: Beautiful area to spent walking around the area of the lake and visit the near by temple and cafes that are around the lake area.

reviews.author: Hyppe
reviews.title: Quiet lake
reviews.content: I stayed in a hotel and my room is actually in the lake. Very quiet and tranquil place. Every morning, there are fisher man on the river catching fish.

reviews.author: Shivan9
reviews.title: WATCH THE SUNSET FROM THIS LAKE
reviews.content: Hanoi’s largest freshwater lake, West Lake has a circumference of 17km and houses many of the city’s historic places of interest around its perimeter – including Vietnam’s oldest pagoda and one of Vietnam’s four sacred temples.The lake attracts many locals and tourists seeking respite from the busy city, providing a sanctuary of great natural beauty with plenty of quiet spots in the sizeable lush gardens surrounding the lake.West Lake is a beautiful place to while away an afternoon, there are boats for hire and lunch on a floating restaurant makes a novel dining option. Notable points of interest at West Lake include Tran Quoc Pagoda which was built in the 6th century making it Vietnam’s oldest temple.Tran Quoc Pagoda resides on a small island built by King Ly Nam De as a cultural symbol of Vietnamese Buddhism. The pagoda is particularly stunning when viewed early evening at sunset. The other main attraction is Quan Thanh Temple located at the West Lake crossroads of Thanh Nien Street and Quan Thanh Street. One of Vietnam’s ancient Four Sacred Temples built during the reign of King Ly Thai To from 1010 to 1028; the temple features detailed wood carvings of sacred animals, trees and flowers in its structure. Quan Thanh Temple is open for all to enter with sightseers encouraged to pray for health, luck and happiness during their visit.The lake used to be part of the Red River when it was a retreat reserved for the relaxation of mandarins and kings, today the lake offers so much to enjoy with a unique fusion of nature at her best and some of the most historic cultural sights in the whole of Vietnam.

reviews.author: 365Weathers
reviews.title: Serine beauty in the center of Hanoi
reviews.content: Every morning you'll find the citizens of Hanoi exercising around  the lake that's found in the center of this old and vibrant city. Beautiful lake, historic buildings and many a restaurant you may lazy in and take in the many passing views. Adjacent to the old quarter and the water puppets theatre.   Surrounded by trees and plenty of seats on which to take a rest as you circumnavigate its surrounds.

reviews.author: Jonny M
reviews.title: Nice lake to run around but pretty damn dirty
reviews.content: Ran around this lake, its around 16ks I believe. Nice in the early mornings or evening when everybody is out riding bikes and walking. A few cool cafe's around too and places to rent boats etc. Saw some locals swimming in there too which is a recipe for sore guts and sickness, but hey, it's not me. Fair bit of trash and suspect looking pipes draining into it and local ladies gathering snails, shellfish, eels and fish anyway so double check your Bun Oc next time...might be from the lake??? Definitely take time out to explore it however

reviews.author: Incense Travel
reviews.title: Best to visit at sunset
reviews.content: Hanoi is actually very green with lots of lakes, ponds, parks and treeline streets. This West lake is the biggest lake in Hanoi. It is too big that you can hardly walk around it. There are golf buggies that take you for a tour around this lake. Best to visit this lake at sunset. There is a nice road running along the lake and it's perfectly suitable for a moped/cycling trip. In the summer you will see lots of lotus flowers too.

reviews.author: pemblin
reviews.title: GREAT WALK
reviews.content: a great place to walk  because its generally a little cooler than most of Hanoi, you get to see locaLS IN ACTION AND SOME QUIRKY ARCHITECTURE.

reviews.author: Maria T
reviews.title: Ok by day, beautiful by night
reviews.content: First time I saw this lake, it was during daytime, and I thought that it looked just like any lake really. It was pretty enough and I took a couple of photos. I came back at night and it was really beautiful. It is very lively and a lot of people come there. Pretty with the lights and people.

reviews.author: deejay90210
reviews.title: Nothing but a lake
reviews.content: Its just a lake with good views and several restaurants lining it. It gets more lively in the evenings. Good for a few hours in the evenings

reviews.author: Stephen M
reviews.title: It's a lake...
reviews.content: Not much to see or do here and I am not sure why it features on any tours. There is a pagoda to visit on the lake but that is it...

reviews.author: lhenonil
reviews.title: Clean lake with joggers and biking lane
reviews.content: Walking, running and biking around the lake while watching the sun rise and sun set is the time to stay in this lake

reviews.author: ArushaMama
reviews.title: it's only a lake
reviews.content: around the lake is a view onto the life of the hanoians.  but that is about it.  interesting activity around the lake in the early morning

reviews.author: Jeffyyc
reviews.title: Serenity within the buzzing city center
reviews.content: Wonderful scenery, especially during the evening sunset.  Too bad when i was there are just too much construction going on nearby.  Once these are completed, I'm sure this lake will have back its aura.  Did a morning jog with nice people around greeting one another.

reviews.author: Gisella F
reviews.title: Beautiful attractions around this lake.
reviews.content: I went all the way around this lake by motorbike, stopping off and so many beautiful temples and streets to see.

reviews.author: Daniel_lawgg
reviews.title: Nothing much to see here actually
reviews.content: We walked for almost 30 minutes from the old quarter to the West lake. Nothing much to see or do here but you have to be here at least once.

reviews.author: scarps
reviews.title: If you have time It's worth a visit
reviews.content: We walked around part if it from our hotel and it was time nicely spent to see some areas outside of the old quarter.  We also walked from there to the Ho Chi Min area. If you're only here for a short time, then maybe not.

reviews.author: Sheena S
reviews.title: Just okaya
reviews.content: Lake is cute at sunset, and maybe you can jog or stroll or bike around. But if you just want to see the pagoda on the lake, you will be disappointed.

reviews.author: chicagobizjetpilot
reviews.title: Lots of bars and places to eat
reviews.content: Around the lake are many bars and places to eat. Also good for the walk or jog. Close to some of the hotels too.

reviews.author: Tiia
reviews.title: Beautiful lake!
reviews.content: Westlake is very big lake in the heart of Hanoi. It's not so far from Old Quarter and it is perfect place for calm down. There are many cafe's and restaurants. Also many foreigners choose to live in the Westlake area.

reviews.author: Maree K
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.content: This is a very beautiful and popular place for locals as well as tourist as it has many walking paths around the lake with different activities going on around the place.

reviews.author: daveyboy544
reviews.title: On the right day - wow!
reviews.content: This beautiful body of water is sensational to sit by and drink a beer or coffee providing the weather is good.

reviews.author: jin_mumbai
reviews.title: super place for an evening stroll
reviews.content: This place is where all the action is in the evening. Take a beautiful stroll around the lake in the evening. It is lot up and looks beautiful. Cafes by the lake are also worth a try

reviews.author: YankBritKiwi
reviews.title: Lovely for a walk, not so peaceful
reviews.content: West Lake is a big lake and the view can be lovely (on days when the pollution is low). You will likely see men fishing off long boats or off the walking path. Depending on what part of the lake you're on, you will see some restaurants and cafes, big houses or, if you are in Ba Dinh, you will pass Chu Văn An High School, an enormous and utterly beautiful set of French colonial buildings. The constant moped traffic makes this place less than peaceful but it's still a beautiful place to walk or bike.

reviews.author: Eung Myoung K
reviews.title: Exercise
reviews.content: Walked walked around the lake takes the weekend. There are so many things to see around the middle, and a really big lake. Fishing people here, to tour the surrounding expanse

reviews.author: Kathy05852
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Take a sroll along the lake although it is very noisy with all the horns I still felt very relaxing walking around sittng to watch the fishermen catching fish and the ladies that ride past delivering flowers their bike chocked full of fresh flower

reviews.author: Jennifer T
reviews.title: Relaxing place
reviews.content: It wasn't so far from my hotel to went there. We had a great time to chill out with some local friends there with beer, sea food, bar and nice view. Really relax on the business trip.

reviews.author: BijanTehran_Iran
reviews.title: No for tourists
reviews.content: It just a lake with some restaurants around, not popular with locals,I write this to highly advise to go for the smaller lake:Ho Hoan Kiem (Hoan Kiem Lake) sits in the middle of Hanoi’s Old Quarter,which is vey alive at night with locals and tourists.

reviews.author: Voyager2
reviews.title: Could do with a clean up
reviews.content: Really large lake right in the city with easy access and quite a few things to visit as you walk around the most accessible part. Can take pedalo out if you want which is pretty popular.Couple of things which spoil it. Traffic throws out lots pollution and after a good walk by the lake you certainly know the traffic is there. Secondly, there is plenty of rubbish at the shore line and needs attention.

reviews.author: AlHarvey4
reviews.title: Not really worth the walk
reviews.content: I decided to walk to the lake after already walking for a few hours around the city and to be honest I was a little disappointed

reviews.author: roskii
reviews.title: Pleasant Lake
reviews.content: Incredibly large lake just a short walk north of the Old Quarter. Seems to be less busy than the smaller but more popular Ho Kiem Lake. Weather was incredibly overcast when I visited but the walkways were clean and well keep. Even if you do not have time to do the full loop, walk on the southern portion to get a taste of what it has to offer.

reviews.author: anjinsan
reviews.title: A Pleasant Walk around the Lake
reviews.content: We walked around portions of the lake on several occasions, and it was a pleasant walk, but we recommend you spend the time just exploring all the back streets of Old Hanoi which border the lake.  You can cross the beautiful red bridge to the island for a small fee, and the temple is interesting but not unique.  But the bustling life and vitality of the streets was were the action was

reviews.author: Jenny S
reviews.title: West Lake by electric car
reviews.content: I had not been overly impressed with Hanoi as my first 2 days were rainy and dull so as soon as the sun came out, I headed for the lakes. It's amazing how everything looks different on a sunny day and this lake was no exception. I happened to arrive at the start of the electric car which is a recent addition to this part of town, tho it has been running for a long time around the other lake closer to the Old Quarter. I jumped on one which took me the 18 kms around the lake, thru the more expensive areas of Hanoi, where the French influence was obvious. It was relaxing, interesting and a great way to see other parts of Hanoi. One of the highlights of my trip here.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.title: Loved this lake
reviews.content: I loved this lake.  Going in the morning and night are very different.  Both give you a different perspective of the lake and what's open

reviews.author: SOH KIEN PENG
reviews.title: Serene and calm
reviews.content: I stayed at the bustling Old Quarters of Hanoi, strolled my way to this part of the city and found peace and tranquility in the calmness of this lake, `Far from the Madding Crowd'.I had been to the West Lake in Hangzhou (China) and it is reputedly a great lake of literary appreciation. Many poets draw great inspiration from the sight of it to compose beautiful phrases of poems. Like her counterpart in Hangzhou, this lake is equally calm, serene and foggy. But I think it lacks the hilly landscape or mountains in her setting that could make her stand out from the stagnant background. The Lake water is just a plain stretch and expanse of fresh water.  The color of the water was stagnantly dull. Compared to the azure blue or lush green of the Sun Moon Lake in Taiwan, this lake water is just too plain to attract any attention. However, the pagodas and the rows of willow trees that dotted around her outline in particularly the Tran Quoc Pagoda enhanced her outlook and portray her out sharply just like a dotted piece of cherry decorated on a plain piece of cake enhanced her flavor and profile. Strikingly outstanding, the ancient pagoda casts a mesmerizing Zen appeal to the misty and quiet lake. Strolling around the lake invoke a meditative state of the mind. I like the serenity, the calmness of this lake.

reviews.author: fareastjim
reviews.title: Peaceful part of the city
reviews.content: We stayed at the Sheraton and in the evenings liked to eat in the restaurants surrounding the lake or take a drink in the bars. The views are beautiful and it is much quieter than the hustle and bustle of the old quarter which isn't far away.

reviews.author: jane53England
reviews.title: Lake
reviews.content: Walked the circumference with a guide, nothing very interesting except the spot where John McCarthy was shot down.

reviews.author: michael p
reviews.title: An enjoyable walk.
reviews.content: The streets around West Lake abound with all kinds of interesting stores, street vendors, restaurants and bars. It will give you a good idea of how the people of Hanoi live and work, all with a beautiful lake in the background.

reviews.author: Colin_B58
reviews.title: Sheraton Close by
reviews.content: We stayed at the Sheraton which overlooks the lake, while we were in Hanoi the weather was dull and wet, so didn;t do the lake full justice. There were canoeists out each morning on the lake. There are numerouse bars and restaurants along the north and west of the lake and a promanade on the north bank.

reviews.author: GallenTan
reviews.title: Iconic Lake
reviews.content: We went there on a late afternoon two days ago and it was too foggy to have a good view of the lake.However we went to visit the pagoda and temple beside the lake.Boats are available for rent to explore the lake but we did not go for that since it's too foggy to enjoy.Dining options around the lake seems limited. We went to Highlands Coffee and apparently it only serves beverages and cakes and such.

reviews.author: McTrix
reviews.title: Stay in this section of town
reviews.content: We stayed most of the day in this area of town. I wish I had been better informed about West Lake, prior to making all my arrangements in Hanoi, because I would have much preferred to be in this section of town, to escape the constant hustle and bustle of the Old Quarter. Also, there are some of the best restaurants in the city are close.

reviews.author: LucaCampana
reviews.title: It's nice to stay on the lake, but it's no tourist attraction.
reviews.content: We're staying on Westlake and it's nice to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city to end each day.  But I'm not sure I'd make a special trip to come an have a look at it.  The lake in the old quarter is much better from a tourist perspective, however I would say it is nice to be so close to the water to relax every afternoon.  We're actually staying over the lake at the InterContinental Westlake which is good.  It's been enjoyable to watch a guy every afternoon fish illegally hiding under our villa and the ones opposite.  One net and about 45 minutes work he hauled in 60 good size fish.  My kids and I counted them as he brought them in - great catch!

reviews.author: pagoda2014
reviews.title: Another breathing space in the city
reviews.content: Although pollution is now matching Beijing, take a stroll around the West Lake. The newly made walkway takes you all round the lake, and there are plenty of eating and drinking corners, worth exploring. Friday/Saturday nights many small restaurants open their doors and you may eat out on the street, for authenticity.

reviews.author: ZKiana
reviews.title: beautiful!!
reviews.content: it was so peaceful and relaxing to sit and have a coffee on the river!!! so nice to walk along too. good job Hanoi

reviews.author: EllaYaldwyn
reviews.title: Good photo opps and quite nice
reviews.content: We'd found mixed reviews on the West Lake but decided to check it out anyway. Had a few good photo opportunities and we managed to flag down a mini electric car and offered them 200,000 to take us both around the lake (took about an hour) which was a great way to not only see the lake but the surrounding areas too. It is what it is, a lake, and is a little smelly in parts, but we rate it!

reviews.author: dorjetravel
reviews.title: Coffee and fresh beer besides the lake
reviews.content: A nice space where people come to relax and often cycle around. Hanoi Bicycle Collective is on the lake and have great service.Good to sit and drink coffee and later Bia Hoi (fresh draft beer) which is very cheap

reviews.author: oziken
reviews.title: Well worth a quick look
reviews.content: Allow a minimum time to see this place - it is very interesting. We made our arrangements with Hanoi Transfer Service on our private one day tour.

reviews.author: onlysixthirty
reviews.title: Huge lake north of the Old Quarter
reviews.content: I didn't traverse the entirety of West Lake (Tay Ho), but I did check out the smaller Truc Bac area and then walked north along the lake from there at night. It was lovely.

reviews.author: Annmarie B
reviews.title: A lake!
reviews.content: Our hotel overlooked the lake, lovely to walk around and a good selection of bars and restaurants overlooking it, great to sit and watch the world going by.

reviews.author: Jean M
reviews.title: Away from the crowds
reviews.content: A half hour walk from the Old Quarter gets you to a peaceful area with floating restaurants, a gorgeous pagoda, and lovely gardens.

reviews.author: Kim D
reviews.title: Large area in the middle if a major city.
reviews.content: We visited the West Lake on a couple of occasions and enjoyed our time visiting coffee shops, restaurants and pagodas. This is a well used area that is very popular and well maintained. It is out of the price range of the average locals to live at but that doesn't stop them enjoying it. Some amazing and large hotels surround it.

reviews.author: Bill P
reviews.title: Cycle Round Trip
reviews.content: Hiring bikes and cycling around 'the big lake' in Hanoi was one of the best things we did. Large parts of the ride do not involve engaging the Hanoi traffic which was reassuring. Mostly narrow paths and back streets that hug the waters edge make for a nice cycle, while the numerous restaurants and cafes provide plenty of refreshment stops along the way.You get to see the districts of Tay Ho and Truc Bach, which are very nice.

reviews.author: Adele
reviews.title: More of an expat enclave than a tourist spot
reviews.content: I visit this area for work and I am not sure I would recommend it specifically as a tourist visit. The lake is massive but not especially photogenic. It is a popular area for ex pats to live but does not attract many day visitors.

reviews.author: Mark C
reviews.title: Nothing too special about the lake
reviews.content: It was also a monumental walk out here along busy roads from the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. The temple in the middle is nice, but recommend getting there via taxi.

reviews.author: Sophie H
reviews.title: If you've got the time walk it's perimeter!
reviews.content: It's around 16.5km and is a most of a day trip but you'll get to see the range of residences of the lake along with those who live off of it! Put on your walking shoes, although it's a flat walk all the way, the surface is uneven for most of it! There are plenty of places to stop for drinks and food. Don't miss the small and quiet cafe that serves the best coconut ice-cream ever!! Unsure of the exact location, but the sign shows pictures of ice-cream inside a coconut and your view directly across the lake is the Sheraton Hotel!

reviews.author: Jerry T
reviews.title: Inter-Continental West Lake
reviews.content: The rooms in this hotel were spectacular. Very spacious and unique in their in their layout. View of lake was great. The bar and restaurants in the hotel are excellent. The location of the hotel is great as it is in walking distance of many great restaurants and bars in the area.

reviews.author: hikkaduwa_10
reviews.title: the best place to live in Hanoi
reviews.content: the area is huge. Reach the part that is closer to Hoan Kiem by feet, enjoy the pagoda and the lake view and then go to another side of it, for example, Lac Long Quan street - there you will find a lot of beautiful temples, sculptures of dragons and a lot of cosy coffee shops down along the lake (streets Ve Ho and Nhat Chieu)

reviews.author: 선우2016
reviews.title: A peaceful walk in the early morning
reviews.content: I asked the receptionist for a quiet and peaceful place where I can have a nice walk in the morning and she recommended me this place. It's really beautiful and peaceful at 6:00AM when there's less motobikes running. There's actually 2 lakes in 2 sides of the street so the scenery was romantic. I also visited the pagoda located on the lake and found it beautiful as well.

reviews.author: garry468
reviews.title: large lake next to market
reviews.content: lake is ok..the market is great...dong market...get your camera out...if your squemish dont go as live animals and animals being killed and chopped up.....

reviews.author: susanb1944
reviews.title: Temple
reviews.content: A beautiful temple on the west lake, lots of vendors selling tortoises to the locals. Temple v popular with the locals, you can take boat trips on the lake.

reviews.author: EarlyRetirementAbroad
reviews.title: Garbage floating in the water
reviews.content: The West Lake looks nice from the distance, but has a lot of garbage floating in the water.  If this and the Truc Back Lakes can be cleaned, it would be a great area to walk around and relax near the water.

reviews.author: Richard K
reviews.title: Disappointing visit
reviews.content: Huge lake (with lots of dead fish in it - asphyxiated due to no oxygenating of the water - do not bother with the pedalos unless you are small - made for locals and if you have long legs then you cannot turn the pedals

reviews.author: whistlestop
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: We walked around the smaller lake Ho Truc Bach yesterday cutting in and out of the streets to look around.  It was so dirty, lots of dog mess and litter close to the lake, not helped by poor weather.  On good weather days this would be great for a nice long walk, nothing else.  We expected more of the Westlake area, apart from a few decent restaurants, and some tourist sights, it was nothing special.

reviews.author: Carla A
reviews.title: Beautiful large lake
reviews.content: This lake on the edge of the city is lovely and enjoyable to explore.  There are various hotels around the lake as well as restaurtants

reviews.author: Molly99London
reviews.title: This could be nice but....
reviews.content: The carpet of dead fish round the edges of the lake, with the associated smell puts you off a bit.  Hopefully this is a one off and not the normal state of affairs.

reviews.author: Andrew N
reviews.title: Big and Beautiful
reviews.content: The road around the perimeter of the lake is over 20 km.  Crushing this distance is something that may interest running buffs or cyclists (I was lazy and rode my motorcycle).It's a fine place to see the sunset.  Just park yourself at any one of the numerous park on the East side of the lake to get the best view.  You'll probably see local couples enjoying a romantic picnic or date, escaping the noise and traffic of Hanoi.

reviews.author: SagarVS
reviews.title: The biggest
reviews.content: This is the biggest lake in Hanoi with a 17 Km walk way around the lake. The lake is clean and well kept. There are several  temples, Pagodas, hotels and restaurants around the lake.

reviews.author: catherine p
reviews.title: romantic place and good for cycling
reviews.content: I did a cycling trip around the lake and I really enjoyed. the pagoda and temple in here also very nice

reviews.author: Lena T
reviews.title: Great place for strolling around
reviews.content: i came to West lake so many times, mostly with my buddies. we strolled around and watched so many people, like some women with their tiny stalls selling water and junk foods, a lot of couples, who choose this lake for their "romantic" date (they just sit on their motorbike, look at the big lake in frond of them and then talk, hug each other etc.), also some old men playing with their grandchildren.... try to taste "Bo Bia" if you visit this place, as well as "Banh Tom Ho Tay". i usually buy ice cream in a big and always crowded store on this lake (don't remember exactly the address), then promenade on the pavements shaded by trees. Personally i like this lake.

reviews.author: vidhusagar
reviews.title: Pretty lake for an idyllic walk
reviews.content: Nice serene lake but mostly crowded on holidays. Good walking and running paths. Well kept gardens around. Nothing spectacular though.

reviews.author: Banda-in-Japan
reviews.title: Great place to stroll and people watch
reviews.content: This lake was a perfect size to stroll around on sunset, enjoying the changing colors, looking at the architecture, and watching all the different people in the area.

reviews.author: annanL1330HW
reviews.title: Flower Valley in the West Lake Area, Hanoi
reviews.content: Flower Valley in the West Lake Area, Hanoi attracts hundreds of tourists to visit and taking photos at the weekend. I had a chance to visit there on Lunar New Year 2016. We such had a wonderful moments in Flower Valley. It's so beautiful place for visit. I suggest it's suitable for the wedding shoot ^_^

reviews.author: VamC
reviews.title: women
reviews.content: We visited the west lake which was lovely - but I noticed some local women in the bulrushes picking the water hyacinths it was very pretty their coloured conical straw hats bobbing in the background.

reviews.author: Ron G
reviews.title: TET celebration
reviews.content: We walked around the lake on the 14th of February!  Which was almost the last night of the TET celebration, it was beautiful and lots of people who had just married having pictures taken with the lake in the background.

reviews.author: chemicallust
reviews.title: Nice to see but nothing special
reviews.content: Nice to see but nothing special. Path around the lake is good for walking or running. There are restaurants on the lake if you want to enjoy the view.

reviews.author: scottyljd
reviews.title: It's just a lake in the suburbs
reviews.content: Our hotel was close to the lake and we could see it from our window, but I did not feel any compunction to see it close up. Maybe that was because the weather was cold.

reviews.author: Phương V
reviews.title: ...Back to childhood, awesome...
reviews.content: ...For the first time traveling to Hanoi......the most great feeling was when I and my friends drove by renting Motorbike around West Lake, about 20 km....How is it amazing!...fresh air...nice weather...no rain...not so hot...no traffic jam...just drove and enjoyed the view of long line trees along river bank....so cool...yes...really cool...just felt like some emotion reminded me about my childhood memories...peaceful place...cannot how to explain exactly...however..maybe i am Vietnamese so that was really different feeling when visited West Lake......on the way...we saw some old and nice pagodas...stopover at Nhat Tan Flower Garden..nice..just can see it on TV before ^^....restaurant with Lotus flower small lake below...some young people got hanging out with grilled corn...sit on the small mat on the river bank...drinking beer...like it...^^...we were not wrong when choosing West Lake for last minutes in Hanoi  on that trip...will be back...

reviews.author: TravelRuby
reviews.title: Nice view at night time
reviews.content: Suggest people visiting Hanoi must go to spend at least a night strolling along the West Lake. Night view is a lot better than during the day because of the lightings along the bridge, and also you can hardly see the dead fishes and rubbish in the water.Don't forget to try "Bo Bia" along the road if you are a sweet tooth, it's a traditional Viet snacks. Easy to recognise because they have white box with red letters writing as "Bo Bia" which costs 10k Dong for one.

reviews.author: Bill H
reviews.title: Freeing the goldfish
reviews.content: Every year on the 23rd day of December in the lunar calendar, many people go to West Lake to release three goldfish I the lake. Many people also pour the ashes from burning 'lucky money' into the lake at the same time. This event happens once a year only

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: Just a Big Lake
reviews.content: In my opinion, there's nothing exciting about this lake at all. It was pretty dirty with lots of rubbish floating about in it when I went, plus a man having a pee into it over the side, ha! It's got lots of swan boats that people take out over the summer months so maybe it's better tended then? It's also where John McCain landed. That's about all there is to say about it. The two temples near it are worth looking at though.

reviews.author: Tri-Jimmy
reviews.title: Our new home
reviews.content: A bit more relaxed than the city centre. Plenty of restaurants to choose from - western and local food. A bit of a journey from the city centre, better off getting a taxi.

reviews.author: Aussiejay78
reviews.title: Learn what pollution does to fish
reviews.content: From a distance, this lake is quite lovely to look at.  But, leave your visit at a distance.Once you get closer you will first smell the putrid water and then see the hundreds of dead fish floating on the surface.This is a heavily polluted lake. I can't imagine wanting to eat in the proximity of the lake, or even worse, going out on the water on one of the swans!It is actually embarrassing for Tripadvisor that this lake has the 4 rating it currently has. Clearly times have changed!

reviews.author: Josie W
reviews.title: Nice lake but too bad it's polluted
reviews.content: I went to westlake in Hanoi. Nice view. The roads are very close to the lake with very little space for park area. There are afew tress and benches as well as pretty flowers. I only give this a bare pass rating becuase I saw hundreds of dead fish. The lake must be polluted which is a shame.

reviews.author: Barbara K
reviews.title: Oasis in the middle of Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is a delightful surprise in the middle of Hanoi.  Go to the Sunset Bar at the Intercontinental Hotel and watch the sunset over the lake as the buildings of downtown illuminate for the night.

reviews.author: Italianshopper
reviews.title: On a clear day you can really see forever!
reviews.content: A beautiful setting.  Watch for the fishermen and locals along the sides. If time take a boat just to see the country.

reviews.author: Rory M
reviews.title: Far from Old Quarter
reviews.content: The West Lake is a large lake on the outskirts of Ha Noi. Surrounding the lake are some luxury hotels and restaurants as well as high rise apartment towers geared to the expat market. There are a couple of temples also located in the region. This lake is very far and an expensive taxi ride from the Old Quarter and the heart of HaNoi. The restaurants, while OK, are not worth the considerable trouble of getting out there. If you chose to stay at one of the hotels here, your only choice for getting to the Old Quarter is to take a taxi.

reviews.author: MLTnature
reviews.title: "The lung of Hanoi"
reviews.content: This is perhaps the largest lake in Hanoi.  Every early morning, if you walk around, you could see many people come here to exercise.  I came here to take picture and enjoyed every moment.

reviews.author: Fikoukla
reviews.title: Enjoyable for an easy cycle ride with stops
reviews.content: I cycled round the lake in a light drizzle and still enjoyed it. I took it easy (and it's all on the flat, so it is easy) with photo or drink stops and it took me just under 3 hours. I hired my bike from the Hanoi Bicycle Collective: 60,000 Dong for a sturdy city bike which was big enough for me (I'm 1m8 so it's often a problem when hiring in Asia). They had mountain and touring bike options too, more expensive and unnecessary to go round the lake. I noticed other bike hire places as I went round, so there might be somewhere nearer your hotel. Make sure to do it clockwise, so you're always on the lake side of the road. Most of the time you'll be on the quiet but we'll paved little lakeside road. A couple of times you are forced up onto the much busier ring road (the only time you have to put any effort in!) but it isn't for more than 5 minutes. There's the more famous pagoda down on the southern tip of the lake, but there are several other smaller quieter and in my view more charming ones as you go round.

reviews.author: Martin_Daly2014
reviews.title: Large and Peaceful
reviews.content: Quieter than Hoan Kiem lake, West Lake is much larger.  I have frequently used it for afternoon exercise.  Not "pretty", like Hoan Kiem, but there are some nice cafes on the bank as you walk around.

reviews.author: Namaste24
reviews.title: Great to walk around.
reviews.content: I walked around the whole lake on a chilly day and Im sure on a warm sunny day, the atmosphere must be nicer. There are some nice photo opportunities and if you can, bring a lunch and eat around there.

reviews.author: Pondele
reviews.title: Close to Everywhere
reviews.content: West Lake, Ha Noi area is long walkable to attractions such as Ho Chi Min tomb, the old quarter and the French quarter.

reviews.author: Willy0809
reviews.title: Evening Walk
reviews.content: The West Lake is a beautiful place to take a walk after an evening's dinner! It is scenic and beautiful. You can also visit any of the cafes along the lake and sees the world goes by. A great place for the family to bond and enjoy each other's company's!

reviews.author: AshishGuptasfo
reviews.title: Nice lake with a pagoda
reviews.content: This is the biggest lake in the city and where a lot ex-pats and well to do locals live.  There is a busy road all the way around the lake making it easy to get around and see everything.  There is a local ice-cream shop across the street from the entrance to the pagoda which has  delicious soft-serve ice-cream cones.

reviews.author: peterbB8221OX
reviews.title: Beautiful lake environment
reviews.content: I walkled by this lake on my first dayand was amazed at its beauty. Great view of the city and nice places to stop and enjoy coffee and meet friends or acquaintances

reviews.author: attyanne
reviews.title: Have a drink at Sunset Bar at the Intercontinental overlooking the lake
reviews.content: After all the hectic noise and traffic in Old Quarter, indulge yourself by heading over to West Lake, recline on the lounges, and watch the sunset over the lake and the City. It's a wonderful retreat when the noice gets overwhelming.

reviews.author: Peter G
reviews.title: A perfect break from the chaos
reviews.content: West Lake is the biggest lake in Hanoi, around 16kms+ all round with a well maintained road right on the side of it, all of the lake is accessible to the visitor, no houses on the actual lakeside. A handful of bars, restaurants and streetfood stalls can be found all around, and if you feel like paddle surfing you can do that, too! (bring your own tho, such a service is not yet offered unfortunately) :)

reviews.author: TT Yu
reviews.title: Just a lake in the city
reviews.content: I visited today. There was nothing special nor worth visiting. There is a Chinese style temple beside the lake. Just took some picture and left. Less than 20 minutes.

reviews.author: PJames73
reviews.title: Must see and feel its atmosphere
reviews.content: It is one must-see in Hanoi. Everytime I come here, I feel very comfortable and relaxed. In the summer, it is cool and will help you out from terrible hot weather in the center of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Elis_Howard
reviews.title: the lungs of Hanoi
reviews.content: It's a huge lake in the middle of Hanoi, a peaceful place with a few pagodas and temples scattered all around the lake.

reviews.author: Richard W
reviews.title: Smelly but interesting
reviews.content: Scruffy, urban and with a definite odour when we were there. Circular walk is interesting though for the experience and recommended if you happen to be in the area

reviews.author: caddyshak1
reviews.title: Largest Lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: we did an electric car trip around the lake which made it more enjoyable. the differences around the lake was amazing especially the socioeconomic difference. this really is a must see in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Marco R
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: Travelling with friends here in Jan 2016. This place were so nice, beautiful, refresh air... This season are cold at the afternoon, but it's good lake for visiting.Strong recommend to evryone come here for refresh a work hard !!!

reviews.author: Wynand B
reviews.title: A good lake to see day and night
reviews.content: Yip a good location to see locals and get great photos of Japanese bridge in the day and night time. It's a must do, safe to walk around it and a few places for drinks.

reviews.author: Jel86
reviews.title: Changed so much
reviews.content: It used to be very dirty and barely accessible, there is now a ring road around it and you can ride a bike or run. Some swim in it, but I would not recommend it.

reviews.author: Philip M
reviews.title: good for a walk
reviews.content: if you want a good walk then walking around this huge lake is a great option.  Its quite safe and there are plenty of seats to take a rest.

reviews.author: JTam2004
reviews.title: Nice Tranquil walk
reviews.content: It was  a nice evening walk around the lake. Lots of people, tourists and locals. Interesting to interact with locals and tourist alike. Relaxing

reviews.author: clame745
reviews.title: had apartment Pho Nhat Chien st. No 77 view of West lak
reviews.content: Great place to stay at the end of street a great fun park great Restaurants in the grounds can be found by giant wheel in this spot very popular heaps of taxi wait here buses etc off Duong Lac Long Quan

reviews.author: ExpatDaze
reviews.title: Great way to stroll and see locals - kill some time.
reviews.content: A great way to see the city, kill some time. Just stroll around the lake and you will see all kind of cool local things.

reviews.author: nicole t
reviews.title: Nice lake to walk, run or ride along
reviews.content: We took a motorised car along the lake and it was well worth the trip.Just over $20 AUS for an hour it was a nice relaxed ride around, and lots of small local coffee shops, bars and restaurants to stop at on the way.

reviews.author: seanworc
reviews.title: Lovely lake with plenty of activities
reviews.content: This is the largest lake in Ha Noi, in a part of the Hay To area that has a lot of lakeside restaurants and activities. The well known Don's Bistro Hay To overlooks the lake.  There are several hotels and beautiful villas.  IMO, not a top attraction in itself, but worth seeing if in the neighborhood. Went in March, 2013.

reviews.author: 2016BS
reviews.title: Beautiful Water Front
reviews.content: West Lake no doubt a bigger, better lake for trying water sports, boating, fishing, lazing around, walking and spending quieter moments. It is worth visiting and spending some quality time at West Lake

reviews.author: acpkl
reviews.title: A COOL TRIP
reviews.content: Nice lake , good pagoda inside with a compelling history .About a mythological turtle and a sword which helped the general win a war

reviews.author: fiorella_nguyen
reviews.title: Good view, old little boats
reviews.content: So my experience was good. The boat where we were at was super old and difficult to steer(what a leg workout! Which we actually didn't mind). The cost was 100K (for the whole day).Got wet while pedaling, still trying to figure out how...the lake is very dirty but if you go farther away from the restaurants and such then it gets betterIts a good little fun adventure so recommend going, also recommend to try and find a somewhat better looking boat

reviews.author: Sheila R
reviews.title: Peaceful West Lake
reviews.content: West Lake is divided into two sides of the street. It is a peaceful setting to relax from the busy rush of Hanoi.  You can buy a coconut or feed turtles.

reviews.author: JillElizSel
reviews.title: YUK
reviews.content: Not the most pleasant of places.  There were dead fish floating on the shore-line.  The temple was shut both times that I visited.  The pollution was so bad that is was difficult to see the other side of the lake. The only good thing I could say was the I walked there.

reviews.author: Dishaa S
reviews.title: west lake
reviews.content: a good opportunity to walk with lake on bith sides, the area around the west lake is relatively quieter as compared to hoan kiem lake because of less tourists footfalls. also called ho tay, west lake houses the tran quoc pagaoda

reviews.author: emillisecond
reviews.title: A strange serenity in Hanoi
reviews.content: Expecting a casual walk around a sludge-ridden lake, I was exceptionally excited to arrive with my poor defenseless boyfriend to a Swan boat-packed water's edge. I had managed to hide my romantic giddiness towards the clunky cliches for a year, but the jig was up. The lake is the kind of beautiful that is almost dreamlike. It might be the city lights leaking through the pollution, but there is a purple haze that seems to reflect on the water. And it's a true treat to watch Vietnamese families play bumper cars on the swam boats. Is this a life changing experience? No. But it was an amazing way to experience the sunset in Hanoi off the busy streets and with my favorite person. My last bit of advice? Head to one of the rooftop bars after for a iced beer.

reviews.author: shoemaker_10
reviews.title: peaceful lake
reviews.content: take a gentle stroll around this large lake. just around the corner from our hotel. coffee - Vietnam style plus snacks available.

reviews.author: Saffron T
reviews.title: Relaxing, Great View
reviews.content: Highly recommendation for a cyclo tour around Hanoi. Enjoying the view from one of the nearby restaurant or coffee shops is also a nice choice.

reviews.author: Susan K
reviews.title: A disappointment
reviews.content: Not well kept -  rubbish in the Lake. Dead fishes left on the grass patch. . Nothing in comparison to the sword lake which is smaller but more charming. Not worth a visit.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Great walk
reviews.content: Walked the lake every day of my stay and always found it so interesting so much to see and take in not matter what the time of day

reviews.author: UsaSeasoned_traveler
reviews.title: Near Sofitel
reviews.content: There is a lot of activity around the Westlake. The lake is a good place to take a walk if you are staying in any of the hotels surrounding the lake.

reviews.author: Robzaza
reviews.title: Not as exciting in the winter months
reviews.content: We came here hoping to go on a swan boat ride that we had read in many reviews. When we arrived we noticed that there were no other riders on the lake and the price for renting a swan was very high. We decided to have a drink at a place on the lake instead. We were the only customers so had to wonder whether the popularity is seasonal or if we just picked the wrong time of day.

reviews.author: markchang2015
reviews.title: 27km round cycle
reviews.content: I usually cycle around West lake in the morning - a really good place for outdoors. There's 27km round trip of the lake instead of 17km as others said. 17km is the length of the road in the outbound of the lake, but if you cycle or walk, you will follow the narrow streets along the shore of the lake, and my bike meter clock says 27km. Enjoy your visit to West lake every time of the day. Another image of Hanoi, serenity in the morning with the old men fishing by the lake, sipping a cup of tea. More exotic in the late afternoon when thousands of scooter move on streets to back home after working hours.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.title: Watch life pass by
reviews.content: Did a morning run around this area, during my stay in Hanoi. I loved this area. I honestly wanted to run around this lake but it's 17km long. I shall prepare to run this area the next time! Great restaurants near the lake! Sunrise was awesome too.

reviews.author: Sir_Gaurav
reviews.title: Serene Evenings
reviews.content: You can take a walk at the specially made embankments in the evening and enjoy some roadside food as well in the vicinity.

reviews.author: Emma S
reviews.title: Wouldn't bother
reviews.content: Not much going on here at all in the winter, it's completely out the way & once you arrived there's nothing to do. Wasted trip.

reviews.author: ramiaj197
reviews.title: Super Quiet and Romantic
reviews.content: I stayed in the Intercont hotel there.. It is really amazing and it is so quiet unlike the most popular area for tourists which is the Old Quarter. There is nothing much to do there. The only attraction to visit there is the Trấn Quốc Pagoda. But if you like nature and tranquility.. you will love it there.

reviews.author: Ray T
reviews.title: A lovely area in Hanoi
reviews.content: Walked to this area as part of a full-day City tour, by car and on foot. Weather was lovely; tour guide very knowledgeable and interesting. One of a number of really interesting City attractions, including Museums, Pagodas and the Mausoleum.

reviews.author: ThomasBo
reviews.title: STROLL THROUGH THE MORNING MIST
reviews.content: Ho Tay, West Lake or The Lake of the Morning Mist - Hanoi's largest lake has a loot of names and legends around it. Great for a Sunday stroll or jog. If you cannot handle all 17 km in one stretch, there are lots of cafés around the lake.

reviews.author: Manzar B
reviews.title: A beautiful spot in Hanoi
reviews.content: The lake, is a beautiful spot to walk around and surrounded by many restaurants. The Pagodalocated i. the middle certainly worth a visit.

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Must see.   Very central, beautiful lake with interesting temple island.  Lots of restaurants and shops around it.  Great to walk completely around - takes about 20 minutes.

reviews.author: RPM
reviews.title: Worth a walk
reviews.content: The West lake walk is around 17km. It's a great place for morning walks and/or evening walks. It's surrounded by boat restaurant and coffee shops. Visit the Pagoda that provides the much required calmness in the noisy vicinity.

reviews.author: The Baobab Republic
reviews.title: The West Lake Hanoi
reviews.content: This, is simlpy a must visist place for tourist in Hanoi. There are not many cities which has lot of lakes like Hanoi. Ang West Lake, or Ho Tay as it's called in Vietnamese, is a wonderful place for you to be. May have a beer at the restaurant call BANH TOM HO TAY, which they sell the shrimp rice cake, very much enjoyable.

reviews.author: phillow1
reviews.title: Serenity with a touch of shimmering reflection
reviews.content: Hanoi Club Hotel may not be a magnificent hotel but I enjoyed the view and close proximity to all the attractions that I planned to visit in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Paradise T
reviews.title: Large lake with nice coffee!
reviews.content: West lake is quite beautiful lake with some nice coffee. The most thing I love in West Lake is Tran Quoc pagoda with the unique tall Buddhist temple. I love the peaceful atmosphere here. Thanh Nien road - a road along the lake is so beautiful with many trees. I also enjoy the ice - cream here. It is okay and cheap.

reviews.author: chuawah y
reviews.title: Good view
reviews.content: Head out to west Lake,easily walkable from Hoan Kiem Lake. (About 45 minutes)The whole circumference of the lake is 10.6 miles.There are nice small cafes around the edge of the lake,but then you don't see any cafes for a long time in a few spots,so be sure to stock up on your water and suntan lotion and take a hat as there is no shade around the lake and can get very hot!

reviews.author: Roland M
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.content: West Lake is another must. Why not buy a baby Turtle and let free in to the lake, wish you something and remember your little baby turtle might live in West Lake over 50 year.

reviews.author: Jacqui M
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: An interesting venue, with the Hanoi skyline on one side, street vendors on another and a historic temple beside it. Also, there were scenes of Vietnamese life - a boat going across with fishermen on board and an old lady with her catch of snails. Do not forget to visit the Tran Quoc pagoda with the Buddhist temple at the end of the lake. Quite peaceful, especially with the chanting nuns in the temple.

reviews.author: Ted O'Connell
reviews.title: Westlake is a great area away from the maddening crowds
reviews.content: A visit to the Westlake area of Hanoi is a visual as well as a culinarily valuable experience. Away from the crowds at Hoan Kiem Lake, the Westlake area has great restaurants and more peaceful and serene experience. You can bike the area without fear of being run over my a motorbike and a stop at Chu Van An high school is a chance to see the lasting affects of French architecture. Enjoy your days and nights at WESTLAKE....!!!

reviews.author: Peter L
reviews.title: Only a brief visit but has potential
reviews.content: Had walked from old town and needed a break so had lunch here.  Too tired to explore but when we come back to Hanoi this area will be high on our must see list

reviews.author: travel_enhancement
reviews.title: Interesting Culture Viewing
reviews.content: The West Lake itself didn't do much for me, though its a good place to walk around if your into walking.  I did like the some culture aspects found around the place, the older people carrying  (empty) baskets on poles across shoulders while wearing the very Vietnamese identifiable field worker hat. They offered people to do the same and get photos etc...so it was a bit of fun doing that.  Across the road from teh actual lake broad walks were plenty of Vietnamese coffee houses and eateries

reviews.author: Ardiana
reviews.title: Yes, for drinking!
reviews.content: At my first night after eating and drinking at a restaurant, we went to the West Lake to have a more chilled out evening drinking juice/beer nearby! It was such a great experience sitting on the floor over looking the lake. At around 2 am though, the police went by and we had to 'leave' (basically, stand up and wait for them to leave) and go back to the same place.
