Even the servers had to remove the mats, and drinks, etc. But, my Vietnamese friends told me, that it's common and the servers just pay the police and continue on for the rest of the evening.

reviews.author: Miker s
reviews.title: Amazing lake
reviews.content: Just wondering why don't most of travelers visit this lake. When we did the biking with VietnamCheapPackages, we just saw a few foreign walkers around the 27km round excursion. Visited the lake in the late afternoon and it provided an amazing image of what Hanoi locals usually do. Many people were coming back home from work, but on 1 side of the lake. On the other side where there are many luxury apartments, resorts and hotels, it was quiet. The pagodas were still serene contrast to the loud music "Casablanca" local women were doing Aerobic beside. What an amazing. We tried snail "bun" vermicelli near from temple of Mother Goddess, which I think it's the most tasty dish I've tried. Highly recommend you to visit West lake.

reviews.author: Sandra S
reviews.title: HUGE !!
reviews.content: A massive sized lake with interesting activities around the south side in particular, also on the water. Great for kids.

reviews.author: appetoni
reviews.title: Lot's of great attractions around the lake.
reviews.content: There are plenty of great restaurants, shops, bars and other attractions around the lake. The lake is beautiful too. I especially enjoyed it in the evening.

reviews.author: Olga S
reviews.title: A relaxed walk with great views
reviews.content: West Lake makes a great walk - the views are great, trees provide much needed shade from the sun, you get a chance to see some local life and try street food - if you spot Bo Bia bike, get yourself a roll!Pagoda is stunning and is one of the most beautiful and oldest in the city - worth a quick visit too!

reviews.author: Alex D
reviews.title: The largest lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: A place you must come when you are in Hanoi. You can enjoy the peace with a cup of coffee at a coffee shop near the lake

reviews.author: Charlie C
reviews.title: Lovely Lake!
reviews.content: Nice peaceful Lake. Great for a stroll and to watch life slowly pass by. Locals enjoy this area as well. Some nice pictures taken here in hanoi by the lake.

reviews.author: manucanuck
reviews.title: Pleasant
reviews.content: I stayed at the intercontinental Hanoi west lake and had a beautiful panoramic view of the west lake every day. Never had enough of it! Beautiful lake situated north of the Ho Chi Minh presidential palace, an easy 10 minutes walk can get you to the edge of it.

reviews.author: Jo F
reviews.title: And another Pagoda
reviews.content: Beautiful area of Hanoi, do buy a tortoise and set it free in the lake.  Buy beautiful fruit from the street vendors, take care in crossing the streets in this area.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.content: I lived just off of West Lake and loved it. Best place to get away from the smoggy city with plenty of restaurants bars with live music, good places for drinking and clubbing & amazing food which you can have overlooking the lake

reviews.author: SaranaeeSaa
reviews.title: Nice Lake
reviews.content: Nice view around and good relaxed but the lake little bit dirty and bad smell. It is ok if just look only the view.

reviews.author: Alana D
reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.content: I had a look at this lake on a few occasions but personally I much prefer Hoan Kiem Lake as it is easier to get around and there is more to see.

reviews.author: luxlink2015
reviews.title: Swimming for the brave only
reviews.content: Situated in the ex-pat area of Hanoi this beautiful lake in Hanoi is of freshwater. We circumnavigated the lake by bike (thanks to a local restaurant owner who loaned them to us) late one afternoon an early evening. It must have been about 15km if not more but enjoyable. We were able to gain a good perspective of the surrounding area. We were amazed there were no mosquitoes. We passed the oldest pagoda in Vietnam and stopped at a restaurant called Pepe la Poele that we can highly recommend. The swim the following day took our breath away... approx 19 C so a bit fresh.

reviews.author: Diana_Ng_17
reviews.title: The lake nearby Church Boutique hotel
reviews.content: When I was in search of local coffee powder as a souvenir, I discovered that it is just few minutes distance from my hotel. It is beauty at the night, and many local and foreigner took pictures. There is also some historical building besides.

reviews.author: Alain B
reviews.title: Very large lake cannot be compared to Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: West Lake cannot be compared to Hoan Kiem Lake. It is surrounded by large international chain hotels  and Serviced Apartments which is the main reason of going there. You cannot walk round the lake. It is too big. Small areas can be accessed and worth the walk for its "local flavour". You need to get there by taxi.

reviews.author: JulieP80
reviews.title: Looks a little tired
reviews.content: West Lake is around 20 mins walk from the Old Quarter. It's quite nice to see - but the restaurants and cafes at the bottom of the lake look a little tired - and there are quite a lot of hawkers - including one selling baby turtles that you can release back into the lake! I'm sure they are then recaptured..

reviews.author: dmemi
reviews.title: very nice and cultural
reviews.content: To me, the beauty of Ha Noi will be something not special without West Lake. After visiting the nosiy city, this is the best place for you to take a rest. You can take a walk along the lake, near the main road or you can take a seat in the floating restaurant nearby. I did both. A perfect time if you visit this site in autumn when the weather is special. Highly recommended !

reviews.author: christpost
reviews.title: Dirty!
reviews.content: Well, the lake is not really well taken care of. People are dropping their garbage inside, dead fish are floating on the surface, water is smelly. Actually a shame. Could be such a nice lake...

reviews.author: 97michael
reviews.title: Larger Lake
reviews.content: One of the cool lakes ya have to pay a visit besides in Hanoi is West Lake and I love the view here at night

reviews.author: johnV9881WF
reviews.title: West Lake (Ho Tay), Greater Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is the largest of several lakes in Hanoi, and about 13 km in circumference.  It was about 2 km northwest of my accommodation in the Old Quarter.  Geologically, the lake was created when Hanoi's Red River (Song Hong), overflowed its banks.  Flooding is still a persistent problem that has been partially overcome by the construction of dykes.  All lakes in Hanoi have associated legend(s), and West Lake is no exception.  One legend on the origin of West Lake (also known as Big Lake and Lake of Mist), relates that the lake was created when the Dragon King drowned an evil nine-tailed fox in its lair, where had stood a large stand of forest.The lake is surrounded by the most expensive suburbs in Hanoi.  On the eastern shores, there are several very expensive hotels of international chains, often built jutting out over the water, to give guests striking views of the lake itself.  While the eastern shores have the most expensive shopping, including boutiques of local and international establishments, on the cheaper south side that are several large seafood and shellfish restaurants, which are very popular with locals.  However, as a tourist with a little time to spare, and very partial to seafood, that in Halong City itself, along the Vietnam coast (as distinct from the wharf to the south of the city, where Halong Bay cruises depart), is far cheaper, more varied and extremely fresh, most being caught daily by local fishermen.

reviews.author: Kimberlie J
reviews.title: West Lake
reviews.content: A mixture of the old and new around this area, with people fishing in the lake to the multi story buildings in the back ground. it is surrounded by awesome eating places

reviews.author: Shane_Thailand
reviews.title: Try Walking Around The Lake
reviews.content: Lots of small restaurants, bars and coffee shops. Interesting place to try and walk around. Takes longer than one thinks. Not very far from Hoan Kiem but thanks to new connection to Noi Bai International Airport it takes about 30 minutes. Some high end hotels - Sheraton and Intercontinental in West Lake - but also some much cheaper hotels. Good pace for walking or simply people watching.

reviews.author: AndrewTMAO
reviews.title: Quite picturesque, particularly in the evening
reviews.content: It is lovely, particularly at the Intercontinental "Sunset Bar" for an evening drink as the sun sets (logically).  I wouldn't think about swimming in the lake, but there is no odour.

reviews.author: Peter L
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: West Lake is a beautiful area which I believe is the area where the western expats live. lots of places to eat whatever cuisine you desire. Grab a coffee and sit by the lake like we did. It was lovely.

reviews.author: peter t
reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.content: More up market Hanoi visited several restaurants in the are all very good and reasonable, go on the swans fore a trip

reviews.author: Winnie T
reviews.title: A secret paradise
reviews.content: I was there in my second last day.  I was told it’s far away from the city so I put this place aside, however, it’s a quiet place without motor bikes.   Besides, there are a lot of good hidden restaurants which has never reported in the trip adviser. And, there are lot of bars and café along the west lake.  It’s a good idea to enjoy the lake view with your Vietnamese coffee in hand.

reviews.author: Xplore_Traveler
reviews.title: Great lake for night a walk to see the west side of the city
reviews.content: Great lake for a night walk to see the west side of the city away from the busy traffics and enjoy restaurants on the boat or visit the Chu Tran Quoc in the afternoon (entry fee)

reviews.author: JHNB1
reviews.title: Once round is good
reviews.content: If you live local then once round by bike is really good to keep fit and to see all the different areas. It takes approx one hour and on the way stop at the French cake shop to buy breakfast. The lotus flower ponds to the north are worth a visit any time of year. There is a swinning club for locals to the north but I am not so sure its a good idea to swim. There is also fish for sale but again take care, only for locals. To the south are the shell fish restaurants. Lots to see in the round.

reviews.author: 197paises
reviews.title: fancy
reviews.content: fancy new  are my Sheraton hotel  as around that  area but I like more the old quarter also good to go and see

reviews.author: Daria
reviews.title: Nice area
reviews.content: Actually lake is very small but this is a very cozy area where you can spend time alone or with friends. Even when its raining.

reviews.author: GretaAz
reviews.title: Not as far away as they say
reviews.content: Very-very polluted, but worth going just to see the pagoda, better early in the morning to see locals fishing and excercising. Can go walking there.

reviews.author: GRIMS
reviews.title: Nice Walk
reviews.content: Nice walk, nothing spectacular but pleasant enough  especially at nightfall when the natives come out to stroll and eat at the various lake side kiosks etc

reviews.author: Ganga D D
reviews.title: coconut water by the lake
reviews.content: Nice place to sit along and have some eats or coconut water! lots of buzz around the place. Public transport brings you here .

reviews.author: Charlie K
reviews.title: A gem in a busy, frenetic city.
reviews.content: A gem in a busy city. This a pleasant place to have a iced Vietnamese coffee. Very picturesque place complete with fisher persons and people rowing boats

reviews.author: Hanoi R
reviews.title: Great quiet space in the middle of the city
reviews.content: Choose to live next to west lake. Huge lake with over 10 kilometres of walking tracks. Many restaurants. Need to sort out the good from the ok. A little tranquilty in a hectic city.

reviews.author: MAHENDRANATHAN
reviews.title: Scenic,Peaceful and Iconic to Hanoi.
reviews.content: This is a beautiful fresh water lake located in the heart of Hanoi and once used to be part of the Red River. The lake is surrounded by gardens and the city itself. The perimeter of the lake is used by the locals and visitors for recreational purposes and other activities like walking and jogging. A must to visit.

reviews.author: Madeleine L
reviews.title: Big beautiful spaces
reviews.content: Tay Ho is a very big lake! We drove all around on a motorbike and it was worth the view! If you are looking for something different than hoan Kiem and the old quarter, west lake is a great option. I would recommend Ngu Xa street which is absolutely beautiful, peaceful and different from any streets we have seen in Hanoi so far. Have a good time in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Cat H
reviews.title: worth to visit
reviews.content: The most beatiful lake i have visited, sun rise, sunset, lotus flower pond, interesting local activites make an intire beutiful photos

reviews.author: lshastings
reviews.title: Lovely centre pice, easy to use to as a landmark
reviews.content: Was always something different happening, we had Moon fesitive on when we were here, amazing to watch the celebrations, for young and old.

reviews.author: Amiad H
reviews.title: Beautiful View
reviews.content: One of the most beautiful parts of Hanoi. Great views, and good cafes and restaurants. The one downside is that this is a bit of an expat haven, so it would not be the best place to find local food.

reviews.author: TallChris51
reviews.title: Impressive space
reviews.content: A welcome and very large expanse of water which adds interest to the city, and with lots of access points and cafes dotted around even including a spot you can swim from!  Nice to go and unwind.

reviews.author: Rita Zennia
reviews.title: Holiday in Hanoi
reviews.content: Went all around the lake on a motor bike which was great fun.  The lake is stunning and all different kinds of life, community is to be seen here.  A definite must if you go to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Bình B
reviews.title: Such a lovely place!
reviews.content: I ve been here many timesw, everytime i come here, walking or driving motorbike, i always feel so peaceful. The lake is large, in the summer u will love the wind. You can come to do excersice, or sitting on the grass, have ice tea, watch the fisherman do fishing. try the "Banh Tom ho tay", ice cream, or Bo Bia if u like sweet thing. you will love your life more when you see the sunset at Westlake. You aslo can stir the "duck boat" go around the lake. or have dinner on the cruise restaurant.a must go in HaNoi.

reviews.author: GohYH93
reviews.title: Enjoy Coffee at Highland Coffee on Westlake
reviews.content: When the weather allows, do take time and sit in the Highland café and enjoy the Westlake view.  Good for couples.

reviews.author: JohnLW91
reviews.title: Dump
reviews.content: It's a dump of a lake. We walked there with the view to going on the swans and peddling around the lake. It has all sort of rubbish in the lake, clearly the locals don't take care of the environment in this part of Hanoi. Save yourself a long walk or costly taxi ride and leave this one out of your itinerary.

reviews.author: Annhien1012
reviews.title: Big lake and interesting streets around
reviews.content: There are not too much people and crowded streets near here. The weather is always great. Many foreigners choose to live near west lake because of the pure air and good view from their villas or studios

reviews.author: hoahip144
reviews.title: Nostalgic sunset
reviews.content: Living in Hanoi near West Lake, i have never lost my admiral to its beauty. Ignoring the dead fish and some UFOs (unidentified floating objects), this is a wonderful place to enjoy the nostagic beauty of Hanoi.Try some ice cream or "bo bia" while strolling down Thanh Nien street, or enjoy "banh tom" (made of shrimps and flour) after visiting Tay Ho pagoda. And finally, lose yourself in the orange sky of the sunset on the lake.My bf and I always love the sunset there!

reviews.author: dennisp358
reviews.title: Downtown
reviews.content: A nice view of the lake and adjacent Old Quarter scenery.  Stops were spontaneous and included getting breakfast.

reviews.author: Emily S
reviews.title: Beautiful, fun and great food!
reviews.content: Great place to explore! The lake is beautiful, there are great places to get food, coffee and bakery treats. We had a heap of fun pedaling the swans around the lake at 11pm (and having one break mid lake making us tow each other to shore- it was a very funny experience)! Definitely wear mosquito spray because there are a lot of bugs around the lake

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Nothing special - head to Hoan Kiem river instead
reviews.content: We walked all the way from the ho chi minh mausolem and walked around the lake and wondered around the neighborhood (around 14kms walk) but seriously, there was nothing much to see and it's not a peaceful stroll either.  Don't bother with this area - I'd recommend Hoan Kiem river instead.

reviews.author: Worldlycouple
reviews.title: Nice afternoon trip
reviews.content: We went to Westlake to see the temple and wound up at the lake across the street with the Swan Paddle Boats $4 hr us, and the floating highlands coffee house.  Definitely an area of Hanoi worth exploring; we didn't do as much as we would like to have since it was our last day.

reviews.author: Bzh56
reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.content: A good tour to be done on a bike , except thsat nothing specail. We stayed on the lake at the Intercontinental, the view of the city is ok, but nothing exceptional.

reviews.author: Lilla C
reviews.title: Sun and water fun
reviews.content: I hired a driver and a motorbike to drive me around the lake. It took approximately 2 hours, with a few stops on the way, but definitely could have been longer as lots of temples, bars/ restaurant on the lake edges. A Quieter part of the city, less manic!

reviews.author: dojohawk2015
reviews.title: Take the electric car
reviews.content: Was  certainly worth a visit.  We cheated and got an electric car to drive us around and it was well worth it.

reviews.author: Girl_in_dark
reviews.title: Largest lake in Ha Noi...
reviews.content: Good place to go for walk.Ocean in the middle of Ha Noi and be the only place you can see the sunset glow, had better come here in the lotus season ...

reviews.author: BuntyH
reviews.title: Good place to walk in evening
reviews.content: Good place to walk around. Cool breeze. This place is not as happening as Hoan Kiem lake. You should have good company to enjoy.

reviews.author: Brenda J
reviews.title: fresh air and quiet
reviews.content: Tay Ho Temple is worth a visit just to look at the old trees. You can bike partway around the lake and I even saw some people swimming in it. A lot of expats live around here and there are so good hidden spots for a meal and glass of wine. Take bus 55.

reviews.author: trevor a
reviews.title: West Lake Wonders
reviews.content: Plenty of foreigners live and eat around West Lake so there is a good selection of many European as well as local foods to choose from. And the Sheraton is ideally located if you want an up market night out!

reviews.author: Krisztina V
reviews.title: Cycling around West lake
reviews.content: We cycled around the West lake in Hanoi which was a great experience. In half way we found an aquapark which seemed to be a great place. There's no cycling path around the lake which makes the trip more exciting and dangerous at the same time.

reviews.author: suziecooch
reviews.title: We stayed at Westlake so this was lovely and the lights over the lake were beautiful of a night
reviews.content: this seems to be where the nightlife is, shopping is in the old town however if you are wanting to have a later night and live music this is the place to be, alot of locals go here as well for the entertainment and nightlife

reviews.author: StephanieP
reviews.title: Amazing Hanoi
reviews.content: The lake is very beautiful and charming, especially if like us, you have a hotel with a view.Very pleasant to walk around the lake, and a visit to the beautiful temple on the island, passing through the charming red bridge.The city is beautiful, especially the neighborhoods and deli markets of longhouse.

reviews.author: indochinanomads
reviews.title: Nice walk
reviews.content: It is really interesting to start walk from old quarter over Nguyen Truong To then Truc Bach road for nice local coffee then across Thanh Nien Road for Tran Quoc Pagoda then make a round trip as long as you could like to then Thuy Khue- Ngoc Ha  and down to Hochiminh Mausoleum towards to French Quarter. Around 10km in total but amazing local scene

reviews.author: elle157
reviews.title: Nice place to wonder and watch the fishermen
reviews.content: I've walked along West Lake and also rented a bicycle. It's a bit big to cycle around if you don't have all day/not used to cycling. But some really nice cafes on the lake and spots to sit and read. Also took lots of photos of the lake, and the dragon statues and the fishermen all around the lake during the day. Eaten at a few places around here and always had good service, usually english spoken and good mid-range priced food. Probably best for day cycles and sunset walks for couples. There is also a swimming pool/leisure park facility with rides etc. that was open but I didn't go in, but looks like fun for a young family for the day.

reviews.author: seedhunter
reviews.title: Nice place for evening
reviews.content: Located in the middle of the city, this is the biggest fresh water lake in the capital. A lot of gardens, hotels are there near the lake. It becomes more beautiful specially in the evening.

reviews.author: Laurice B
reviews.title: No complaints
reviews.content: We ate at one of the 'houseboats' on the lake - picked at random - no complaints about food, alcohol or service. Worth the experience! (took a cyclo from our hotel)

reviews.author: Ramram47
reviews.title: walk trail
reviews.content: this area has a long walk area where you can just relax view the lake and other people some doing excersize

reviews.author: Shakira
reviews.title: An unforgettable adventure
reviews.content: I went out towards the evening with West Lake circled on a map. The Vietnamese are extremely  friendly despite the language barriers. Nonetheless, three taxis took me to 'West Lake Hotel' instead of the lake, I ended up getting off the third time, ventured through the streets and eventually managed to get help to get to the lake. I passed se amazing coffee shops. It really was a beautiful sight to take in, the lake is vast it looks like the ocean,  gardens are well kept, lovely to takr a walk though a struggle to find a taxi back as well.

reviews.author: Epanadero S
reviews.title: Nice palce!
reviews.content: It is a good place for visiting and relaxing near by Hanoi and it is not so far from the old town. Tourist could walk to this place just for see and look the screen around here.

reviews.author: Nidhi_onroad
reviews.title: Visit around sunset time
reviews.content: West Lake is a little away from the tourists areas. A cab from old town to West Lake would cost around USD 4. It was lovely to walk around the lake in the evening. There are several pubs/restaurants and five star hotel around the lake. It was nice to sit in one of the them and watch the crowds go by. Visit the lake if you have a free evening in Hanoi.

reviews.author: clairmontjeff
reviews.title: Pleasant Area
reviews.content: There are several floating restaurants on the lake, so the area is quite busy both during the day and evening.

reviews.author: GURUPRASATHK1979
reviews.title: Nice place to spend in the evening
reviews.content: Very nice place to spend in the evening,Nice people,also nice place to shop in the road side shops.we have to bargain before shopping

reviews.author: roamingmark1
reviews.title: Nothing special...if you are into wandering.
reviews.content: Walking North from "Ba Dinh Square" we reached the West Lake.Coming across "QuanThanh Temple" was a little gem and I believe is the oldest temple in the city.For me this was the hi lite of our wander to the West lake and the smaller "Truc Bach lake". (we had 5 days in Hanoi)The area is picturesque and something upmarket with hotels and profusion of seafood restaurants. So if you are into wandering and have the time why not.

reviews.author: Glenita
reviews.title: Nice views at night
reviews.content: If you want to spend a great late afternoon grab yourself some nice cold drinks and spend it by the lake, even better at night as you see the lights of the city all around you reflecting off the water.

reviews.author: ksfoong
reviews.title: You won't miss that lake, it's located centrally at Old Quaters
reviews.content: There are some tourist spot at the lake. And it has old folk story about the lake. The famous water puppet show is just beside Westlake

reviews.author: Vermilla2008
reviews.title: Rent a bike!
reviews.content: If you come here just for the lake, well, I'm not sure is be that impressed, as other reviewers have said, it's just a lake. However, we rented bikes from the Hanoi Bicycle Collective (http://ns390200.ovh.net/thbc.vn/), and it was brilliant - all the way round the lake with a 10 & 12 year old, some busy bits, but mainly really easy riding. Stopped off at Botanical Gardens, and had a lovely lunch on the north shore. THBC were great, highly recommended.

reviews.author: ozpom
reviews.title: Views of Hanoi skyline
reviews.content: If you're staying in the Old Quarter this is a bit of a hike; you'll need to get transport there... if you are interested in a view back to the Hanoi skyline, there are great views from the poolside bar at the Intercontinental; expect to pay Western prices at the bar. The view at night is quite captivating.

reviews.author: NguyenMr
reviews.title: Beautiful & Romantic
reviews.content: Westlake is one of the characteristic beauty of the capital, Hanoi, from many years ago so far west lake has changed quite a lot about the beauty and upgraded for the lakeside road. It is the anniversary for the city young couple in love. It will be a pleasant experience when you discover Westlake

reviews.author: torontobiggs1
reviews.title: Peaceful place to relax in the center of the city.
reviews.content: This is a peaceful part of the city to get away from the buzzing bikes and crowds. Nice to just sit and watch the people pass by.

reviews.author: Puppy
reviews.title: Great views of the lake and from the lake
reviews.content: This is the biggest of many lakes (12-15) in Ha Noi which were, in the past, all part of the Red River before its path was altered. The view of the lake from Observation 72 is excellent but you can see some cool views at the side of the lake too. You can get food, watch the locals and generally enjoy a walk.

reviews.author: Coleman M
reviews.title: View from the Lake
reviews.content: I went to the West Lake to visit the Pagoda, but unfortunately, it was closed for lunchtime, so I just walked along the banks of the lake. I guess that got the name of the lake from the West Lake in China in Hangzhou and although this lake was quite huge, I did not see much interesting places of interest here. Overall I was quite let down by it and thought that this is a attraction that you can give a miss if you are staying in Old Quarter, which is about 15-20 minutes drive away.

reviews.author: Slappyjoe
reviews.title: It's a lake
reviews.content: The lake is nice with lots of businesses around it, Not really my thing as most of the restaurants around are tourist traps. Go for a walk but avoid the restaurants and bars here.

reviews.author: Heather F
reviews.title: Free attraction
reviews.content: Spend the time to stroll around this lake , it's very beautiful with overhanging tree. Great photos and walk along with the locals. It's cooler under the trees in the afternoons and you can sit on many of the seats and watch the world go by.

reviews.author: Neil G
reviews.title: So refreshing and peaceful.
reviews.content: If you come to the lakes from the old part of Hanoi you will find a large amount of house boats and old steamers all turned into great restaurants, food on all of them it  to die for .The lake itself is a respite from the madness of the city, it would probably be one klm across and two klm wide and is a great in the cooler times of the day ..The ex vise president of the USA  was shot down into this lake during the war , so it has some telling history. A must place to go if you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: BKK111
reviews.title: Don't make a point of going here
reviews.content: A large lake with lots of nothing. I haven't been there for years except for asking by in a taxi. IMO if you miss it you've missed nothing!

reviews.author: Malayprincess
reviews.title: ITs just ok
reviews.content: Pretty quiet place but nothing much to do there, not sure it is worth the journey.  there are  swan boats to rent and go out

reviews.author: Robert Elsey
reviews.title: West lake is best place to stay
reviews.content: We stayed in the Sheraton hotel which is on the West Lake. A great part of the city to introduce you to Hanoi.  It is certainly a little more calm than the Old Quarter! You can walk round the lake and we found an outdoor swimming pool which seemed popular with Hanoi people and our first pagoda.  We also frequented a lovely bar just outside the Sheraton on the lake - great place.  It is also not expensive or difficult to get taxis in and out of central Hanoi

reviews.author: Adi R
reviews.title: Cool--and huge
reviews.content: Neat spot to get a view of the more commercial districts of Hanoi. You'll inevitably end up here if you spend enough time walking around Hanoi.

reviews.author: Ivy G
reviews.title: It was okay.
reviews.content: We took an electric car around this lake.  It was ok.  Nothing special.  The price of the electric car was high.  12$.  That is the most we paid for anything in Vietnam.  Maybe we would have seen more by foot.

reviews.author: NickiandPeter
reviews.title: Seafood
reviews.content: We found delicious seafood and a lovely atmosphere in the evening. It gave a more pleasant aspect to the city.

reviews.author: Hoaiphuong2191
reviews.title: For some one love to bike
reviews.content: It may be noisy and cramped but you still can fine some quite and beautiful conners some where here. I love to bike around West Lake, breath fresh air and find a small cafe shop to take a rest. Love it so much

reviews.author: CherlyOsa
reviews.title: Lovely Lake
reviews.content: Its nice to stroll around the lake either morning or afternoon, there is a lots of bench to sit to and reading books or just enjoy the view!

reviews.author: Chris101111
reviews.title: Big lakes.
reviews.content: I cycled up here and there is a lot to see, the lake itself has activities, swan boats etc.It is quite crowed on weekends but it's great to see all the local people use the area.Great also for a walk, I recommend it.

reviews.author: macneillfamily
reviews.title: Worth walking around to capture the feel of hanoi
reviews.content: Good experience to take a leisurely walk around the lake, first thing in the morning is ideal, you will find the locals exercising and contemplating the day ahead, simple thing to do but halos orientate you in central hanoi

reviews.author: Aisling247
reviews.title: Smelly
reviews.content: Unfortunately it's the only place in Vietnam that we would not return, The lake looked beautiful but as we got closer it was very smelly caused by all of the rotting fish floating along the edge of the dirty lake...

reviews.author: mjayBoston
reviews.title: Refreshing
reviews.content: Beautifully landscaped with flowers, trees, and greenry. A very pleasant walk around the lake and a refreshing break from the hustle & bustle of the city streets. Lots of benchs to sit and rest.

reviews.author: Ansella
reviews.title: Slowly night
reviews.content: You can just lazying around walking at the sidewalk of the lake, on the corner near the temple some young man and girl will offering you to paint or drawing your face, they have different style to draw.  You can watch the reflection of the light on the edge of the lake or just sitting there and have a chat with your friend. If you are lucky, you gonna get bump with a dancer group practicing their dancing skill too, which is refreshing to see.

reviews.author: Glenn M
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: The night life around this lake at night is colossal. Great place to have that evening stroll and get ice cream.

reviews.author: Peggy C
reviews.title: City surprise
reviews.content: This area of Hanoi is quiet beautiful, a real surprise.  Many people about enjoying the lake and the walkways.

reviews.author: Hồng Anh N
reviews.title: The romantic lake
reviews.content: West lake is the largest lake of Ha Noi. It is divided into 2 parts by Thanh Nien street, West lake in the West and Truc Bach lake in the East . In the past, the people did the aquaculture in these 2 lakes but now, this area is a good place for relaxing. You should walk and enjoy the cool winds from the lake, go on a boat shaped like ducks around the lakes in about 30' at the price of 50.000 VND. This will be the most interesting memory.

reviews.author: Rosemary F
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: The pretty centre of the capital. So much happens here... including water puppetry. Lush, green, picturesque and action packed. Lovely walking around or looking at from a rooftop bar.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: As romantic as a dead fish
reviews.content: This destination was part of our day's tour - our guide told us it was a lovely area around the lakes where young couples came to be 'romantic'.  Maybe just us but we didn't find anything remotely romantic about the lake where dead fish and garbage floated along the edge.  You could hire Swan paddle boats, but the idea of floating in the debris didn't appeal to any of us!

reviews.author: JEmmanuelLasPinas
reviews.title: Good spot for a late afternoon stroll
reviews.content: This is a bigger lake but has some nice quiet portions where one can enjoy a leisurely stroll. Take in the peaceful atmosphere and enjoy the tranquil views around the lake.

reviews.author: heather n
reviews.title: The hub
reviews.content: The best time to go is very early morning. From 6:00 onwards you will see all sites from limbering up and pushing on trees yo badminton and tango dancing.  Enjoy the walk around the lake while still warm but not too hot. At the. D have an Vietnamese coffee.

reviews.author: stef933
reviews.title: Need to see to understand the scale
reviews.content: A great way to understand the scale of the city and the lake itself. You'll still see people fishing in the lake as well as people gathering for a chat and stopping to take it in. Great sunsets over the lake due to its size. Enjoy.

reviews.author: Sumedha K
reviews.title: Time your visit to morning/ evening
reviews.content: The temple was a bit underwhelming but a great spot for people watching and some quiet amidst the hustle-bustle.

reviews.author: Nhu_Phuong
reviews.title: Come here early in the morning!
reviews.content: If you are one of those who enjoy people-watching, come here early in the morning to see lots of middle-aged women doing aerobics, it's really fun. It's a nice walk along the lake too.

reviews.author: CTRTeach11
reviews.title: Nice place to relax
reviews.content: This is the area you go to shop, find a restaurant, sit for a bit, then get back up to search for an ice cream shop.  This lake area is simply the best part of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Jackie H
reviews.title: Lovely area
reviews.content: We stayed in the West Lake area and found it to be lovely. The view of the lake with all the city lights of it at night is a sight to see.Also it's a place for the young locals to take there girlfriends and sit on there scooters and talk the night away which I found so lovely.

reviews.author: nootnoot6
reviews.title: High-end
reviews.content: Luxury hotels and clubs line the lake, and there's even a driving range over the water! The haziness detracts from its beauty, but overall it's a pretty sight.

reviews.author: Rebecca S
reviews.title: Looks great from a distance
reviews.content: The lake and park areas are very large , the lake is a little grimy but still a significant landmark in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Italia030292
reviews.title: Nice atmosphere
reviews.content: This is biggest lake in Ha Noi, there are lot height hotels, luxury restaurants.... around the lake if have chance you should come here to enjoy . Every morning both young and old people exercise very crowed , when lotus season come  you can come here to take some photos or contemplate  hot girls! especially, very good place for young couple to hang out

reviews.author: Jordan U
reviews.title: Pleasant place for an evening walk
reviews.content: The well paved walk path and surrounding green spaces make this an enjoyable walk anytime of day but particularly at night when the lights of the city provide a backdrop reflected on the lake. The area is also quite lively at night with people coming out to read, exercise or just sit around and chat - quite enjoyable

reviews.author: KHFK1
reviews.title: Huge
reviews.content: Fantastic Temple by the west lake and fantastic views all around.  We felt there was an inner calm in the temple and it felt cooler somehow despite the seering heat.

reviews.author: Steveskipton
reviews.title: Not really much to see
reviews.content: We spent a couple of hours around the lake but it is somewhat uninspiring! The pagoda is OK but not very big (and shut anyway when we were there) apart from that a pretty boring and not particularly clean lake.

reviews.author: Hannahthuy
reviews.title: Nice riding around
reviews.content: It is totally a biggest lake in Hanoi. I rided bicycle around 2 hours. Very nice to see around with many kind of flowers especially lotus. You can also fishing here. Seeing local people do taichi in the morning and evening. It is also busy at weekend. Nice palace in summer.

reviews.author: prasenjit1988
reviews.title: Nice walking street
reviews.content: Go there during sunrise or sunset. The lake is big, so you can have walk on one side only. The garden near the very old temple is also nice.

reviews.author: Vietnam Visa Easy
reviews.title: The biggest lake of Hanoi
reviews.content: My house is located just 5 minute walking to the West Lake, the biggest lake of Hanoi. It's great place for doing outdoor morning or evening excersice. I suppose the road around the lake is the most beautiful one in Hanoi. If you feel exhauted of the stressful job, getting tired of the busy life, or whener you'd like to f5 your life, just ride your bike or walk around the lake or even sit at any conners, you'll defenitely find yourself relaxed.

reviews.author: Betty J
reviews.title: nicest part of Hanoi
reviews.content: Beautiful We had a student Guide andit was lovely to have the historyexplained to us through her eyes.The one thing that ruined the experience.Hanoi should stop people using there very small children 2 and 3 years oldfrom running up to you and trying to shove stuff in your hands to make you buy it aroundthe park.  This is a abuse of children and leavesa bad feeling with all tourists.

reviews.author: YuenFen
reviews.title: Evening Walk
reviews.content: Many local people have their evening walk and exercise session here. Mostly are senior citizen. Clean place. The authority is keeping this place well. No hawkers and traders. There even have guards patrolling around.

reviews.author: Debralee2015
reviews.title: Book a Tour
reviews.content: We wandered over from the Old Quarter thinking we would stroll around and figure it out when we got there.  The lake is huge. There is a temple in the middle of the bridge you can see that takes about 10 minutes.  We took a small open air bus "tour" (located in front of the temple-they didn't speak English) that was actually a ride around the lake with no explanation of what we were seeing/passing.  It was so hot, we enjoyed the cool breeze anyway.  I suggest booking something if you are not staying there and the area is unknown to you.  Lunch across the street was excellent.

reviews.author: PLB15
reviews.title: Huge lake to go around
reviews.content: We rented a bike and it was perfect way to see the entire lake cause the roads were not too busy and lots of different spots to see around. Highlights were the many small temples/pagodas and the large lotus filled ponds.

reviews.author: janice655
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: We visited the area and the Buddhist Tran Quoc Pagoda one of the oldest pagoda's in Vietnam was breath taking. The surroundings were peaceful and relaxing , many tourist visiting , the weather was very hot and humid but we didn't seem to mind.

reviews.author: HugoColle
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: The lake isnt really special and quite dirty. There are lotusflowers and some nice sights but not even close to Lak Hoan Kiem.. Some pictures here are from the lake Hoan Kiem and not the West lake. Its good to walk a bit when you are in the neighbourhood.

reviews.author: PorthosLondon
reviews.title: Has potential but needs some work
reviews.content: First impression, very dirty, nearly everywhere we stopped in our short walk there were dead fish floating in the water and in one place a dead rat.  Not great.huge lake though, attractive Pagoda on one sidethe view is nice from the Sofitel hotel sky bar, opens 4pm - western prices for drinks.  good view for sunset also

reviews.author: Michelle D
reviews.title: Lotus flowers galore!
reviews.content: This is one of my favourite lakes. The lotus flowers are in full bloom now at the top of the lake. Best visited in the heat of the day... very hot, I know but they smell divine then! Enjoy!

reviews.author: Babe M
reviews.title: Cycling around!
reviews.content: The homestay in Sapa where we stayed gave us a contact in Hanoi that was able to arrange a guided cycling tour through Hanoi. A safe one, through that crazy traffic. We cycled around the big West Lake , including Nice places to stop for drinks, food and look around. No other tourists!

reviews.author: Cherri
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: I heard a lot about this lake and decided to give it a try. We went out for a walk around the lake but we were disappointed as it's quite dirty and not as charming as the Hoan Kiam lake. If you don't plan to visit here, you didn't miss anything really.

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: West Lake OK
reviews.content: West Lake is worth a visit, the locals in summer would use the place for paddle boats. There is a a worthwhile temple at the end of the lake when you take your life in your hands to cross the roads to get to it. On the lake itself is a floating coffee shop that serves good coffee and accompaniments as well as a number of smaller cafes and the like surrounding the lake itself. We have photos of a lady netting for fish in the lake, personally I would not want to eat fish from it due to some rubbish observed around the perimeter. As a site OK but not exciting

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Exercise
reviews.content: nice view and good place to take a walk or go by the golf car if lazy, many tourist in the area mixed with locals doing exercise , nice

reviews.author: Us2inNI
reviews.title: worth a walk around if it isnt too hot
reviews.content: it was roasting the day we went to the lake (in the 40's) so we couldn't walk all the way round but did as much as we could before needing to escape to an air conditioned cafe nearby

reviews.author: taggmontreal
reviews.title: Pretty and quiet
reviews.content: Love the area. Very peaceful but close enough to old quarters if you want to get back to craziness. Love the cafes along the lake. Great hotels to choose from as well.

reviews.author: Canuckaway
reviews.title: Great stroll to see the traffic going by and it's citizenry
reviews.content: The lake is not too large, yet in the high 30's weather, that is good. A walkway, away from traffic all the way around. In the mornings a great run.Rumour has it if a turtle sticks its head up as you pass, you should make a wish and it will come true. At the one end is shopping street which has more fake sneakers on sale than feet in Vietnam (seems it does) .The water is not very clean, so it is best viewed from the walkway.

reviews.author: Travelingmarika
reviews.title: Lovely lake
reviews.content: Hot, busy, exciting, good for people watching and bike watching, we tried to spot bikes carrying interesting goods (a ladder, 100s of balloons).  Loved the restaurants, bars and market.

reviews.author: fritzie18
reviews.title: Nice, peaceful
reviews.content: It is not just a lake, it also has a pagoda and a temple, it is very peaceful. You can go around and take a stroll. There are also a couple of fruit and souvenir vendors just beware and don't give them big bills or denominations because they tried not to give us change and pretended to be busy until we tried to ask for it, good thing we have our local tourist guide from free hanoi tours that help us communicate with them in Vietnamese and they relented and give us our change.

reviews.author: Sean962
reviews.title: Charming trendy neighbourhood
reviews.content: We stayed at the Intercontinental and did a lot of walking around the lake.  More walkable than much of the rest of Vietnam, still a bit tight in spots.  Nice houses and authentic flavour of locals going about life.  Nice views over the lake.  The pagoda is large and interesting.  Also, don't miss the Chula boutique for inspired and interesting women's fashions, my wife loves their stuff.

reviews.author: Kidwaan
reviews.title: Architecture and food!
reviews.content: I loved the old French architecture and the wide avenues.  It was a nice change from the old quarter. There is really good and cheap food along the South East corner of West Lake (Street address: Phố Trúc Bạch, Phường Trúc Bạch, Quận Ba Đình)

reviews.author: Akihito K
reviews.title: Beautiful lake
reviews.content: Well worth a visit if for no other reason than to view and photograph the exposed roots of the trees growing out of the water.

reviews.author: Anirudh_Anand
reviews.title: Serene
reviews.content: The west lake is a great place to relax and enjoy the serenity. They have a track which makes a great place for an early morning run. The banks are filled with lots of cafes offering great coffee. I also happened to notice a couple of great bars around the west lake.

reviews.author: Subielover
reviews.title: A little too crowded on a Sunday afternoon
reviews.content: This is the largest lake in Hanoi and has been quite commercialized.  It was very busy and with the oppressive heat not overly comfortable.We enjoyed the lotus flower plantations.Not a lake to walk around the entire perimeter.

reviews.author: gadi b
reviews.title: Worth
reviews.content: Go there this season, all the lotus ponds ( in the east side) is blooming now, better early morning, when farmers are reaping the flowers and sell them. Also in this time the locals going out for morning exercise.

reviews.author: Robinjyates
reviews.title: Go by day and go by night
reviews.content: Within easy walking distance from Hanoi's old quarter is Den Ngoc Son, a shrine on West Lake. Well worth a visit if for no other reason than to view and photograph the exposed  roots of the trees growing out of the water. Also Vietnamese style bonsai  trees, the statues of Buddha and other deities plus one of the best gift shops we came across in Vietnam. Don't get confused with the inadequate signage the Marty's Monument is across Dinh Tien Hoang St. You can hire an electric cart and driver for only a few dollars NZ that will take you right around the lake and part of the Old Quarter  for an hour. Saves walking in the heat and being slow and open allows excellent photo and video opportunities. Do it by day and the do it again by night, the light displays are not as spectacular as Honk Kong, but very good in their own right.

reviews.author: Larry O
reviews.title: Great place to spend an afternoon
reviews.content: West lake is covered with coffee shops, somewhat low key bars, and restaurants all around it. The coffee shops are a great place to relax and look out over the water while enjoying a coffee or tea.There was one cafe where I sat across the street on a comfortable lawn chair, directly facing the lake while enjoying a nice cocktail on a warm late afternoon with a friend. Can't remember the name of the cafe, sorry!

reviews.author: Ron S
reviews.title: Staying at the Sheraton, it was not a lake to walk around
reviews.content: We were looking forward to either a walk around part of the lake (it really is big) or to a pagoda.  Whilst we found Vietnam to be generally clean and tidy, this area is not and we would be most uncomfortable there after dark.  The pathways are ripped up, all sorts of things stored on them, plus the rubbish and dog droppings.  It is the only place throughout the length of Vietnam that we retreated to the hotel and stayed in there.

reviews.author: aticus k
reviews.title: Beautiful lake and surrounds
reviews.content: West Lake is a huge area, I stayed in the Westlake area at the Intercontinental, and really enjoyed walking around the lake, lots of shops and restaurants catering to the upmarket suburb and the expat market.I also wandered around the lake edges, near the Sofitel, it was so nice , having a coffee at an cafe with seating across the rd on the lake edge.

reviews.author: dakotablue2013
reviews.title: "Beautiful views"
reviews.content: West lake is a big lake in Hanoi...our hotel was right on the lake and it was a nice place to take a walk and watch all the boats going by... there is a lot of restaurants near the lake along with some nice shops and relaxing places to sit and enjoy the view!!! enjoy!!!!

reviews.author: Daviddebbie972
reviews.title: Great walk around the lake
reviews.content: It's ok but not many things to do here.There are many good restaurantsThe atmosphere is nice.The lotus are beautifulThe lake is quite cleanCome here and walk around

reviews.author: jeraldcoolpianist
reviews.title: Very Big Lake
reviews.content: West Lake is one of the biggest lake and it has quite a few attraction. Similar to the Restored Sword Lake, you are able to see many locals exercising and socialising in the evening. One attraction is an ice-cream shop nearby that serve really delicious ice-cream

reviews.author: Osaka-Gaijin
reviews.title: upscale section of Hanoi
reviews.content: Westlake is full of upscale shops and new apartment buildings. It is the preferred area for foreigners living in Hanoi.  The lake itself is nothing special but there are some nice parks along the shores.

reviews.author: chavi2015
reviews.title: beautiful place
reviews.content: I visited this place many times .I like natural beauty thatswhy i like sunset in west lake.Enjoy green tea,coconut water ,lotus ponds with rosted sunfower seeds.....

reviews.author: Mandy M
reviews.title: The Lake
reviews.content: Sit and cool off with breeze across the water. Was surprised to have to pay to walk over the bridge, I think this should be free.

reviews.author: Zara M
reviews.title: Hoan Kiem is more lively, prettier too
reviews.content: This lake is not far from the Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, so you might as well walk there for a bit of a rest. The pagoda complex was closed the day we visited, so all we saw were locals fishing and PYTs picnicking. The heritage structures near the lake are not bad, though. And it's a quiet, green area. A nice break from the bustle and crowds of the Old Quarter, but not much to do.

reviews.author: Kurt C
reviews.title: If you rent a bike, make a tour!
reviews.content: It's nice and refreshing and you will cross different areasFrom may-july you can see the lotus flowers growing, they are beautiful.Having a drink next to the lake is a bit more expensive, but still cheap.

reviews.author: HannArdy
reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.content: We took a local bicycle taxi there for AUD$10 and what a fabulous area of the city! Many photo opps!

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: A big bit of water in the middle of Hanoi
reviews.content: We took in West Lake as part of our walk from Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum to the north. If you have seen one lake you have seen them all, but the local life that goes on around the area adds to the colour. Also there are a couple of historical pagodas and temples along the way.

reviews.author: biddy777
reviews.title: Cooling winds and riverside restaurants
reviews.content: a great area around the west lake is tay ho. full of boutique restaurants and cafes, the locations are beautiful, very upmarket and trendy with cuisine from all over the world and international chefs. There is a lot of night life here, with live bands and a great panorama of music. on the Xuan Dieu road which runs along the lake is full of restaurants, bars, cafes, chic clothing sores and much more.

reviews.author: 19Dave53
reviews.title: Very serene
reviews.content: One of the largest lake in Hanoi - during the late evening, it is nice to walk around the lake area, enjoying the breeze and you may be able to see some of the locals doing some fishing around the lake. Lovely and breathtaking sunset to view - have your camera handy for some beautiful shots..

reviews.author: gohomemumbai
reviews.title: Enjoyed the atmosphere
reviews.content: We walked around the lake one afternoon and enjoyed the ambience.  Beware the students wanting to start up a conversation, they can really take up a lot of your time.  Unfortunately we didn't see the lake in the early morning, just too tired to make the effort.

reviews.author: KiwiCzech
reviews.title: Great for a walk around
reviews.content: My wife and I stayed at Intercontinental West Lake and had beautiful lake view. On our final day we had some time to spare so decided on a walk around the lake. Started from hotel and it took us 3 hours 5 minutes.It was a great walk and we saw many different areas of Hanoi neighbourhoods but were very safe throughout. Parts of it involved being close to traffic but for the most part is was quiet and enjoyable. We even saw a live Eagle standing on fence post (see photo).If you enjoy walking, do it as it is very enjoyable.

reviews.author: amyctza
reviews.title: Fun on the lake
reviews.content: We took a swan peddle boat  out on the lake and it was fun. Pretty for sunsets. Don't eat anywhere nearby, typical tourist traps catering to large tour groups.

reviews.author: Cong X
reviews.title: nice sunset
reviews.content: The lake is bit away from the other tourist area, but the lake is a lot bigger than Huan Kiem Lake and the sunset is really amazing.

reviews.author: kenn123
reviews.title: The sea of calm
reviews.content: "Thou shalt not lie." The ruleless traffic in Hanoi is too much for anyone. It's not the amount of traffic but the lacking of rules is the main problem. When you stand in front of the West lake which is massive and endless, unlike the one in town centre; it takes you away from all the impact of the traffic congestion in the old quarter. You appreciate the vast space and peace it brings. You wish you could walk on that peaceful field of water and get away from the maddening traffic.

reviews.author: Hs656409
reviews.title: A nice area but too big to define
reviews.content: West Lake spans a huge area - so it is too big to take in at one visit. In fact the best way to see it all would be on a scooter if you're game.We went to the Pagoda and took some nice photos, but other than that it is popular amongst the locals. The locals like to hire the Swan boats and paddle out in the lake - a bit tacky for my tastes.

reviews.author: Nicola H
reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.content: Great for a walk. There is an interesting pagoda nearby which is worth visiting. Lake is polluted in some areas but still worth the walk.

reviews.author: My-Linh P
reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit
reviews.content: I personally think the best experience would be riding bicycle around the West Lake to appreciate Hanoian life around the area. Fresh air in the morning, light fog in the evening. West Lake is surrounded by wonderfully beautiful street such as Xuan Dieu, Lac Long Quan, etc. where you can experience a good cup of coffee, the flower market and, of course, a lot of yummy street food.

reviews.author: Bjorn O
reviews.title: Beautiful area with great potential for future development
reviews.content: I was lazy and toured the lake in a car.For people with time and stamina a one day walk around the lake should be fantastic.Less than 5 out of 17 km are uninteresting and there are restaurants and coffe shops virtually everywhere . The architecture of the buildings are varied and sometimes you may think that you are in nothern Italy with the narrow streets

reviews.author: Vulcan99
reviews.title: wonderful in the morning
reviews.content: it is wonderful if you could be at the West Lake in the early morning.You could feel the pure atmosphere and the wind bring some small amount of water from the lake to fill your face.at Thanh Nien (or young road), you walk on the pavement.See the people go by

reviews.author: Debab_63
reviews.title: Nice area to stroll
reviews.content: This wasn't necessarily on our list of things to do but one of our guides in another tour suggested it if we had time.  It is a lovely area to stroll around. Tran Quoc Pagoda is along there and also worth a look. It was very smoggy the day we went so the distant views weren't great and the lake is rather dirty. We didn't have any trouble with peddlers. On the way we stopped at Chau Long market which is a local produce market which we found very interesting.

reviews.author: dycwan
reviews.title: Not much to do
reviews.content: There is not much of a view, nor much to do. One sees a floating restaurant along with an abandoned ex-floating restaurant, all rusted up. Tragic reminder that things get old and die -- even boats.

reviews.author: rollwe
reviews.title: Big Lake in hanoi city
reviews.content: this lake is bigger more than hoan kiem lake But Borth this is good area. when you go to visit hanoi vietnam, you can go to visit 2 areas are very very Great view of this city.

reviews.author: benmart
reviews.title: Walking the Lake
reviews.content: Nice walk along the lake. Stopped by the Higlands Coffee boat on Ha Tay (the small adjacent lake). A few vendors, but nice when you say no.I was approached by a young chap on the west lake sidewalk who said he was a teacher and asked me to fill out a one page survey. The final note was his producing a note book with signatures of people that had "donated" for a cause he had produced an ID for.I politely declined and his smiles evaporated to a distinctive frown, accompanied by something in Vietnamese. I departed without incident.I would suggest a walk around the lake and the small pagoda, which was unfortunately closed on Thirsday when I visited.

reviews.author: Roman S
reviews.title: You should visit it
reviews.content: Awesome place, especially if you can use a motorbike. We drove around it, the lake is really beautiful, lots of good views in the sunset ) Don't forget your camera )

reviews.author: Li x
reviews.title: Excellent and faithful hotel
reviews.content: It/s my first time to Hanoi.  And I was so satisfied to spent my two wonderful days  within this excellent hotel.First of all , it has an excellent landview  because it is just beside the westlake which is the biggest lake in Hanoi(I guess so:) . the 11st restaurant is the wonderful place of view. you could easily watch the  streetscape and the beautiful westlake while drinking coffee   Second  , although it  is located near the main road beside the lake , but at the day it was  not so noisy like I ever thought . Actually it was really a quiet place for resting at the night. And it also have the clean and comfortable rooms too. I like the room/s colour.The third and the most important .   when I left the hotel and was on board the plane , I just found that I had been forgetted my IPAD in the hotel.  When I called the hotel at the following day,  the staff instantly found the thing I lost . And helped me to select the method to give back the thing to me  .What the most deserves to be mentioned above all is  the staff/s patience and their splendid english level。After all  it really did give me a big favor (think about the datas in the IPAD)!  Choosing his wonderful hotel  is  just like  found a faithful old friend, that/s all

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Bigest lake
reviews.content: This huge water feature lies to the west of Hanoi. There are actually two lakes here - the larger one called West Lake and a smaller one called White Silk Lake. Across the road from the White Silk Lake is a restaurant that offers a delightful buffet lunch with more than 70 variety of Vietnamese cuisine for only VND115000. A good place for quick try of Vietnamese specialties from the north, south and central parts of the country.

reviews.author: Ingriddebombay
reviews.title: Tirening trip
reviews.content: It was so crowded,  and one must be careful not to go during some feasts, then many places are closed, and people feast with their family, so we made a mistake thinking it will be fun in restaurants etc, with happy  atmosphere. But instead family stay together visiting one another.  Next time we will choice working period.

reviews.author: Eurodog2013
reviews.title: Great for exercise and people watching
reviews.content: Lots of room to walk - get up early to beat the crowds 😃 many people doing tai chi walking and sight seeing

reviews.author: Petta15
reviews.title: Nice for a stroll but beware
reviews.content: This was a lovely place for an afternoon stroll but beware of people approaching you as you may get robbed.  We were lucky as I was aware of the scams from other countries an d told my husband what was about to happen. We were approached by a man who wanted to ask questions for an "assignment".  Nearby was another man who passed us in the opposite direction then stopped to watch our interaction, I had seen them talking to each other earlier that the morning but now they didn't seem to know each other.  My husband told him we weren't interested and he walked away.  Later on our walk I saw them together again watching other tourists.  If you are approached just be polite, say no and keep walking.

reviews.author: Neve05
reviews.title: Tranquil
reviews.content: Visited the West Lake Pagoda  in the morning and it was fairly quiet. I found  a great sense of peace and tranquility here which is very unusual for me.  It  is certainly worth a visit.

reviews.author: nazrul
reviews.title: large lake
reviews.content: large lake, but not as beautiful as Hoan Kiem lake. nevertheless, if you happen to pass by, do stop and walk along the edge

reviews.author: Pierce_Rekk
reviews.title: The Locals seem to relax here
reviews.content: A lake in the middle of the bustling city, completely surrounded by traffic. Sit on the lake and ignore what going on bend you, and its surprisingly picturesque and calm.

reviews.author: Syd M
reviews.title: Chillax on West Lake!
reviews.content: In the center of Hanoi we sat on our balcony in Tay Ho and looked out at the West Lake every chance we got. Sure, we also went down and walked along the lake. Always found a quiet spot to 'chillax' when the noise got too much! As ArezzoNM mentions, the kids love the boat rides! Do that sometime during your stay in Hanoi, with or sans kids and you won't be sorry either way!

reviews.author: barbanddick
reviews.title: Surprising and Beauty
reviews.content: We were told that this is where John McCain was captured.  The lake is right in the center of Hanoi and is a place where locals and tourists go for quiet and beauty.  The city noise and bustle seem filtered out by the tranquillity of the spot.A worthwhile starting point for a tour of Hanoi.

reviews.author: ArezzoNM
reviews.title: Paddle Boat Fun for Kids on Lake
reviews.content: If you have kids this is a fun activity. If they are little kids you might want to go to the smaller Truc Bac lake to rent a paddle boat as the lake is much is smaller and you can see the shores easily. The bigger West Lake would probably appeal to older kids. It cost $4 USD for an hour for a swan paddleboat (NB: if you are a long legged adult your legs will be too long for the pedals). Boat seats two adults and one smallish child. Seats hard, so bring something to sit on.  In the day time, even on a Saturday we were the only people on the lake. (Most locals prefer to go in the evening).The rental station sells water and drinks. Bathroom nearby. Floating coffee shop next door.

reviews.author: SIG521
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.content: Very nice. A beautiful, relaxing area, in the middle of a large busy city. People enjoying the lake, doing Tij Chi.

reviews.author: barry h
reviews.title: Hanoi's secret gem.
reviews.content: This place is the best...not crowded, and excellent seafood restaurants. Try and go with a local.We went with David from Violet Hotel. He knows the best places.

reviews.author: pieata
reviews.title: Is this your thing????
reviews.content: A trip around the west lake, the biggest in Hanoi!!!TO ME, IT IS JUST A LAKE in a CITY!!!!!! Surrounded by expensive(you wouldn't think they all are) houses....SO what!!!!Not all cities have lakes within, so it is an ATTRACTION!!!

reviews.author: pnpee
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: Great view. Good atmosphere.Good for tourists, and for taking photos.Lots of exciting nightlife going on.Lots of bars, cafes, pubs, clubs, restaurants, shops.

reviews.author: ron P
reviews.title: Good landmarkwhen walking around old quarter
reviews.content: loved walking around the lake watching locals excercise ..photo shoots ..people dancing . Early morning is great time. When lost wanding streets I would ask for the lake. and then find the water Puppet theatre and I would be fine . As always carrying a hotel card will get you home but the lake is lovely place for people watching

reviews.author: Sarakit C
reviews.title: Beautiful area for a stroll
reviews.content: The walkway around the lake is worh a stroll where you can see the different architecture all along the perimeter.  There are intesting hawkers plying their goods - a quick look at the local lifestyle.

reviews.author: Mariloony
reviews.title: huge lake in central Hanoi
reviews.content: we drove around this lake on a tour and it was interesting to see how it is used by the local people. Not a 'stop off' place

reviews.author: MarkNewgate45
reviews.title: To stroll around
reviews.content: Big lake, fresh air (if you can find some around the city)fishermans, cha da on a tiny chair and some bats when the sun goes down..thats all.

reviews.author: bgarnett2015
reviews.title: Beautiful to walk around
reviews.content: This is really nice to walk around and you can take some exceptional photo's from anywhere along the edge of the lake. Keep an eye on your handbag though as there are quite a few people that watch you, but apart from that, it is definite place to go look at.

reviews.author: justinejanbe
reviews.title: most beautiful lake in hanoi
reviews.content: As Hanoi's largest lake, located right in the center of Hanoi, West Lake is abundant with many gardens, hotels, restaurants and other entertainment centers. For this reason, real estate prices near West Lake are staggering[1] and the surrounding quarters are often full of many imposingly large edifices occupied by wealthy Vietnamese people and expatriates.

reviews.author: Tran Bao An
reviews.title: Things to do at the West Lake
reviews.content: Ho Tay, the West Lake, is Hanoi's biggest lake. According to a legend, it was created when a Chinese buffalo mistook the sound of a bell of a pagoda for its mother's voice and ran away, creating the lake by stepping into a small hollow... It must have been a giant little buffalo!!! Ho Tay is a vast area of water, situated in the northwest of Hanoi. Some of the city's most expensive hotels are located there, the place to get the best coconut ice-cream (eaten out of a coconut) - located at the top end of the dike road between Truc Bach Lake and Ho Tay, a 3-storey ice-cream place -, the Highlands Coffee with its chill-out ship and many things more (e.g. pagodas!)... An afternoon is easily spent at Ho Tay, especially if you include a cruise with a tourist boat. Combining Ho Tay with a visit to the nearby Ho Chi Minh Museum and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is useful

reviews.author: peahead1
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: Thought this was going to be some kind of 'beauty spot' to chill out and sit around watching life go by...Nope, its murky, greenish-blue'brown, quiet and empty and no real 'soul' to it! Oh and I stopped and sat at a cafe for a coffee... and two big fish popped out of a plastic bag that had been dumped near my foot! Random, funny, but not the 'wow' factor I was hoping for!

reviews.author: Thanhmvo
reviews.title: not to be confused with Hoan Kiem lake
reviews.content: West Lake is in the North End of Hanoi and the best way to visit is by motor bike. I took a bike tour around the lake and stop to chat with some friendly locals. Had good weather so lots of people were out and about. Great place to hang out and get away from the hustling and bustling of downtown Hanoi. The shore length is around 17km according to Wikipedia. Lots of restaurants, shops and private homes around the lake. A great place to chill:)

reviews.author: Aussie_Tourer_62
reviews.title: Great walk around
reviews.content: This is a lovely lake and worthy of a walk around it which can be done comfortably in about 40 minutes. Some good little cafes around the edge that may be worthy of a brief stop.

reviews.author: Jayceebee31
reviews.title: Tranquil
reviews.content: We enjoyed the city walk around the lake, especially at night.Great Architecture of buildings surround it and very close to puppet show.

reviews.author: 442joseph
reviews.title: Beautiful lake
reviews.content: This lake is central to Hanoi city. It has many lights at night and its great place for walking and training outside in the morning and evening. Many English learning students will come and talk with you and ask you questions. Don't be afraid they have a assignment from school to do !!! Take a picture with them and enjoy the ride. You will also see many people taking marriage pictures on the lake, join them they love it.

reviews.author: An old gentle dog
reviews.title: Lots of beautiful Vietnamese brides
reviews.content: There were lots of beautiful Vietnamese brides taking wedding photos along the lake side. Most of them were willing to be photographed by tourists. Enjoy.

reviews.author: Terry K
reviews.title: Hanoi highlight
reviews.content: If the West Lake is a highlight of Hanoi then that tells you everything about Hanoi. The Lake is not very big - takes about 20 minutes to stroll round it. The water is green!

reviews.author: gypsysing
reviews.title: Go fishing
reviews.content: Lots of people catching their fresh fish from the lake and lots enjoying their ever present ice coffee near the water.

reviews.author: artalmon
reviews.title: Rolling around the Lake
reviews.content: Every Sunday, after Sushi at the lake, I ride the scooter around the lake. One Sunday clockwise, the next counter-clockwise, for the difference in view. Depending which way I go, I have coffee at the south-west corner or the by the small lake. There are plenty of restaurants and coffee shops. I find it very relaxing to ride the scooter around the lake, great compensation for the stress of the weekdays.

reviews.author: Espanatraveller
reviews.title: Packed
reviews.content: It was just a short walk here from our hotel so we took an amble over but as it was a sunday, the place was packed with tourists and thousands of locals.  Nice but we weren't able to take any photos without someone walking past the lens.  Try to go on a week day.

reviews.author: Satya P
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: West lake is really AWESOME... Loved going there. So serene and so tranquil. Its a must visit for those visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: Daniel A
reviews.title: It Depends?
reviews.content: If your idea of seeing a multitude of expats in a nice community, then go to West lake. However, if you want to see Vietnamese in their typical community, then go to Lake of the Restored Sword For that matter there's no reason to step out of Old Quarter if you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: david g
reviews.title: A Pleasant Break
reviews.content: Getting away from it all can be difficult in Hanoi. At these times, a leisurely stroll (or jog) along the promenade around West Lake is just the thing!

reviews.author: Dave D
reviews.title: Don't waste your time
reviews.content: Expat zone, no soul.  This area is full of French and other foreign residents that work in Hanoi.If you are in Hanoi to experience the city culture, avoid, unless you just wish to get some exercise and cycle around it.  Even that isn't really very attractive.

reviews.author: Helen A
reviews.title: A bit of peace and calm in an otherwise manic city.
reviews.content: We liked this spot best of all in Hanoi. Right in the heart of the city is this peaceful lake which exudes a feeling of calm in a very chaotic noisy city.

reviews.author: youngshep
reviews.title: People, people, people
reviews.content: A nice place to  walk  in  the city and get away from the motorbikes for a bit.  Nice to relax and chill.

reviews.author: ChandonPictures
reviews.title: Just a lake
reviews.content: Many more beautiful sights to be seen in Vietnam. Fun to see the local in the morning doing their exercise though.

reviews.author: JCB38_60
reviews.title: Worth a taxi ride to visit
reviews.content: Outside the old quarter, the lake is calming for a gentle stroll. The pagoda was busy with tourists but interesting to see.

reviews.author: Charlise B
reviews.title: Hanoi's beauty
reviews.content: West Lake is a beautiful place to while away an afternoon, there are boats for hire and lunch on a floating restaurant makes a novel dining option. Notable points of interest at West Lake include Tran Quoc Pagoda which was built in the 6th century making it Vietnam’s oldest temple.Tran Quoc Pagoda resides on a small island built by King Ly Nam De as a cultural symbol of Vietnamese Buddhism. The pagoda is particularly stunning when viewed early evening at sunset. The other main attraction is Quan Thanh Temple located at the West Lake crossroads of Thanh Nien Street and Quan Thanh Street.

reviews.author: ngadang87
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.content: I live here so I know its value. Wake up in the morning, jogging, walking or riding and enjoy the pure air from the Lake. At night, go to a pub or try some street food, amazing :).

reviews.author: veturpin
reviews.title: Lovely peaceful site.
reviews.content: My husband and I walked to this lake several times during our stay in the old quarter. It is fun in the day or night. Lot's of family's out strolling. Great place to people watch. In the evening it is all lit up and the lights reflect in the lake.

reviews.author: NguyenLuyen
reviews.title: Hidden Charm Beauty of Hanoi
reviews.content: Known as the biggest lake, West Lake is listed top destination in Hanoi. You can walk around lake or sit at a coffee shop nearby lake to feel the best moment of lifetime.....

reviews.author: Philip L
reviews.title: A good place to visit under nice weather
reviews.content: The name West Lake reminds me of the West Lake in Hangzhou, China. They do look alike to some extent especially the size.  The lake side is a good place to loiter when the weather is sunny but in the 20s.  The temples and relics are probably interesting to see but over the TET period, there are too many people. And it seems that the city hasn't made enough efforts to facilitate tourists with signage and tourism information centers.

reviews.author: Brenton K
reviews.title: Good view of lake
reviews.content: We walked to the lake from the old quarter. Had something to eat on the lakes edge in a cafe. The view of the lake is nice and peaceful. Plenty of people out in the swan paddle boats. Its is nice clean area without the noise of the old quarter.

reviews.author: rama1
reviews.title: A great way to sample life in a busy city
reviews.content: Noisy, loud, busy.  Fun.Loved the way the locals were just having a good time.  We were there Chinese new year so maybe a bit busier than usual.Have a wander, grab a coffee and watch the world go by.Getting there and getting back involves crossing some roads, which is a LOT of fun.

reviews.author: vtailor81
reviews.title: A crowded lake with a small pagoda
reviews.content: Not worth the walk in my opinion. It is a nice enough lake and can imagine it would be nice early morning but we found it crowded. What made it worse was a huge number of scooters mounting the footpath and beeping at us to move. The footpath around the lake is not very wide so having scooters driving aggressively at you spoils the whole experience of the lake.

reviews.author: Merilyn_S_12
reviews.title: Lovely place to sit and watch the world go by
reviews.content: Well this is a little gem that we only discovered on our last day in Hanoi. Shame we didn't find it earlier. Definitely go here, it's a lovely walk around a lake, that is bustling with local life from Hanoi.  We enjoyed a little sit down on this lake, and were able to watch Vietnam go by.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Morning walk
reviews.content: walk around the lake in the morning. You can visit a temple in the way.South of the lake you can find a top end luxury mall.

reviews.author: nellie5555
reviews.title: A lovely place to spend a morning
reviews.content: It was lovely to find this quiet lake in the middle of a chaotic city.We watched the fishermen fishing and had lunch near the lake.We actually stumbled on to the lake by accident as the Ho chi Minh mausoleum wasn't open on a Monday so we just kept walking and found this lovely place.

reviews.author: Pernille E
reviews.title: Nice open space
reviews.content: If you need some air, then this is a nice place to go.. There are some nice restaurants and it is a nice place just to sit and watch the daily life of Vietnamese people :)

reviews.author: Glenn C
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.content: This place is fascinating because of the view and the Pogoda that sits on the late. The pagoda is awe-inspiring very spiritual both day and night. This late offers a lot of various views of the areas around the late in that part of the city.  All of Hanoi's lakes have their own unique inspirations and atmospheres. This late is probably my favorite.

reviews.author: grahamteys
reviews.title: A picturesque lake near the city center
reviews.content: How many large cities have such a beautiful lake almost in the center of the city. We were fortunate to wake up every morning with a fabulous view of the lake as we were staying at the Intercontinental Hotel which has rooms sitting out in the lake itself.
