reviews.content: The waitress was super friendly. The food was ok,  with the pork cha being really tasty. The restaurant was mucky, sticky tables, condiments and contents have seen better days but it's cheap enough to visit and say you've been.

reviews.author: ckthyap
reviews.title: Tasty
reviews.content: Place is clean and the food marvelous. One of the best Bun Cha in town. The manager, Amy , very friendly and serve us rice wine, compliment from the restaurant. She recommended us to a nice and famous dessert shop nearby. Will drop by again during our next visit to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Akshayne
reviews.title: Lovely service
reviews.content:
We had a lovely dinner here. Thao, the waitress was very helpful and full of recommendations and tips about Hanoi.
The food was simply and yet so tasty! Would definitely have it again

reviews.author: Rosiet13782
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Really nice Bun Cha! Best we found in Hanoi!! Great service and such good value - came here twice on our trip!

reviews.author: Caitlin B
reviews.title: Great bun cha and wonderful service from Thao
reviews.content: We had some delicious bun cha for dinner nearby our hostel. Great little restaurant and friendly service from Thao, who shared with us some of her knowledge about Hanoi and Vietnam. Thanks!! Would recommend.

reviews.author: Svsaramarie
reviews.title: Delicious food, great service and a lovely evening!!
reviews.content: I came here during my first night in Vietnam, and was not disappointed. The soup was delicious, the beer cold, and Thuy made great recommendations, and even sat down for all to me when she realized I was dining alone. I will definitely go back!

reviews.author: hyenasgohaha
reviews.title: Yummy! With great service (:
reviews.content:
Bun cha is so yummy! A humble dish of rice noodles with soup and springrolls, served with herbs, but so good.

Great customer service! My server, Thuy, was very friendly and happy to serve wherever she can. She strikes up conversations with the customers, making them feel very welcome 😊

reviews.author: Jeremy Yong
reviews.title: Good grilled pork, and cheap
reviews.content: Food is good, but not exceptional. Grilled pork is tasty and served inside a sweet and sour soup. Adding cut chilli into the soup definitely makes it more interesting ! Soup can be abit too sweet for my preference. Hygiene in the restaurant can be further improved but for the cheap price, really good value for money.

reviews.author: Anthony Y
reviews.title: Solid Bun Cha
reviews.content: Love Bun Cha, so had to look for some before I jetted. Found this one in the old quarter. Comfortable restaurant and decent service (from Thuy). The bun cha was very good and it's opened later than the street stalls.

reviews.author: Reisender_ohne_Ziel
reviews.title: Good bun cha
reviews.content: The bun cha was very good and the waitress Thao was very friendly and explained me the food and the way how to eat it.

reviews.author: amandasharpe1@hotmail.com
reviews.title: Simple, tasty Vietnamese street food
reviews.content: This is a simple Vietnamese street food restaurant ...if you can, sit upstairs where you sit on low, shared tables which are surprisingly comfortable!  The menu is simple and the food is good, tasty and fresh.  The staff (in particular Thuy) are fun and friendly and love to chat to customers. Give it a try for some genuine local fare.

reviews.author: Feebs
reviews.title: Great flavour and service
reviews.content: Great flavour of the pork, noodles and sauce altogether. What impressed me the most is the hospitality of Thuy, she made us feel so welcomed and even taught us how to eat the noodles :) Definitely a must come!

reviews.author: Jin Ping B
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: Was greeted by a friendly Thuy and she explained to us in detail how to eat the Bun Cha. First time experience, loved the pork balls! Would come again :) very near famous egg coffee place too.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Sensational tradition Vietnamese
reviews.content: It started with Thuy, our young charismatic hostess for the night. She taught us how to eat in correct order, what was best to pair and even helped my partner with her chopstick skills. After everything was said and done she gave us a little present called Happy Water! I'm not sure if we should be thankful or sorry for ourselves but either way, I would rate her service 5/5  and is definitely worth checking out this well priced restaurant!

reviews.author: Saed W
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Great food friendly staff come here for good food :)  Thuy was amazing and very nice can’t wait to come back :-) I had the food in the photos with rice wine please do try it !!!!!

reviews.author: Jessica N
reviews.title: Delicious Vietnamese street
reviews.content:
Delicious Vietnamese street food with vegetarian option. Great service from Thuy she explained everything very well and gave us great tips where to go.

handhelped us

reviews.author: Jane J
reviews.title: Absolute Must try. Best Bun Cha
reviews.content:
I visited with my young daughter.  We were welcomed and had to remove our shoes outside dining area upstairs.  
Very traditional custom.  The Bun Cha Ta No 2 was plentiful and extremely tasty - there was plenty of meat and veg - and the broth was  yummmmmy!!
Furled for next stop we left this restaurant happy, full and rearing to go.   Definitely worth a visit

reviews.author: CheeBoon
reviews.title: Great Hospitality & Food
reviews.content:
Thuy our host has been most hospitable serving us Bun Cha Ta. She said she failed English miserably in University and wanted the opportunity to speak the language. We felt there’s huge potential in this country waiting to explode and bloom. 
The dinner consisted of fried pork balls, spring rolls and rice noodles eaten with a stock made from sugar, fish sauce, carrot and papaya. Very popular and busy restaurant, worth a try in Hanoi.

reviews.author: BennyLovers
reviews.title: Bun Cha Tourist Trap
reviews.content:
We were recommended this restaurant by our hotel, but unfortunately it is a complete tourist trap. There are no locals eating there, only tourists, and the food is pretty terrible. In the end we stayed there not more than 15 minutes, eating the unenjoyable and overpriced bun cha (including meat that was way too dry) and fled from the unwelcoming surrounding.

This was the only unsatisfying meal we had in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Elly George
reviews.title: Absolute MUST!
reviews.content: The atmosphere was very calming. We even had to take our shoes off which made the experience even more relaxing. I have traveled around Vietnam and Hanoi was my last stop. I can honestly say that the food there was the best and most delicious traditional food I have tried in Vietnam. Definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Steve W
reviews.title: Delicious food!
reviews.content: Delicious food, fun atmosphere! Not much English, but that was not a problem! We are a family of 7 and they managed to seat us together! I would come here again.

reviews.author: SpiM55
reviews.title: Excellent traditional Hanoi dish
reviews.content: We have been recommended by our hotel staff and we were not deceived. First, we didn't know this traditional dish.  Great to discover it for our last dinner in Hanoi.  Second, Thao, our waitress, has been amazing. Her kindness, her availability, and her explanation about the dish and how to eat made our dinner and time in Bun Cha Ta restaurant, an "unforgettable time.

reviews.author: Jerris Sunny
reviews.title: Bun cha ta 😍
reviews.content: The food was delicious and the people there were super friendly.. @Thuy.. you were a lovely person to interact with !! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Marina
reviews.title: Always lovely
reviews.content: Always a lovely meal, food is delicious. Nicd atmosphere, good prices. The waitress Thuy is especially nice :)

reviews.author: Jaf8130
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.content:
This place has the best Bun Cha, so tasty and delicious. It is a warm soup with meatballs and pork that you add herbs and salad, noodles and spring rolls to. The result is a delicious comforting meal.

We last came here when on holidays 2 years ago and it is just as good now.

reviews.author: Sophia L.
reviews.title: The TASTE of hospitality
reviews.content: If you've ever wondered how hospitality would taste like, you can taste it here. Delicious food and very friendly staff. My server, named Thao, was all smiles and very kind. Upon serving you the dish, she would politely ask if you know how to eat bun cha and if you didn't she would enthusiastically teach you how. Great experience eating bun cha here.

reviews.author: Liz W
reviews.title: Ok dinner
reviews.content: Had dinner here. Ordered bun cha ta. Veggies were fresh. Pork was flavorful. WiFi worked. There were outlets too. My friends raved about this place, saying they came back multiple times. I ate this as my last meal and thought it was overhyped. It wasn't bad, but I would've preferred another last meal in Hanoi

reviews.author: Gillian L
reviews.title: Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: My husband and I were very excited to eat Bun Cha when coming to Hanoi, since it was the dish Obama had when he came to visit. We came to Bun Cha Ta during a food tour and were very happy. (There are plenty of Bun Cha options in town, hard to select the best one since they all claim they’re #1). The broth is light and clear and the spring rolls were delicious we had to come back the next day for round 2 where we were served by Thuy who was very friendly and helpful. Delicious food and friendly staff, made for a good meal!

reviews.author: Andrew Tan
reviews.title: Bun Cha
reviews.content: Bun Cha is excellent here!!  Look for Thuy when you are here!  Ask for Ruou drink, she will give you free!!

reviews.author: Asier M
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.content: Good food and Thuy, the waitress, very nice! The price is cheap, chiquen and rice delicious. Hope see you soon!

reviews.author: Duck Horse
reviews.title: Amazing - must visit!
reviews.content:
Our hotel recommended we go here as it served the best bun cha in Hanoi - they were right. The food was amazing and reasonably priced.

Thank you to Thuy, who suggested dishes to try as well as local sites to visit - she was extremely friendly and helpful.

Will 100% be going back again!

reviews.author: Catherine D
reviews.title: Thanks to My
reviews.content: Really good restaurant, totally recommend this place. The food is so tasty and not expensive. Great atmosphere. Special thank you to My, she was an amazing waitress, very sociable, she spoke to us about the Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: komal n
reviews.title: Great service, amazing food!!
reviews.content: I had the spring rolls here, which were very fresh and tasty, came with a side off a green leafy&herby salad which was a great accompaniment. A nice spacious airy clean place to sit in and to top it off the customer service was excellent - I was served by Julia, she was very friendly and attentive, I have a few dietary restrictions so she talked me through the full menu and explained what I couldn’t have and gave some great suggestions. An all round great experience highly recommend

reviews.author: traveltime94
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Found this restaurant due to previous reviews, and it did not disappoint!! The seating arrangements were very traditional vietnamese which was lovely. The staff were very friendly and made us feel very welcome. And the food was amazing! We had the bun cha with a mix of spring rolls and it was all so tasty. Our main waitress was called Thuy and she was very lovely, explaining to us how to eat the food correctly and also spoke with us about Hanoi and things we should try. Would 100% recommend!

reviews.author: Rene F
reviews.title: Great food!
reviews.content:
First we ordered the combi (springrol, noodles, herbs and pork), but as it was so good we ordered one extra noodles with pork.

The restaurants looked very clean and the atmosphere was good. Further, service was also good since miss Thuy was very friendly and also helped us how to eat the Bun Cha (was our first time).

Including three drinks we paid around 240K vnd, so quite cheap too. Would really recommend this place!

reviews.author: Anneleen
reviews.title: Great local food
reviews.content: We went to this restaurant because of the positive reviews on tripadvisor and were not disappointed! The restaurant has a local vibe, but is great for tourists as well. The spring rolls were amazing. My was a very attentive waitress and helped my friend figure out which dishes were gluten free.

reviews.author: Jonah S
reviews.title: Delicious food and great conversation!
reviews.content: We enjoyed a delicious Bun Cha Ta full option and our server Thuy was very nice to us. We had a pleasant conversation and a great time!

reviews.author: Ron H
reviews.title: Fantastic little spot
reviews.content: I was walking for hours and was drawn in by the air conditioning when I passed the door. Decided to give it a try... it was worth it. The food was fantastic! Thuy and the rest of the waitresses were fantastic. Friendly and great suggestions on items to order. I’ve been in twice on a short 3 day visit. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Yip Song C
reviews.title: Worth the visit!!!
reviews.content: Must try in Hanoi Old Quarter, reasonable price with great taste profile!!! We went on the first night when we first arrived & also the last night before we departed. The staffs are friendly and willing to show u the way to eat it if u are a first timer. Vietnamese coffee and egg coffee are good too!!

reviews.author: Caitlin Phillips
reviews.title: Excellent Hanoi street food
reviews.content: Really good food and extremely friendly waitress who showed us how to eat the dishes and also gave us plum wine to try. Great prices and delicious authentic Vietnamese Bun Cha, meat and vegetarian.

reviews.author: GrahamP66
reviews.title: Great food at a reasonable price
reviews.content: Typical Vietnamese food. Service was good although a little 'fast food' feel to it but worth a visit.

reviews.author: Alex_Ioana
reviews.title: A very tasty Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha we have been served here was extremely tasty! I appreciated the traditional environment as well. Definitely recommend this place to whoever is new to vietnamese cuisine, before starting with the street food.

reviews.author: Joselien1
reviews.title: Delicious food, great atmosphere
reviews.content: Had an amazig dinner at Bun Cha Ta, would certainly recommend the spring rolls. Atmosphere is really great as well. Our waiter My was super friendly and explained us how we were suppose to eat and combine everything, she's amazing!

reviews.author: Swissie78
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: Fantastic Bun Cha Ta and very friendly staff. Great and authentic experience. Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Mark W
reviews.title: Amazing food and excellent service.
reviews.content:
I've never had better Bun Cha, the food was amazing, and my waitress 'My' was an exceptional and made me feel right at home from the moment I walked in. 10/10.

I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: Greathouse
reviews.title: Good food
reviews.content: we ate in this restaurant and we were really happy to be in this delicious dishes. Hopefully be back

reviews.author: Anja M
reviews.title: Awesome! So so good
reviews.content: We LOVED our lunch here. It was about $10 USD for 2 people, with 2 sodas. Amazing flavor, great service, and would go back in a heartbeat. Chose this one over the “Obama & Bourdain” one, just due to not being as touristy.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.title: don't judge a book by its cover
reviews.content: Doesn't look very appetizing at first, but it turns out to be nice. We tried the set with spring rolls, its nice if you like a bit sour food. Egg coffee is good!

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.title: Locally claimed best Bun Cha, and pretty much so.
reviews.content:
Hostel we were staying at recommended it to us to go give it a try. Not disappointed though. Surprisingly happy with the barbecued pork meat and balls in the soup. 

albeit a weeee bit pricier than street food, probably because of the space rental. But otherwise the food is really good. Spring rolls are a gem and DAMN i love nep cam so I ordered one too and it never disappoints.

reviews.author: Bella S
reviews.title: Delicious food, great vibes
reviews.content: The food was absolutely delicious and we loved the ambience of the restaurant. Thao, our waitress, was so kind and friendly and gave us lots of great information about Vietnam! Thank you!

reviews.author: Haley R
reviews.title: So yummy!
reviews.content: We had the traditional meal and it was so good. The broth was amazing. Thao was our waitress, she was so sweet, kind, and friendly. Great experience overall!

reviews.author: Marian0907
reviews.title: Best choice!!!
reviews.content:
It's really tasty with the soup (meet balls inside) and 2 seafood spring rolls! And server Thao, so kind and helps me how to eat, shows me lots of useful informations!! 
Great!!! I'll be back!!!

reviews.author: Fleur F
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content:
This small little place is a must visit in Hanoi. 
The full bun cha meal comes with a beautiful bowl of soup with fresh greens, a pile of rice noodles and a huge side of garlic and ginger also 3 spring rolls. 
It is one unbelievable dish all at a cost of NZD$8 with a beer. Couldn’t get better. 
And as you leave they give you a little shot of home made whiskey, just to keep you in your toes whilst crossing the road 🤣

reviews.author: Rachel Green
reviews.title: Good
reviews.content: This place is the right place to find delicious Bun cha. The fish sauce is good. Besides, the pork is really great, too.

reviews.author: Maylee
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Bun cha is one of the best foods i’ve tried in Vietnam. The pork was soft and delicious. Besides, rolls are amazing, too. Definitely worth it!

reviews.author: tuttasara
reviews.title: The BEST bun Cha in Hanoi - don’t miss it!
reviews.content: Bun cha is my favorite Viet dish so I had tried a few in the city. This is my favorite by far. Soup, rolls, pork meat... everything is so delish I came few times! Also the place is very special, you eat in the second floor, barefoot (japanese style)- you can have the egg coffee too! staff is great and Mi was specially attentive. Enjoy bun cha!

reviews.author: Zachary inouye
reviews.title: Delicious food, great service
reviews.content: Really delicious food and the server Thao was very helpful and friendly. Definitely recommend trying this place if you have a chance.

reviews.author: JeffreyDantes
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: The food and atmosphere is great here! Our server Thao taught us how to eat bun cha and even gave us a shot of their white wine at the end.

reviews.author: Amy O
reviews.title: Best spring rolls we've ever had
reviews.content:
We visited here tonight and the food and service were amazing. Thao served us and was an absolute delight, so friendly and helpful. The spring rolls were to die for. Will definitely be returning.

We paid 215k for two meals and two drinks, which was great value in our opinion.

reviews.author: Libby C
reviews.title: Delicious and easy introduction to Bun Cha
reviews.content: I've been back here twice during my trip to Hanoi, because I'm basically addicted to Bun Cha now.  The service is lightening fast-- my waitress, Thao, had the meal there for me almost before I blinked.  On my first trip, Thao kindly explained to me how to eat Bun Cha (I think I would have put all the noodles in at once and made a giant mess if she hadn't told me the noodles were to be added a little at a time).  On my second trip, Thao remembered me, which was very nice!  The food here is fresh and delicious, very easy to order as the menu has an English translation.  I'm probably going to bring a friend here next week!

reviews.author: japrestone
reviews.title: Holy Bun Cha moly
reviews.content:
This is probably the best food I’ve ever eaten and I’m not a simpleton who’s only ever eaten fish and chips...
They’re so quick and professional. The girls who served me, My and Nga were exceptional, they taught me some Vietnamese pronunciations that I’ve no doubt forgotten, that’s to no fault of their own as I was enjoying the rice whiskey and I have a bad memory at the best of times.
The food is spot on. I wake up in the morning with a hangover, don’t want to move, force myself to go out and get Bun Cha from here and I’m reinvigorated.
6/5 would eat here every day if I could. 
Thank you for bringing this into my life.

reviews.author: c_wagstaff
reviews.title: Gorgeous food in a simple setting
reviews.content: We returned to this place having encountered it during a stop on a street food tour - we liked it so much we wanted the opportunity try more of the menu and relax for a little longer over our meal. We had the traditional pork soup with fresh herbs and noodles on the side, and both vegetarian and meat fried spring rolls. We like the way you can flavour your own dish with herbs, garlic and chilli so it is just to your own liking and the herbs are fresh and diverse. The spring rolls (both versions) were also incredibly fresh and flavoursome and much better quality than ones we had previously tried elsewhere on the street food tour. Staff were very friendly and guided people through the dish and how to act in their restaurant (shoes off at the entrance to the dining area) in a kind and considerate manner. We had a wonderful meal and wouldn’t hesitate to return if we find ourselves back in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Rj Bulao
reviews.title: Good soup
reviews.content: The soup is a little bit sweet but the pork is very good. Nice service from the server, Thao as well

reviews.author: dlazarus6
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.content: Incredible food and incredible service.  The Bun Cha, spring rolls, and coffee are all equally exceptional. You must come here when in Hanoi!  Cannot recommend enough.

reviews.author: Bee
reviews.title: Bun cha ta(mazing)!
reviews.content: We had a great meal at Bun Cha Ta! After hearing about this restaurant from a friend it was our first meal in Hanoi and set the bar very high! The food was delicious, very affordable and arrived very quickly. On top of the food Thao made our lunch experience even better! She was so sweet!! Thao gave us recommendations, taught us about the food and was very social, it was great speaking with her. Highly recommend this restaurant to other travellers. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Lexy78
reviews.title: Delicious Food
reviews.content: We had a lovely lunch at Bun Cha Ta served by Thao. We took her menu recommendation and enjoyed the authentic setting, delicious food and excellent service. Well worth a visit ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Delicious and great value
reviews.content: We went here for our first meal on arrival in Vietnam. Glad we did as it set a high standard with very good food, especially the soup, and very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Rebecca tate
reviews.title: Best food I've had in Asia!
reviews.content:
This bun cha is the best food I've had in my 3 weeks in Vietnam. My meal was 100,000d ($5 US) and I couldn't possibly eat any more. Aside from the ridiculously delicious specialty that is bun cha, you also get spring rolls included in the meal to dip into your bun cha and they are incredible!
I have coeliac disease and find it hard to eat gluten free food on the street and in restaurants but this food was naturally gluten free and the server knew exactly what I was talking about and explained to me all the ingredients.
Finally and most importantly, the service here is amazing and I've not had better service at a restaurant anywhere in Asia. Amy asked if she could chat with us and we invited her to sit down, we chat about where we are from and she was so lovely and passionate about the food. She had a big smile on her face the whole time and epitomises the lovely Vietnamese people.
I recommend bun cha ta to everyone who loves authentic food!

reviews.author: Ichigo
reviews.title: Great Food and Service
reviews.content: The food there was great, and service was good too! We reached the restaurant around 9pm+ but they still took our orders and did not seem to rush us (though of course, we tried to eat faster). A waitress named My was very friendly and recommended us places with good coffee! 😁 Satisfied!

reviews.author: Mariana S
reviews.title: Great experience!!
reviews.content: We were trying Bun Cha for the first time and were not disappointed. Very nice and tasty meal!! But the highest point of the evening was meeting Amy who was attending our table. She explained everything about the dish, how to eat it and how it was cooked. We asked more about Vietnam food and traditions and she was very kind and attentive answering everything, telling us curious facts and even giving us tips for our next day in Hanoi. We had a lovely time!!

reviews.author: susan1819
reviews.title: Okay...
reviews.content:
Sat upstairs. The stairs are steep & having to take off your shoes before entering while there is a crowd makes it quite a tricky experience.
The menu is simple and there are sets which quite a few restaurants now put on their menu to take the burden off the unfamiliar.
All offer bun cha- grilled minced pork in soup. A plate of rice noodles and a basket of herbs makes up the meal that comes (if part of a set) with fried spring rolls- the seafood tastes better than the chicken by the way. The grilled pork in the soup is tasty but lacked spice that such ASIAN food often offers.
The bun cha soup was warm which was the first let down for me. It was rather sweet and a dash of fish sauce didn’t tone down the sweet. Add your preferred amount of noodles and herbs to make your meal.
The place was crowded even at 6pm - mostly tourists who were either recommended by hotel or social media.
Staff are pleasant. Worth a try if unsure of street food but personally, would not make the trip for another meal.

reviews.author: Lucia.xiii
reviews.title: air con bun cha for summer day
reviews.content: If you felt so exhausted with the heat during the summer time in Vietnam, this could be the thing you need. The quality is just okay and kinda have the reheat process here but the food came out quite quick.

reviews.author: Gabby
reviews.title: A good meal upon arrival
reviews.content:
Soup was a tad bit too sweet and thick for my liking. The pork was tasty but a little chewy. Still a good bowl of bun cha.
Service was good with a pretty enthusiastic lady Thao introducing the dishes, how to eat them, offering a taste of potent house wine made from ginger. 
Thank you!

reviews.author: Maxi R
reviews.title: Best Street Food in Hanoi
reviews.content: Delicious spring Rolls, good Price, very lovely service, especially the girl Thai! Very typical for Hanoi!

reviews.author: Dhrity
reviews.title: Amazing Vietnamese food and delightful service
reviews.content: We visited this quant little restaurant in Hanoi on the recommendation of the staff of our hotel, and it did not disappoint. We loved the seating arrangements. And the staff took care to explain their dishes on the menu. The food was very tasty and one of the best we had while in Hanoi. The spring rolls were divine. We were very glad we visited this restaurant, and would recommend anyone visiting Hanoi to definitely give this place a try

reviews.author: Emma Y
reviews.title: Very Friendly Staff
reviews.content: The food was delicious and all of the staff were extremely friendly. Thao was awesome and made sure we had everything we needed! Definitely stop by here if you're in Hanoi.

reviews.author: James J
reviews.title: Super Friendly Staff
reviews.content: The bun Cha was good and the egg coffee was great. The staff were very friendly and helpful there. I would recommend it.

reviews.author: Phonevilay J
reviews.title: Bun Cha Fix
reviews.content: Great bun cha with a decent atmosphere. The place is quite busy, so book in advance. Good egg coffee, too.

reviews.author: 181ShellBell
reviews.title: Good Traditional Nem
reviews.content:
We ate at this restaurant because we were staying in the French Quarter and I needed a Bun Cha fix.  

This is a nice place with 3 levels.  We sat on level 2.  The service was quick and the waitress was helpful especially when other guests asked how they should eat the Bun Cha.

I personally found the Bun Cha broth and meatballs lacking a little in flavour.  But i have to say that the Traditional Nem (pork spring rolls) were the best that we have had during our Hanoi visit.

reviews.author: Mr C
reviews.title: Amazing food, great price!
reviews.content: This was our first time eating in Vietnam and definitely would come back. The waitress Thao is amazing! She is very helpful and can tell you a lot of information about the dishes :) definitely recommmend, the food was great!

reviews.author: Lily F
reviews.title: Delicious food
reviews.content: Went here on a good tour and have been back ourselves a few times as well. It is delicious! And had a good vego bun cha too. Lots of seating upstairs and good service. Would recommend if you’re after some traditional vietnamese street food!

reviews.author: Catcatmeow
reviews.title: Best Vietnamese cuisine and experience ever! Highlight of my trip!
reviews.content: The waitresses were super nice and were very helpful in helping us choose from the menu. It was my first meal in Vietnam and the best so far! The food was extremely delicious, tasty and fresh! We ordered Bun Cha and Spring rolls and they were the best I've ever had and will ever have. I had a small crush on the waitress, but don't tell her! Will definitely go to Bun Cha Ta again in my future Vietnam trips!

reviews.author: Where the Locals Roam
reviews.title: A Great Introduction to Bun Cha
reviews.content:
This was my first time having bun cha, but it certainly won't be the last. Came here on a Sunday evening and was able to get a seat without a problem -- there are a couple of floors, much bigger than it looks! You have to take your shoes off before entering any of the dining areas. 

Ordered the #2 (bun cha) and watermelon juice, which was super refreshing after a day wandering around in 108 degree heat.

The staff were friendly, and food came out pretty quickly. The broth was amazing (make sure to add those chilis and garlic), and I wish I could bottle that up and take it with me everywhere.

More expensive than bun cha you'll find on the street, but 65,000 VND still isn't bad (~$2.75). Will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Explorer0092
reviews.title: Delicious Food and Service.
reviews.content:
My friend and I ended up going to Bun Cha Ta multiple times during our stay in Hanoi. 

We ordered the Vegetarian fried spring rolls during all our visits and the fried tofu with tomato sauce during one of our visits. Both meals were delicious and worth our value for money. 

We loved the meals, they were very affordable and top of this the staff were very sweet and friendly. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rhea C
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: First time to try this famous meal from hanoi and it didn’t disappoint us. The barbecue minced pork blended well with its sauce together with the fresh herbs and noodles. The soup is not actually a soup but rather a sauce to me. Sweet vinaigrette with fresh papaya and carrots. We loved it! Rose the crew who served us was very friendly and sweet.

reviews.author: Chan
reviews.title: Delicious food
reviews.content: We went to Bun Cha Ta at the recommendation of a friend. We were greeted very warmly by Mia. Since there were 3 of us, we managed to try more items on the menu. The bun cha and spring rolls were out of this world. This restaurant is well worth a visit. If I had stayed in Hanoi longer, i would have gone there a second time.

reviews.author: Ftrigaux
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Delicious bun cha for very affordable price. Admirable staff with great English and smile. Soft prices (65k for bun cha)

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Lovely lunch
reviews.content: Read a review on line that this was the best Bun Cha Ta in Hanoi. Was a 5 minute walk from our hotel so gave it a go. Beautiful food, is basically a soup with herbs and grilled pork, drop in noodles and dunk spring rolls in it. Was very flavoursome. $6 SGD. Had a lovely waitress who was very chatty and spoke excellent English. Well air conditioned too so great to escape the heat. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Blake J
reviews.title: Safe and solid option
reviews.content: Very tasty food with a nice setting. If travelling with a family you could probably experience Hanoi dining with slightly greater peace of mind. It’s slightly more expensive than you would expect and I would recommend street food over here, but nevertheless cheap. Thao was very friendly.

reviews.author: Dimitri
reviews.title: Excellent meal
reviews.content: This restaurant was recommended by a taxi driver and he was right!  Very nice atmosphere and our waitress THAO was very friendly. Her English was good and she was kind enough to explain to us how the Bun Cha should be eaten. You enter the dining room without shoes which gives it an extra Asian touch. The food was excellent and service fast and friendly. Wish Bun Cha Ta success for the future.

reviews.author: Heidi
reviews.title: Awesome food!
reviews.content: The staff was awesome and food exceptional and very inexpensive.  It was started to rain hard and we were in luck that we ducked in here.  Great for families.

reviews.author: Andrew Elcock
reviews.title: Best meal whilst in Vietnam
reviews.content: My son recommended this place to me and for good reason! The food was delicious and the service was very welcoming and pleasant. I ate there a second time just as I was about to leave Vietnam as I wanted my final meal to be a good one and it was! Do yourself a favour and eat here.

reviews.author: Hugo Homer
reviews.title: Great food and very nice staff
reviews.content: My waitress ‘My’ was very welcoming and friendly to me and my siblings and the food was absolutely great for a very good price, the layout of the restaurant is very interesting and cool, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Hvwoods
reviews.title: Beautiful food and service
reviews.content: We were recommended this spot by one of the staff at the hotel we are currently staying at, and boy are we glad we decided to try it out! The flavours of the bun cha are to die for, we had such wonderful service from our waitress My. This spot will definitely stay in the top of our list!

reviews.author: Kate McPherson
reviews.title: Amazing and tasty bun cha!
reviews.content:
My friend and I went to try some bun cha and we were delighted to see that the food that was served was simply amazing. It was tasty and that place is much better than the Bun Cha Obama we went to.

Great street food, great value, great service!

reviews.author: eva
reviews.title: Sooooo tasty!!!
reviews.content: I stayed in Hanoi for 5 days and during my stay I went twice! The food here is super tasty and the staff are really friendly. It’s also reasonably priced with the meal I had being 100,000 VND (around £3.40) for a bowl of broth with veggies and pork, 2 spring rolls, a plate of rice noodles and a bowl of lettuce + herbs. By the time you finish, you are full to the brim, it’s so good, I can’t recommend it enough!!!!

reviews.author: Paula and Darrel
reviews.title: Great food and service
reviews.content: Nice food, good service and a great place to chat as the world goes by. Air conditioned so it's cool and comfortable too

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.title: The only Bun Cha we needed to find.
reviews.content: Like many others, we followed Anthony Bourdain and Obama's lead and wanted to experience some Bun Cha for ourselves. Luckily, Bun Cha Ta was the first restaurant we came across our first day in Hanoi. My brother and boyfriend got number 1 combos and I got the number 6 vegetarian combo. Everything was amazing! The gracious hostess gave us a tutorial for how to eat our meal and gifted us with some complimentary shots of traditional rice wine. This meal was so good we ended up going back to Bun Cha Ta three times in the few days we stayed in Hanoi. Not to mention, the restaurant itself is very cute and pleasant. Definitely a must-eat in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Febriyantiella
reviews.title: Street Foods Wrapped in A Restaurant
reviews.content: I was there in week day for a dinner and the restaurant is pretty crowded. I enjoyed the spring rolls so much, they served it with a soup, rice noodles, and a bunch of veggies! I also ordered the egg choco cream and the taste is surprisingly yum!!! Overall i love the food and the ambience, the staffs also good in english, especially the staff named Trang, she helped me so much, she speaks english very well among the others and she even told me how to eat the dishes, haha

reviews.author: Sherry Bischoff
reviews.title: Our first Vietnamese food experience
reviews.content: What a great experience. This was our first meal after arriving in Vietnam. We were a little apprehensive but it turned out to be wonderful. The food was delicious and the server guided us with our meals.

reviews.author: JoelAngZhiXian
reviews.title: Clean and interesting experience
reviews.content: The grilled pork is delicious. Also, the spring rolls are good too. The service provided by Trang is amazing. She spoke to us in English and talked to us too.

reviews.author: Cindy K
reviews.title: Excellent Inexpensive Bun Cha
reviews.content: Our second visit. If you are looking for Bun Cha in the Old Historic District, this is the place. It is cheap but delicious. Decor is a bit spartan but the food comes fast and you will leave very full and glad you came. Herbs are fresh, broth is rich and tasty and the servings are very plentiful!

reviews.author: Sue Westgate
reviews.title: delicious delicious authentic Vietnamese food
reviews.content: What an amazing meal. in fact we went there twice as the food is excellent. fresh and full of flavour. Such a lovely atmosphere there. would highly recommend everyone to visit!

reviews.author: Luis Garrido-Julve
reviews.title: Great Dinning Place!
reviews.content: You can't say anything bad about this place. Bun Cha is very good, the staff super helpful and the price decent. I think is great if you come here on your first visit, to discover bun cha, a Hanoi delicacy.

reviews.author: Marc R
reviews.title: Yum yum
reviews.content: Absolutely delicious, authentic Vietnamese food. The servers there are extremely kind and friendly - Trang was particularly helpful and sat down for a conversation with me. Really amazing experience!

reviews.author: Katherine A
reviews.title: Beat spring rolls
reviews.content: We were recommended Bun Cha Ta by some girls in our hostel and we are so glad we went. Firstly the spring rolls were amazing (both veggie and chicken versions) and secondly there was just the most relaxed atmosphere. Our servers were lovely and explained how to eat bun cha and also brought us over rice wine! Would thoroughly recommend

reviews.author: G Hall
reviews.title: Yummy bun Cha and very very friendly
reviews.content: Very friendly service and very hospitable and welcoming, great hospitality. Delicious bun Cha and we were given a Rice whiskey to try which was yum. Prices are slightly higher but that comes with the great hospitality and welcoming interior. 65,000d for bun Cha 25-35,000d for Hanoi and Saigon beer

reviews.author: Jay Lo
reviews.title: Excellent Food...
reviews.content: I would've instantly given 5 stars to this restaurant for EXCELLENT food, but we don't generally like to see "wildlife" in restaurants. We are also reasonable in the knowledge that in a big, hot, and humid city, you will very likely see large bugs, and potentially in restaurants. We were escorted to the third level of the restaurant, since the tables are sunken, you are given mats to sit on. There was a large, dead bug on a mat. We alerted the staff to this, and they did move the mat into the window near the stairwell, where the bug (which was stuck on the mat) was still visible. Despite this, we did have one of the best meals we had in Vietnam here. The spring roll that came with the meal was a bit greasy, but did go well with the Bun Cha. Overall, this restaurant is highly recommended for the quality of the food.

reviews.author: Katrina O
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content:
This was literally our first place we went off the plane! The food was amazing and it was our first time in Vietnam so the staff chatted to us and explained how to eat the food etc!! The spring rolls were insanely good! 

Vi the waitress was amazing and all the staff were friendly! Couldn’t recommend enough 🙌🏻🍜

reviews.author: Corinne Lau
reviews.title: Nice food!
reviews.content: The restaurant is nice and the food was awesome. I love the bun cha ta as well as the spring rolls. Egg coffee was great!

reviews.author: Amina Matavia
reviews.title: Bun cha ta
reviews.content: Food here was so good. One of the best meals I had while I was in Vietnam. The service is also really good.

reviews.author: Rachel Nguyen
reviews.title: Great food, lovely staff!
reviews.content: The food here is great, it was so delicious and flavorful, especially the meat and the spring rolls! The staff briefly explained how to eat bun cha correctly, which was really nice since it was our first time eating it. Also the egg coffee is fantastic! Then we had the best conversation with Vi, who gave us some Vietnamese rice wine to try, and helped us with recommendations for traveling further in Vietnam. She was so sweet and truly made our day!

reviews.author: Ekaterina D
reviews.title: Great way to explore Vietnamese cuisine
reviews.content:
I totally loved the food there!!! This place gave me a good sense of Vietnamese cuisine is like! It was delicious, especially the barbequed kind of spring (I guess, that's how you call it)! Definitely take a Vietnamese friend to show you how to it it, yes, there is a special way:) 
In addition, there was sooo much food, so don't worry about being hungry - this is not the case!!! 
Definitely recommend to everyone!!!

reviews.author: Jungwoo K
reviews.title: Great food and vibe
reviews.content:
Visited with some close friends and was pleasantly surprised by the quality we experienced. The food was the best we've had in our time in Vietnam. Espacially their rolls!!! Truly worth making a trip for.

Also, the waitress who introduced herself as Havi was able to guide us through her recommendations and I must say that all her choices were on point. She was fluent in Korean so if any fellow Koreans need any language help just ask the staff for Havi.

reviews.author: Lee Yerin
reviews.title: Excellent food with excellent service
reviews.content: The buncha was amazing and it worth the second visit! The waitress Ha Vi was very kind and generous, the restaurant is very spacious and nice! Best buncha restaurant in the whole of vietnam!!

reviews.author: Luxury Traveller
reviews.title: Great food , great venue
reviews.content: Our favorite restaurant in Hanoi. You take off your shoes before you enter the dining part. Everything we ate, was just delicious

reviews.author: 101holiday lover
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content:
Recommended this place by friend and I must say we loved it.  Simple menu and food was tasty.

We had no 1 and 8 from the menu.  Had plenty of flavour.  The lady gives you instructions on how to eat it if you haven't tried it before.

Price was 210,000 dong which is cheap.

I would definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Robin B
reviews.title: Wow!!!!
reviews.content:
Wow... so many flavours!
I chose number one and it was really really delicious. Fresh garlic and Chili on the table, full bowl of soup filled with meatballs, bowl of herbs, plate of noodles and a plate with fresh rolls... it all just mixes so well together! (And very cheap!)

Must go to when in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Noah P
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.content: Honestly this place was only busy cuz it has a lot of trip advisor reviews. Zero locals and the food showed. Bun cha we had at street places (learned from food tour guide) was 100x better and ⅓ the price. Not bad food but there is much better out there if you’re all the way in Hanoi.

reviews.author: davidchak
reviews.title: Best buncha ever.
reviews.content:
Tried this place on my first day here, it tasted so good that it ruined all my future buncha (yes, this is even better than the Obama bun cha). 

Came here again on my last day, still the same amazingly cooked buncha. Gonna miss this when I leave town. Strongly recommend this place. Warning though - you will find all your future buncha subpar after tasting this.

reviews.author: JimmyBaggott
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Great Bun Cha! The grilled pork was the tastiest! Nice restaurant with taste and authenticity of good street food

reviews.author: Nico G
reviews.title: Beautiful family restaurant!
reviews.content: The atmosphere was really nice and friendly! They specialize on the Vietnamese Bun Soup and spring rolls, which were both excellent! They offer unlimited rice and herbs. (I went through two baskets of herbs which tasted great in combination with the strong soup stock)

reviews.author: Hi-there-all
reviews.title: Another variation of bun cha
reviews.content: Food was freshly made and very tasty.  And it was full of locals and tourists alike.  Worth a visit when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sir Wens
reviews.title: Bun cha
reviews.content: The rice wine tasted good. The servers are friendly-rose and cloud. Please come and enjoy Bun cha 😋

reviews.author: Parky155
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content:
Our local guide recommended trying Bun Cha and said this was the best place in Hanoi to try it. It was such a tasty dish and was a great price. Best to get the full option so you can dunk the spring rolls into the broth, so good! 
Staff were also so friendly and nice. Very good restaurant and a must if in Hanoi.

reviews.author: lauraknak
reviews.title: Best food in Hanoi
reviews.content: We had our amazing dinner served by the lovely Ngoc who made our experience at Bun Cha Ta simply great. She was so kind and great at explaining how to eat our Bun Cha Ta. Thank you!

reviews.author: David F
reviews.title: Not all Bun Cha's are created equal
reviews.content: Eating in a new city can be a bit of a gamble, so came on the strength of reviews, and were not disappointed. Very tasty food with a little bit of instruction from the waitress on how to eat it. Went back the same evening as part of a brilliant Hanoi street food tour reviewed elsewhere on this site and the local guide really rated the food too.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Delicious meal, delightful service!
reviews.content: Stopped by here based on reviews and they did not disappoint! Prices are fair for the level of service and ambience the establishment offers, portions are good. Great Bun Cha experience thanks to our waitress, Hien :)!!

reviews.author: JoJo And Darcy
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: Really great Bun Cha and spring rolls. The service and atmosphere were also really nice, would recommend.

reviews.author: Sophie Turner
reviews.title: The taste of Hanoi
reviews.content: No tourist ever come to Vietnam and has not tried bun cha, specialty of Hanoi. The mince pork was moist, soft. The pork bacon was grilled to perfection which was crispy and tasty. The crab spring roll was well seasonning and with crispy layer of rice paper on the outside. A must try venue!

reviews.author: Javier O
reviews.title: Juicy beef
reviews.content: The Bun Cha sold here looks different from the conventional ones sold but tastes so much better! It's price friendly for tourists too. A strong recommend from me!

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Excellent food, lovely place to have dinner
reviews.content: We broke one our standard travel rule by eating here twice in a single visit to Hanoi.  The food is wonderful and the service is cheerful.  Our server both times was Rose, a university student who, during our first visit, helped us figure out what was in front of us and how to eat Bun Cha.  She actually remembered us when we returned a week later and, as it was early, had the chance to sit and talk with us for a few minutes.  Interactions like this help make a trip memorable.

reviews.author: Puneet A
reviews.title: Great food in a traditional setting
reviews.content: Lovely and sumptuous proportions in a very traditional setting. Vegetarian options on the menu and fresh fruit juices were delicious. Loved it!

reviews.author: Mathilde B
reviews.title: Lovely food and very friendly staff
reviews.content:
Our waitress Hoa was very freindly and good at speaking english!
The food was very good and we got a little introduktion on how to eat it.

reviews.author: Kamran R
reviews.title: AMAZING FOOD
reviews.content: this restaurant would be one of the best ever in Vietnam, the food was just amazing. Only Bun Cha Ta is available from Pork, meat, veg, and Chicken. But amazing a must try

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.title: The Best Bun Cha
reviews.content: This restaurant serves the most amazing bun cha. Highly recommend! Great food, great atmosphere, and the staff is lovely. Hoa was the sweetest!

reviews.author: PoTu34
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha order #1 comes with the most delicious fried spring rolls
reviews.content: This place is clean, cheap and food is awesome. Also just a few doors down from fast and clean laundry so have laundry done in 2 hours while you eat bun cha and have drinks ....what could be better!

reviews.author: Anne-Sophie Z
reviews.title: The best Bun Cha and spring rolls in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Food was amazing !! The best we had so far in Vietnam. I’ll definitely recommend the combo spring rolls and bun cha, they also have vegetarian options that look also delicious.
Service was also great. Special shout out to our waitress Thao who was very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Lovely food and friendly service
reviews.content: We had two great meals at Bun Cha Ta during our stay in Hanoi. The food was really tasty and the atmosphere was great. Thao was an amazing hostess, she was always friendly and cheerful and even recognised us when we came back.

reviews.author: Gladys b
reviews.title: Best meal of my trip so far
reviews.content: This meal was so good! The recommended Bun Cha (110,000 VND) is amazing, it comes with very good fried spring rolls. A lot of flavor.

reviews.author: Lauren303
reviews.title: Yum
reviews.content: Order the number 1 with a Ha Noi beer and dig in. Add some garlic, maybe a few chili peppers, basil, mint, and shiso and you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Rokki1211
reviews.title: Best bun cha place in Hanoi!
reviews.content: You cannot leave Hanoi without eating here. We ate here for 3 nights in a row! The staff are lovely, the environment is relaxing and the food is fresh and delicious. 10/10! Great vegetarian options too. We found our love for bun cha here ❤️

reviews.author: Meryl L
reviews.title: Don't leave Hanoi without eating here
reviews.content: We went here on the first day of the year and were received with great hospitality! The food was excellent and filling. Really a good place to experience the popular bun cha. Our server was also nothing but lovely. She had amusing stories to tell, and was so warm and friendly.

reviews.author: Sophia M
reviews.title: Best food
reviews.content: Amazing food!! The best I had in Hanoi! Ms thao is a very friendly and nice Person :) just really nice

reviews.author: 다솔 김
reviews.title: Staff is kind :)
reviews.content: The food was delicious and Hien who is server was super kind. She let us know how to eat bun cha and traditional Vietnam drink. I love this place :)

reviews.author: Rangy2018
reviews.title: Top Bun Cha!
reviews.content:
Because of this restaurant, Bun Cha has become one of my favourite dishes.

Excellent service, we had a little miscommunication with our order, but the staff were quick to correct it.

I would say that this was the best food we had in Vietnam, and I would highly recommend it to anyone staying in the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Kathy S
reviews.title: Wanted Bun cha...best in town
reviews.content: we'd heard about Bun Cha. Saw Anthony Bourdain's visit with President Obama...heard the location of their's was 'not the best' in town, so hotel recommended this one. It was fabulous! traditional small establishment in Hanoi. I LOVED the Bun Cha...making it at home now!! whoo!! Really cute restaurant, great service, price so reasonable!! and delicious!

reviews.author: Kum Yoke K
reviews.title: Yummy
reviews.content:
We had a sharing of a bowl of soup with grilled pork minus the noodle and tried their traditional spring roll. Yummy! Their Vietnamese Coffee was good too.

Lots of foreign tourists eating here. Simple menu with staff could speak English.

reviews.author: lck257
reviews.title: Easy selection and so tasty
reviews.content:
We were recommended to this place by our hotel. It was delicious. They have a very limited menu, which made it very easy to make a choice as to what to eat, especially for us who were not familiar with the food.
It was a pleasure to have Rose waiting on us.  We had a nice chat with her while we ate which I really enjoyed...getting to know locals is always a pleasure for me.
Would’ve have definitely gone back had we had more days in Hanoi.

reviews.author: kamawa2018
reviews.title: Tasty enough
reviews.content:
We went twice. Once for dinner and then lunch the next day as we knew it was a safe place to eat having been recommended by our hotel. Tasted much better the first time.  2nd day seemed a bit sweet.  Lovely staff. Hien was great and helpful.  Go hungry. 
Limited menu for fussy children.

reviews.author: Javier F
reviews.title: Simple menu, very nice food!
reviews.content:
The place offers “pre-selected” options, most of them come with spring rolls and rice noodles, the detail will be the pork or not. We went and order the #3, which is rice noodles and traditional spring rolls, it was super tasty and plenty full for 2. We had an extra of seafood spring rolls and with the dessert of yogurt and sticky rice we were totally satisfied. So good food and cheap price!

My recommendation would be to go for the traditional spring rolls instead of the seafood ones, although both are very nice.

reviews.author: Seamus G
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: We went here for our first night in Hanoi and we weren’t disappointed - the bun cha is beautiful and for such a great price. Highly recommend - nice venue, quick service and good all around food.

reviews.author: Clallz
reviews.title: Get the recommended Bun cha
reviews.content:
This restaurant was recommended by our hotel concierge. Food was delicious with generous servings. The waitresses explained how is best to eat Bun Cha. Restaurant was Japanese style seating and made for a nice change from mini stools. Would definitely recommend.

Tip for westerner tummies: I ate all the herbs and lettuce with no problem so please enjoy how it’s meant to be eaten :)

reviews.author: 814karen168
reviews.title: Bun cha ta
reviews.content: First night in Hanoi and we had read the reviews of this restaurant and so glad we went the food was delicious and the service fantastic.  A big thankyou to Thao who taught us how to use chopsticks! Would definatly recommend.

reviews.author: Samwisegam
reviews.title: Amazing bun cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha is delicious and the spring rolls were good too. The place has a lovely atmosphere and the staff were great. I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Chris K
reviews.title: Incredible meal !
reviews.content: My favourite place in Hanoi ! Amazing food, delightful staff and great ambience. Ask for THAO, nicest person I have met in Vietnam

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Our first taste of Bun Cha
reviews.content:
Excellent little place. 
Clean and comfortable with efficient staff who speak English and make you feel very welcome.
Possibly a tad sweet for my liking, and the garlic accompaniment rather too powerful for my liking but the spring rolls were stunning.

reviews.author: dolight
reviews.title: Bun cha is too sweet for my tastes
reviews.content: Went here because of locale and online reviews. Japanese style seating. Bun cha is too sweet in my opinion, even with chilli added. Lemon juice on the sweet side. The egg coffee is just to my taste. As good as Giang.

reviews.author: Duc Anh
reviews.title: Yummi
reviews.content:
Very tasty food and very kind service by Thao.
We had a great experience and recommend you guys to try it out.
Cheers, Duc anh, Van anh, Ruben.

reviews.author: Rouge_fairy
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: Our favorite bun cha place in Hanoi. Tasty bun cha and spring rolls, big servings, nice staff who could speak English well and clean restaurant.

reviews.author: Arsen Khizriiev
reviews.title: Average
reviews.content:
Had high expectations by the goods review on some online websites as it was told one of local favorite, but when I got to the restaurant, it was all foreigners (a little disappointed). The Bun Cha was so so, the spring roll have so much oil. Not thing special or stand out much in taste. We had another at local restaurant surrounding as street food and it was better at lower prices. When I came at around 3PM, it seemed that not too much people there and the waitress was not focused on her own business. The service quickly though. 

The decoration is old and not as clean as I expected.

reviews.author: Carlos F
reviews.title: Nice experience of delicious bun cha in a quiet space
reviews.content:
Discovering this restaurant was a very nice surprise to find. The Bun Cha they prepare is delicious, and moreover the waitress care to explain both the recipe and how to eat it to enjoy it best (in good English). The place is right in the old quarter although it provides a more intimate ambiance than what's typical for bun-cha places! Ideal to disconnect a little from the chaos of the streets, recover your strength and enjoy the food.

I have to say that in particular Ngoc, one of the waitresses, contributed to making it a very nice experience by providing a lot of details on Vietnamese gastronomy!

reviews.author: stickymission
reviews.title: yum!
reviews.content: This was the first restaurant we went to in Hanoi and I can't stop thinking about it! The Ba Cha and spring rolls were excellent. We also really liked the atmosphere. We went upstairs, removed our shoes, and sat low to the ground. (what we would call Japanese style)

reviews.author: Retired_teacher_56
reviews.title: Amazing Bun Cha
reviews.content: Search out this restaurant for amazing Bun Cha. There are 2 floors. If you eat upstairs you have to take off your shoes before sitting at long tables. Service is fast and food is amazing.

reviews.author: lissu_666
reviews.title: Best place in Hanoi to eat Bun Cha
reviews.content: You need to add this restaurant definitely on your bucket list if you want to try really good Bun Cha. Staff is also very friendly and English speaking. Special thanks to Lee who was serving me today!!! Customer service is 10/10 👍

reviews.author: Irene S
reviews.title: Delicious affordable bun cha - with veggie option!
reviews.content: We were looking for bun cha with vegetarian options. Unfortunately the Obama/Bourdain bun cha place only offers meat and seafood but TripAdvisor steered us to Bun Cha Ta and I have to say, we loved it! I’ve never had bun cha before so unfortunately I have no basis for comparison but both my husband and I very much enjoyed our meals. We went for lunch and were ushered up to the second floor. Menu is straightforward but the staff were happy to answer any questions. Reasonably clean bathroom on the second floor but was lacking toilet paper so grab a napkin or two from the table first just in case. My husband had the veggie spring rolls bun cha (they also have a tofu and tomato option) and I had the pork. Came with plates of rice noodles and a large dish of greens and herbs. Note to strict vegetarians, the broth usually has fish sauce. I could taste it in mine but my husband didn’t notice it in his. You should check with the staff on this if it is a concern. Overall two thumbs up!

reviews.author: Helene
reviews.title: Yummy Noodles!
reviews.content: First time trying bun cha Hanoi was so great at this restaurant! The noodles, veggies, and eggrolls/meat were very fresh, authentic and  delicious. The food came very quickly and the service was one of the friendliest we’ve had in Vietnam. Our helper Thao was so sweet and helpful to show us how to eat this dish! From the start, Thao was so welcoming and made our experience in Hanoi that much more memorable by helping us with bun Cha! :)

reviews.author: HikenbikeCNX
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.content: A great find!  Very nice owners gave an explanation of how to eat the Bun Cha.  One of the best meals we had in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Hannah C
reviews.title: Tinh is a legend
reviews.content: Tonight we were served our first Bun Cha in Vietnam, but we are convinced it is the best! The experience was made so much better by our lovely waitress Tinh, who speaks impeccable English. We hope to be back!

reviews.author: Elaine
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content: We have visited Bun Cha Ta twice during our stay in Hanoi - once with our street food tour. The Bun Cha is delicious and our lovely waitress Thao was so helpful in offering to show us how to eat the dish and giving us a sample of Vietnamese ‘happy water’ at the end of our meal!

reviews.author: Adrian P
reviews.title: A must eat!
reviews.content: Simply delicious Bun Cha, the restaurant is very unique and our sever was very very nice giving us advice on other places to eat. Recommended 100%

reviews.author: vickyfisher
reviews.title: Unusual restaurant with good street food
reviews.content:
This restaurant is located in the old Quarter of Hanoi 
The food is local street food but served on low tables on two floors
Clean interesting food reasonable priced

reviews.author: 99Rachel
reviews.title: Top Bun Cha
reviews.content: Thao was so friendly and helpful. We had delicious Bun Cha and rice pudding - just as good as our first visit!

reviews.author: Chlobo Bellbag
reviews.title: Review of this Bun Cha Joint
reviews.content:
Do you like sausage and mash?.... Nervous about eating in south east Asia?.... Don’t like spice or the thought of fish sauce? Eeuughh
Well Bun Cha Ta is for you!
Such tasty food and option to add chilli and garlic and the selection of Vietnamese herbs was great.
My boyfriend is always trying to take me to these random places sat on the floor eating entrails out of a bowl. So this was a welcome break.
Our waitress was called Thao was so lovely, and extremely genuine. She made the experience extra special.

Come here to eat you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Sonia
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: We love Bun cha and can eat it everyday. This place makes a delicious bun cha and equally great spring rolls. Ate here 3 times during our stay in Hanoi. Friendly staff and relaxed atmosphere.

reviews.author: Zack S
reviews.title: So nice we went there twice
reviews.content: We first came here on a walking food tour of Hanoi, and the food/atmosphere really blew us away. We could help but come back the next day for a full meal! Our server Thao was very friendly, service was quick and painless. If I ever find myself in Hanoi again I'll definitely swing by for some more bun cha

reviews.author: Sylvia L
reviews.title: Simple but delicious
reviews.content: Ate their Bun Cha and it was good. Service and staffs are friendly. Fast service as well. Must at least try once if you are here.

reviews.author: estelleh
reviews.title: Meilleure nourriture de Hanoi
reviews.content: Le cadre est super sympa, le personnel adorable. It was delicious, best dish I had in Hanoi. I really recommend it

reviews.author: Meghan S
reviews.title: Amazing Food!
reviews.content: We loved this place so much we had to go back before we left Hanoi. Great intro to vietnamese food and Bun Cha is still my favorite eats from our trip!

reviews.author: Tristan W
reviews.title: Incredible flavour at an amazing price!
reviews.content: This restaurant is the perfect way to experience delicious, authentic Hanoi street food while relaxing indoors in a comfortable setting. With prices only slightly higher than the street stalls, it is well worth the visit. Our server Thao was exceptionally lovely and very helpful. Couldn't recommend more! Apologies for the picture, but we were in too much of a hurry to eat when we smelled the delicious broth!

reviews.author: 87Jayb87
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.content: Had the number 5 bun cha with seafood spring rolls also had the rice wine whisky. All of it was incredible. My wife had number 2 with pork meatball style in the same soup and it was also amazing.

reviews.author: ritapintomm
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.content: We loved this restaurant! The food was delicious and Thao was very kind and explained us everything! We definetly recommend.

reviews.author: andy172017
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: This Bun Cha restaurant is on right old quarter & easy to find out. Bun Cha was delicious & flavor soup. Staff were friendly. Should do it!

reviews.author: Aliyah T
reviews.title: Amazing Bun Cha!!
reviews.content:
Bun Cha was the best I have had! So good that we went back twice during our 3-day trip to Hanoi! 

As a bonus the staff was super attentive and our waitress Thao made us feel at home.

reviews.author: AmableA1981
reviews.title: Good Food; Excellent Service
reviews.content: We tried this place out after our egg coffee at Giang Cafe based on nearby bests on TA.  They had a chill spot upstairs with comfortable seating.  The food was very good, but it did not give me a wow! feel.  It was the customer service that was top notch though.  The servers were very accommodating and engaging.  We had Thao help us out with how to properly eat the Bun Cha.  She also talked to us about many other things.  We really liked her personality.  We plan on going back here when we go to Hanoi again later this year.

reviews.author: Gifford2013
reviews.title: Fabulous Meal
reviews.content:
We were in Hanoi for one week and actually came here twice. Bun Cha was excellent and the second time we ordered with spring rolls - wonderful!

Phao provided excellent service and is such a great young lady. Thanks Phao! Would definitely recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: yezminassad
reviews.title: Beautiful catch up for dinner
reviews.content: Everything was amazing.. the service, the place, the food! Thanks Thao for helping us choosing our dishes and for looking after us during the whole dinner. We had a great time!! :)

reviews.author: velorok
reviews.title: Flavourful local street food in a comfortable seating.
reviews.content:
We visited this place twice for the quick midday bite.
Wonderful and delicious version of a fast food with the homemade aromas and edible bouquet of freshly picked cilantro, basil and other herbs that compliment the aromatic broth. Don't skip fried spring rolls. For some reason they don't come with that staple dipping sauce, but could be dipped in the soup. Works fine for me.

reviews.author: Kathleen
reviews.title: Great meal!
reviews.content: We went here twice in Hanoi since we enjoyed it so much the first time!  Sat upstairs in their cool 2nd floor - great AC.  The food was delicious, and the staff was helpful in providing tips on how to eat the food as well as what to order (amounts, etc.).

reviews.author: Jennifer Y
reviews.title: Best Buncha
reviews.content: Best Buncha in Hanoi. Must visit here. Customer service is great too. Great price as well. It’s in Hoàn kiem and easy to find.

reviews.author: Virginia M
reviews.title: Lovely little place
reviews.content: Lovely little resturant that doesn't require you to sit outside with plastic stolls, great service by lovely lady Thao and the food was good also! We had the bun cha and tried rhe tomato tofu which was delicious. (Its better than it looks) :)

reviews.author: Aaron K
reviews.title: Top Vietnamese Street Food
reviews.content: I highly recommend this place, order the #1 on the menu you won’t regret it.  I have been here twice and both times I had the pleasure of having Thao as my server.  She is very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Karla S
reviews.title: Best bun cha ever
reviews.content: Cozy place great food. Hostess thao is the best makes you feel welcome and explains everything.  A Hanói foodie place

reviews.author: Ballaagi
reviews.title: My first try of Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content:
Nice and cosy restaurant specialized to bun cha ta but have vegetarian options too.
The staff is nice and friendly. Especially Thao who helped me and teach how to eat  the meal properly :)
Location is also good.

reviews.author: Jess&Tom
reviews.title: Tasty Bun Cha
reviews.content: Tasty food, good prices, fast service and our server Thao was very helpful and friendly! Would recommend.

reviews.author: Monien89
reviews.title: Clean and tasty
reviews.content: Went here for brunch. Just a short walk from the infamous Giang egg coffee. The place was quiet and very cosy. The Bun Cha was very tasty, had a tangy taste. You should definitely add garlic and a bit of chilli to add a bit more flavour and kick! Portion size was very good had the grilled pork, honoian spring rolls, herbs and vermicelli. Definitely was full from this brunch! 95000vnd! Tasty and I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: GSCtraveler
reviews.title: Excellent meal- helpful staff
reviews.content: We had a delicious meal at Bun Cha Ta. Good value. Staff were friendly and helpful. Easy to find and great location.

reviews.author: bubblybeky
reviews.title: So good!
reviews.content: We had already had Bun Cha elsewhere, and wanted to eat it again. This place does really good dishes! And good spring rolls too. Cute place, three storeys. Definitely go here!

reviews.author: EFreviews
reviews.title: Delicious bun cha
reviews.content: Bun cha is a speciality dish of Hanoi so Bun Cha Ta is an excellent place for bun cha, a yummy broth with grilled pork and noodles. Order with seafood spring rolls and tick off another Hanoi speciality, though I did prefer their pork spring rolls over the seafood ones.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: Best bun cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: We ordered the number 1 from the menu bun cha and spring rolls absolutely delicious, great prices and lovely staff. We sat downstairs but the upstairs has sunken seats where you take your shoes off. Really great restaurant best bun cha we had in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Charlie M
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Great taste, good location, reasonable prices. The trifecta. Visit this place, I don't think you'll regret it.

reviews.author: Multi-traveller
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content:
First : remember to wear socks when you go there because you're gonna have to take your shoes off if you go upstairs.
Aside of that, this was the best bobun I've ever had and the mango juice was also delicious and very fresh. I wish we had the time to go there twice.

reviews.author: Daydream42211996833
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha!
reviews.content: That restaurant is really a nice place with good food! Lee was very sweet. We definitely recommend that place!

reviews.author: Alison K
reviews.title: Great street food option
reviews.content: This was a lovely quiet restaurant.  We went upstairs and sat at sunken tables.  We ate spring rolls and soup, washed down with beer.  Great value, friendly service, very clean and air-conditioned

reviews.author: Shana
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: My husband and I have been traveling through Vietnam for 3 weeks now and have had bun cha several times. This was the best one we’ve had in Vietnam! I ordered the grilled pork and my husband ordered the tofu. It was packed with flavor and was so tasty! Also, we felt it was great value and the staff was friendly and attentive. We would definitely recommend this spot!

reviews.author: danieltravel54321
reviews.title: Great traditional Vietnamese food
reviews.content: My girlfriend and I ate here on our recent trip to Vietnam - the Bun Cha was fantastic and excellent value for money. The broth was very flavoursome - it is slightly sweet but also spicy. The barbecued pork balls are also delicious and the dish comes with nice fresh greens. The lady serving was also very friendly which further made the overall experience really good - would highly recommend

reviews.author: S Bodz
reviews.title: So fresh and so Hanoi!
reviews.content: Down a little alley that is easy to miss, this place runs a brisk business and is a must-try in Hanoi! Best Bun Cha here!

reviews.author: Cammie81
reviews.title: Excellent food, must try.
reviews.content: Never tried Bun Cha before (had pho) and have to say it was excellent. The rolls, meat, broth, everything in the dish was outstanding. Really liked the atmosphere and the service was great.

reviews.author: Anthony Mota
reviews.title: One of the best dishes I’ve ever had in life
reviews.content:
Really amazing experience. 
The bun cha ta dish it’s something mind blowing, brilliant. 
Good service and very friendly. 
I

reviews.author: El_Pelicano
reviews.title: Great Service, Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content:
We had a fun meal here tonight, our first ever Bun Cha. The young woman who helped us couldn’t have been nicer, patiently taking the time to tell us how to order and eat Hanoi’s famous specialty dish. 

And everything about it was delicious — the pork nuggets, the fresh vermicelli, the spring greens, and the broth. The crab filled spring rolls may have even been better than the soup. 

My only complaint:  the broth, when served, was barely lukewarm. Now, I’m no Bun Cha expert, so maybe it’s supposed to be that way, but I don’t think so. It was super flavorful, in any case, and so the low temperature didn’t detract too much from the overall meal. 

$18 for two combination specials and two Hanoi beers. 

Recommended.

reviews.author: E&M Idaho
reviews.title: Our first Bun cha and it was delicious!!
reviews.content: Just arrived in Hanoi and this restaurant was recommended by our hotel.  A great casual restaurant, and the Bun Cha was delicious.  Jing our server was friendly, and recommended other things to see in town.  We will definitely be back for another meal.

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Wonderful food and service
reviews.content: The local northern Vietnamese food was delicious (I had the vegetarian spring roll with soup and the black rice desert). The ladies working there were very nice and Lee was particularly hospitable. I highly recommend. Enjoy :)

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Just perfect
reviews.content: We had a dinner here and a lunch the following day. Both times we have the Bun Cha and spring rolls. Both of which are amazing. We had Ann serving us who was just wonderful. She explained to us all of the ingredients, how best to eat the food and was just so warm and friendly. The place is clean, the food is extremely well valued (I think around 50k VND for the bun cha and spring rolls?), and top knotch service. Nothing more to say, fantastic!

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Amazing service and GREAT food
reviews.content: We came here for dinner and the service and food was great. We had the recommended dish and it was one of the best bun cha that I’ve ever had. Good portions at a great price. Our server Jing was also very friendly and helpful. We asked for her recommendations of Vietnamese food and restaurants and she wrote down a whole list for us. She was so sweet and thoughtful.

reviews.author: Sebastjan S
reviews.title: We went there hungry and...
reviews.content:
... stayed hungry afterwards.

This was probably one of those restaurants that we put on our "crazy good reviews but the reputation doesn't live up to them" list.
Food seemed old cooked, it was cold-ish, quite greasy and didn't taste anything special. The only thing preventing this place from getting 1 star is the staff - the lady there tried her best to make us feel comfortable with the food.

Setting and service - 3
Taste - 1
Value - 1

reviews.author: Serge M
reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.content: Really good food and drinks. My wife and I took the Bun Cha (full). We loved it. The juices were good too. But the best thing was the kindness and tips from our waiteess Jing about Vietnamese cuisine. We were reeated like in a 5 stars restaurant for the price of street food. Exceptional place!

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: Best food I’ve had in 3 weeks I’m vietnam
reviews.content: This place is a most visit. Food delicious, staff lovely and so affordable. I’ve came twice in 2 days. Highly recommend :-)

reviews.author: HilsBack
reviews.title: Divine
reviews.content: We had the grilled pork with noodles, spring rolls, lots of fresh herbs and enjoyed every single mouthful.  Wonderful flavours.  We went twice!  Our favourite meal in Hanoi where there is lots of good food!

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Excellent Food
reviews.content: Excellent food, quick efficient service. Very well priced. Next time in Hanoi we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: giovagiova87
reviews.title: Amazing dinner
reviews.content:
Stop in this restaurant for a fast dinner. The food was absolutely Grest as the lovely girl at the table, Ngoc, that show me the dishes and..how to eat them! Moove here and you'll be in a great Place!
Highly reccomwnded!!

reviews.author: Kenny
reviews.title: Absolutely never again
reviews.content:
I ate there last week with my wife and we both agreed the food was only average. The pork patties were fairly bland and fell apart easily. The Bun Cha was just average for what I tasted across Vietnam. The spring rolls were oily but were tasty and crunchy. 

The main reason for only giving two stars and why I will never return is as follows. It is the restaurant's policy for guests to remove their shoes or footwear and leave them in the staircase. We finished our meal only to enter the staircase and we found that my wife's expensive shoes were gone. Yes they were stolen and because we were in the dining room we did not see it happen or who took them. 

The staff just basically brushed us off and made me pay the full price for the meal. So after paying top price for an average meal we had to leave without my wife's shoes and got to enjoy getting ripped off by the street sellers and buy another pair of shoes before heading back to our hotel. I don't know who stole them but I was not impressed with how management did not care or do anything to help after we were victims of crime in their restaurant. They did not offer a discount on our bill or help even after I left and sent them messages about this matter. My messages went unanswered.

I will never return to Bun Cha Ta, nor will I recommend this restaurant to anyone.

reviews.author: Anya G
