reviews.title: Amazing Everything - Seriously!
reviews.content: My husband and I have been living in Hanoi for almost 2 months now and have had some delicious bun cha, but this place surprised us in the best of ways. The old quarter is certainly more touristy than other areas of Hanoi, but the food here is definitely worth the visit! We've been here multiple times and everything is always incredibly fresh and tasty. We have an addiction to nems (fried spring rolls) and theirs are the best we've had in Vietnam (and that's saying a lot)! The restaurant can get busy on weekends, but the waitstaff are always kind and more than happy to answer any questions or help you with your pronunciation. Lee, one of the waitresses we always have the pleasure of seeing here, is particularly helpful and goes out of her way to make sure we have a delicious meal and memorable experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mel Eade
reviews.title: Tasty and friendly
reviews.content: Ann was an excellent host who welcomed us and then explained all about the food. She was friendly and chatty and the food was very tasty. Thanks Ann!

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: Good cheap eat
reviews.content: Tasty, and affordable. And safe... Street type food but at a restaurant. I ordered #2. Would recommend. They have seating upstairs so don't let the 1st floor fool u...

reviews.author: FoodiequeenNelson
reviews.title: Love! Must tru
reviews.content: Bun Cha is a hanoi speciality and Ann makes this a worthwhile experience. Great way to taste this delicious meal! Thoroughly recommend

reviews.author: Thepngs
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content:
This place was recommended by our hotel front desk and we were very glad that we tried it. It was one of the best traditional noodle soup we had in Hanoi. We were seated on the 2nd floor (japanese style - must remove shoes) and the english speaking staff were very friendly and helpful. Price was reasonable and food was good.
Hope to visit again.

reviews.author: Ilovemycactus
reviews.title: Lived up to expectations
reviews.content: A very enjoyable lunch, tasty, good service. The serving staff are friendly and helpful. Great value.  Loved it.

reviews.author: AlieGlobeTrotter
reviews.title: A mandatory stop
reviews.content: Great experience, we discovered Bun cha and our hostess was kind enough to show us how it is supposed to be eaten. Very friendly personnel and outstanding service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Welsh K
reviews.title: Kevin
reviews.content: I was recommended this little place by some australien tourists I met. The ban Cha ta I had was fantastic!! Very welcoming and friendly people who spoke good English. Thoroughly recommend this little gem of a place!!

reviews.author: Ro Mo
reviews.title: Shoes off and eat well.
reviews.content: Read the reviews beforehand and was not disappointed. Bun Cha is pretty much all they do, but they do it excellently. Go upstairs and remove shoes before entering. Seating is unusual but very comfortable. A great place to eat in the Old Quarter of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Best Bun in Hanoi!!
reviews.content: We had the #1 & #7 dishes. Both had amazing flavors and the ambiance of the dining area is absolutely charming. My girlfriend is vegan and she can’t stop raving about the #7. The rolls and broth and everything about #1 will certainly be etched in my memory for a long time too. This establishment feels like a very authentic family restaurant with top class food and service. Our server on the second floor, Jing, was very friendly and helpful. We will definitely be coming back here the next time we visit.

reviews.author: jtrisno
reviews.title: One of the best Bun Cha
reviews.content: One of the best Bun Cha. Fairly priced, good food, with nice atmosphere. Service was good and staff understand English.

reviews.author: Jenny K
reviews.title: Nice food and fast service
reviews.content: Nice buncha and delicious spring rolls.Service is very fast.Menu is in English and waiters can speak english.

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Came here for dinner as it’s near our hotel. English speaking staffs and menu. Bun Cha is good.Higher price though. 2nd floor seating is pretty unique.

reviews.author: Aimee Black
reviews.title: Yum food
reviews.content: Visited bun cha ta three times over our stay in Hanoi. The food is yummy and reliable. It is a bit touristy, but easy after a long day out in busy Hanoi. The full option with spring rolls is super filling and tasty.

reviews.author: saigonhue
reviews.title: Kinda of a tourist spot but the food is legit.
reviews.content:
Excellent Bun Cha. More pricey than the other bun Cha places I eaten at. 

The pork patties and the broth had more flavor.

The nem (spring rolls) was good. The staff is very attentive and understand English.

Kinda of a tourist spot but the food is legit.

Beer and wine is served here.

Credit card accepted.

reviews.author: Jammonica57
reviews.title: Good value for your money
reviews.content:
At this place we had lunch two days 
when visiting Hanoi. You get very tasty lunch here and the staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: neilhassall
reviews.title: Two visits, two very different experiences (but delicious both times!)
reviews.content:
We visited Bun Cha Ta twice during our stay as we returned a second time after the food was so good. Our first experience was incredible - we were seated on the third floor, served quickly and it was some of the best Vietnamese street food I've ever had  - fresh, zingy plus the spring rolls are unbeaten. The second time we visited (a Friday night) still had great food, but we were sat on the ground floor, and there was a lot of staff screaming plus it took an eternity for our food to come out - the couple on the next table even gave up on part of their order after waiting so long.
Overall,  a culinary delight but next time, I wouldn't sit on the ground floor or go on a weekend.

reviews.author: Daniel Kent-Royds
reviews.title: Delicious and great value!
reviews.content: Delicious food and good price, and our waitress Ann was very helpful! She had great english and was very friendly!

reviews.author: Ofir G
reviews.title: Tasty Bun Cha
reviews.content: Not easy to find vegetarian Bun Cha, so this one is a good option, especially when it's so tasty, fresh, and the stuff is very friendly (Ann). Nice welcoming place.

reviews.author: lucyyyn
reviews.title: Seriously delicious
reviews.content:
We were recommended Bun Cha Ta by hotel staff and were not disappointed at all. It was our first time eating bun cha and have to say we haven’t found tastier during our time in Vietnam yet! 

The restaurant itself was unsuspecting but the place, food and staff are all great. We only stayed in Hanoi for three nights but went twice during our time!

reviews.author: Liz B
reviews.title: Vietnamese gem
reviews.content: I love the Bun Cha hear! I’ve been really struggling to get a taste for Vietnamese food so far as even the street vendors seem to only make a few dishes. Bun Cha is definitely the Pad Thai of Vietnam and Bun Cha Ta is a great restaurant to show you what it’s all about, the food is delicious,  it’s well priced and the seating is authentic and a comfortable way to dine. The waitresses made it for me, asking whether you would like to know how the dish should be eaten and explaining very kindly. If you’re in Hanoi, definitely go down to Bun Cha Ta!

reviews.author: kasim206
reviews.title: Do not leave Hanoi without eating here!
reviews.content: After a regrettably lackluster bun cha experience at a random sit down place elsewhere in the city, my wife found Bun Cha Ta online and we opted to try it given the positive reviews. We immediately knew we'd be eating there again before we departed Hanoi. The quality and portions are amazing, and the staff is exceedingly friendly. The restaurant has plenty of seating and the food comes out fast and fresh. Order the full course bun cha for the best experience, and top it off with one of their egg coffees for a delicious finisher.

reviews.author: Denis Mark
reviews.title: Delicious & affordable
reviews.content:
We went for the set with spring rolls topped with a cup of egg coffee..

Enjoyed every bite of it!!

It's a must have whenever I am in Hanoi.

The staffs are really friendly too and if you are a first timer, they will advise you on the proper way of enjoying it. 😊

reviews.author: Kath B
reviews.title: Affordable, friendly, traditional
reviews.content: We ate at Bun Cha Ta at the recommendation of our hotel, just around the corner. Located at one end of "Coffee Street", Bun Cha Ta is a wonderful and very easy first-day option. The food is delicious and service is prompt. Owner-proprietor Katy is warm and welcoming, and will walk you through how to eat bun cha (traditional Hanoi specialty) if you've never had it before. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Nttvinh
reviews.title: Nice restaurant - yummy food
reviews.content:
This place is good for travellers because the waitresses could speak English fluently, and she's willing to give you a guide on how to eat Bun Cha. 

They have good variety of dishes including veterarian and nice setting. The food came out fast and they price is OK.

reviews.author: cltham
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha & reasonable priced
reviews.content: We came back after our almost 12 hours day trip to Ninh Binh tired and hungry and wanted to find somewhere nearby to eat. We came to Bun Cha Ta at our hotel staff's recommendation. It was our first time eating Hanoi's bun cha. The very friendly & helpful young lady named Katy showed us the right way to eat the dish with all the fresh vegetable & herbs & the spring rolls. She even enlightened us on trivials like how the spring roll got it's name! The bun cha with the grilled pork was very delicious and my husband and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Chad JW
reviews.title: Local recommendation
reviews.content: I was told about Bun Cha from a local.  I looked up Bun Cha on Google and this restaurant came up first.  The reviews convinced me to go.  Was I ever glad.  I had the #1 item on the menu.  Sooooo good.  The herbs that comes with it really make this meal so great.  The staff here are super friendly.  I highly recommend this restaurant for a truly authentic flavourful meal. 👍🙌

reviews.author: Duane U
reviews.title: Pocketbook Friendly
reviews.content: Stopped in here for a light lunch. The buncha and spring rolls are delicious, comes with a side of rice noodles and green salad and herb combo to add to your soup. Light and refreshing and inexpensive 95000 dong. Wish they had more items on the menu but I will be back again anyway.

reviews.author: 142JanetH
reviews.title: A victim of its own success?
reviews.content:
We went here on the basis that this restaurant features in most searches for 'best restaurants in Hanoi'. Truly - there is simply no taste in anything we had and we felt somewhat offended that it would be served in a country of such wonderful cuisine. Our Bun Cha was not even served with fresh herbs! 
Note that it appears to us (we walked past here regularly from where we stayed) that only tourists go here - there is good reason for this!

reviews.author: Dena
reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.content: We ate here as part of our food tour. The food was so amazing we went back the following night for dinner. We had the soup which is number 2 on the menu. It’s served with a side of salad & herbs that you shred into your soup & rice noddles. The meal is light & fresh & tastes delicious. The restaurant in air conditioned & the seating is comfortable. Very lovely presented restaurant. 100% recommend eating here.

reviews.author: Hyungjin Kim
reviews.title: Deserve to eat
reviews.content: They offer bun cha in 60000đ. It tastes good. The best point is that they offer additional noodle with only 2500đ. And there was helpful and english fluent guest. But i wish they would have more diverse menu.

reviews.author: gabbage
reviews.title: A comfy place to eat :)
reviews.content: Bun Cha Ta ended up being one of the places we frequented whilst in Hanoi. As we discovered bun cha is a very delicious meal particularly here and the interior of this place was comfortable and welcoming. We found the service here to be very friendly particularly from the server Jing! She always made sure we were happy and enjoying ourselves. It's a must go to if you are ever in Hanoi.

reviews.author: beauandmel
reviews.title: Bun cha
reviews.content: Buncha is average? However, this place has proper seating and is cleaner than roadside stores. 95k for 1 portion of buncha and nem.

reviews.author: KNscoren
reviews.title: Best bun cha!
reviews.content: We stopped in Hanoi during our trip to Vietnam and wanted to try the famous Bun Cha and were looking for the place that Obama had visited. We were recommended this place instead and we we're not disappointed! The place was super cute and upstairs where you removed your shoes and sat on lowered benches. The waitresses we're friendly and directed you as to how to eat the bun cha! The bun cha was delicious and so flavourful with a variety of greens to eat with. If you are in Hanoi old quarter I would definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Good Bun Cha with a smile
reviews.content: Great food in a nice setting and really friendly service. Especially from Ngoc with the beautiful smile. :)

reviews.author: Jay_coolza
reviews.title: Surprisingly good!
reviews.content:
My friend and i had 
1 grilled pork with spring role with rice noodle( recommended menu)
2 fried tofu with tomato souce with rice noodle 
3 egg chocolate
We didnt know what ban cha ta is until we had it and it is amazing, tasty and healthy. My friend said the grilled pork soup is superb. The restuarant is clean enough and staffs were very tentative. Its not so expensive for dinner. I ll definitely miss bun cha ta in Hanoi

reviews.author: walterinbaja
reviews.title: Great spring rolls
reviews.content: You’d better like Bun Cha(who doesn’t?) cause that’s all that on the menu, but it’s great and don’t forget to have some spring rolls.

reviews.author: Rob B
reviews.title: Yes yes yes.
reviews.content:
Wonderful Bun cha & spring rolls!
We will definitely be coming back. 
Friendly staff. Good prices. 
Lacks nothing.

reviews.author: yyhhcc
reviews.title: Only if they serve a hot soup
reviews.content: great food but the soup they served was just warm .. not good enuf to 'soak' the fresh raw herbs and vege together.  But otherwise, it is reall tasty.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Great food and so cheap!
reviews.content: The food here was delicious and so cheap! We will definitely be back. Be sure to try the egg hot chocolate!

reviews.author: Kita B
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!
reviews.content: Great food, and very reasonably priced ! If you don't know how to go about eating the Bun Cha, they're here to guide you through the process! Staff is very kind and friendly, a solid thumbs up!

reviews.author: Arvin
reviews.title: 1st Vietnamese Meal!
reviews.content: 1st day and 1st meal in Hanoi. Amazing food and awesome service by staff! The prices were affordable too. Must try:)

reviews.author: Sven K
reviews.title: Bun Cha served by Lee :)
reviews.content: During our stay in Hanoi, we really wanted to try some local specialty and therefore we ended in this really nice restaurant eating delicious Bun Cha with a bunch of herbs to mix inside and the fried spring rolls. They are really kind and explain the way how to eat this specialty. Actually, we came back again and second time and lovely Lee served us free happy water :) we really recommend this place

reviews.author: Léo
reviews.title: Warm and authentic Vietnamese food
reviews.content: I love that place! The atmosphere is warm and authentic, especially up stairs. I've been served by Ngoc, she's so nice and friendly. She asked me if she could chat with me while I was waiting for my meal and of course I accepted, it was a very nice exchange. The food is delicious, I ordered a vegetarian bun cha and Ngoc explained me how to eat my meal properly, I really liked it. I highly recommend this place! I've been there twice already and I'll come back again.

reviews.author: Brian L
reviews.title: Amazing food and experience
reviews.content: Had the pleasure of having the bun cha #1, which was incredible. The waitress, Ngoc, made the whole experience amazing with walking me through the proper way to eat the meal and teaching me common Vietnamese phrases. Will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Elena P
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: The food here is amazing. They only serve a few dishes but I haven’t tried better soup in Vietnam. I will truly recommend it.

reviews.author: John Anthony Cantley
reviews.title: Very nice food and welcoming staff
reviews.content: If you are new to Hanoi or Vietnamese cooking I would recommend this restaurant. Jing the host was very friendly and took her time to explain how to eat bun cha. If you have a sweet tooth you should give the egg coffee a try!

reviews.author: Feroz Q
reviews.title: Incredible to say the least!
reviews.content:
Katy is an amazing host. So
Kind. So understanding. I ordered the vegetarian option (6) and was absolutely blown away by the taste and quality of the food. Not only was Katy so amazing - she taught us how to toast in Vietnamese. Can not recommend this place enough

reviews.author: Wandereroftheglobe
reviews.title: Just wow!
reviews.content:
My husband and I read reviews on trip advisor and saw that it had excellent reviews and was also vegetarian friendly so, we gave this place a go. I must say, the food here simply blew our minds. Both the veggie and pork options were superb! The layout of the place was pretty cute too and service was great. We were served by Jing who gave us a list of other restaurants with good veggie options and she told us why word we need to use for veggie food in Vietnamese. 

The best part about this was that it was one of the best foods we have had in Hanoi and it was mad cheap! We spent about $16 CAD for two people and that includes spring rolls and a soft drink. 

We loved it so much that we went again the next day!

reviews.author: Sonata S
reviews.title: Perfect place
reviews.content: It is wonderful place to east Vietnam food. Service is fabulous!!!:) we recommend verymuch. Price are low but food quality- high!

reviews.author: Cheryl M
reviews.title: Top Vietnamese dish to try
reviews.content: Lee was amazing, really helpful with explaining how to eat the dish like proper locals. She was great, super friendly and helpful. The food was unbelievable, a friend said you can't leave without trying Bun Cha, so on our last evening after exploring we found this great restaurant around the corner from our hostel. Really amazing upstairs venue to eat this great dish served with awesome staff. Thanks Lee and team for an unforgettable dinner.

reviews.author: Ashleigh
reviews.title: Real taste of Vietnam
reviews.content:
On our first day in Hanoi, my friend and I struggled to find a vegetarian friendly restaurant. 
We happened to stumble across Bun Cha Ta.
Delightful!! Lee was our gorgeous waitress who was able to recommend dishes for both meat eaters (me) and veggie for my friend. Her English was fantastic and we had lovely chit chat with her about our up coming travels and she again was able to give helpful suggestions.
I tried my first egg coffee as well and that was also yum.
Highly recommend this restaurant. Reasonable prices and delicious flavors. You won’t be disappointed 😊

reviews.author: sshamim97
reviews.title: Amazing Vegetarian Vietnamese street food!
reviews.content:
I went to Bun Cha Ta as I was looking for veggie food but could not find it around Old Town Hanoi. Saw this place on TripAdvisor and glad I went as the veggie options were so delicious! You should try option  6 ( veggie spring rolls and rice noodle with soup).

Lee was very friendly and helpful, and showed me how to prepare the soup.

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for good veggie food, and even good meat options.

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: Good Bun Cha alternative to Obama/ Bourdain
reviews.content: After a slight brainfart of thinking I needed to go to the restaurant Obama and Bourdain unintentionally turned into a tourist trap. I decided to try Bun Cha Ta. It was an excellent choice. I had the traditional Bun Cha, egg rolls and a beer served with a complimentary "Heavy Water" meal was reasonably priced and clean. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Especially Jing (in pic). Bun Cha Ta won't disappoint.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.title: Amazing service and food!
reviews.content: Ann was very friendly showing us the ins and outs on how to eat bun cha the Vietnamese way. The food was tasty and perfect portion. Recommend!

reviews.author: Aline BR
reviews.title: Very nice streetfood
reviews.content: We had a pleasant evening eating the typical Hanoi soup. On the first floor you take off your shoes and sit at a low table.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.title: Favourite Bun Cha
reviews.content: This was my favourite Bun Cha restaurant I visited during my 2 weeks in Vietnam :) Had the Bun cha, spring rolls and lemon drink.

reviews.author: Ellis Williams
reviews.title: Amazing food and service!
reviews.content: Our whole experience at this restaurant was amazing! Our waitress, Ngoc, was very attentive and showed us exactly how to eat the traditional Vietnamese dish - which was delicious!! We went for the pork with noodles and spring rolls.. amazing flavours!

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Delicious street food
reviews.content: Super flavorful, fresh, delicious street food served in a comfortable atmosphere with fair prices and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Sightsee25982794303
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here is delicious. Our host, Jing, was extremely helpful and she demonstrated to us how to eat the Bun Cha. The prices were very good and we even got given complimentary rice wine shots after our meal. Couldnt reccommend this place more!

reviews.author: Inspire50152544296
reviews.title: An absolute must eat when in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Jing was very pleasant! She spoke English and gave us suggestions on what was good. All of the food is delicious! She then told us how to eat it and she proceeded to explain to every table with a huge smile on her face! The atmosphere and service are second to none!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.content: Visited this lovely restaurant, inside is simple, very good quality food, very tasty! And lovely friendly staff, happy to chat to customers. I really enjoyed my food and drink here, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Jimmybraz
reviews.title: A very nice experience
reviews.content:
As many others have mentioned , the food was great . If you are hesitant to eat bun cha on the street , then this will be a good place to sample this great dish.

And a special thank you to Lee for your very attentive service , wish you all the best . The apricot rice wine was prettty yummy too.
jimmy

reviews.author: Gabriela
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: Amazin food, reasonablr price and very kind staff especially Ms Lee! We were also given traditional rice wine (on the house) And highly recommend this place to everyone !

reviews.author: Katie P
reviews.title: Cute little restaurant
reviews.content:
Stopped by for a quick and convenient dinner. The dining areas are split in two floors and the menu is kept minimalistic. 

Shoes off as you sit on long wooden benches but you still retain your personal space. Waitresses are all very helpful with good English (thank you to Lee!) 

Great food for excellent price. Dishes around 60.000 for Bun Cha and 100.000 if you'd like a combo with rolls. 

Would eat there again :)

reviews.author: Colin O
reviews.title: Friendly intro to Hanoi
reviews.content: As others have said in the reviews, very friendly people! Ngoc helped us and walked us through how to eat Bun Cha. Tasty food and a good way to learn how to start eating types of Hanoi food. Clean restaurant, but not as fun and authentic Hanoi as the street food setups.

reviews.author: gow
reviews.title: Made my trip to Vietnam in one single meal
reviews.content: This is one of the most spectacular dinner I’ve had on my trip so far. The price, atmosphere, staff, quality of food and the taste makes this place THE must-visit recommendations in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Jolly M
reviews.title: Friendly, great food
reviews.content: Lee Is a wonderful host. Very friendly. They have great fun char and have a fantastic rice whisky. Had a great time here a year ago and had to come back and it is still fantastic. Five stars.

reviews.author: kdyding
reviews.title: Friendly people, good food in a comfortable setting
reviews.content: Had a great time hanging out and talking to Jing, very friendly staff. Food was good for me and loved the black sticky rice yoghurtz

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Great intro into Hanoi street food in a comfortable setting
reviews.content:
Wanted to get off the busy streetside food scene for a meal while still enjoying authentic Hanoi eats so I headed here. Very kind staff who are eager to walk you through how to eat Bun Cha. Ann was awesome and she told us the ingredients which make the broth so distinct and sweet as well as explaining all the herbs in the basket which you tear up and eat in your broth. The pork has a nice barbecued flavor to balance the sweet of the broth. When I finished Ann was kind enough to point out some of the sights to go view around the city and explained each one with passion! 
Go for the food, stay for the friendly service and enjoy Bun Cha Ta!

reviews.author: Ginnyleeinwonderland
reviews.title: Not a delicious meal
reviews.content: It was a suggestion of a friend for me to try to have meal there. It looked like a famous place. when I was there, they asked me to go to second floor and I had to take off my shoes. I didn't like it because someone could step on my white shoes and have them all dirty. I ordered a normal Bun Cha, it was double price than what I had in other place in the old quarter. And it was even more expensive with spring rolls. I thought it was a big meal but I was wrong. I was as normal as other Bun Cha. They put in too many meat balls. So it was not traditional Bun cha anymore. It was like meatballs bun. The pork was really dry since it was not fat on it and it was hard to have a dry and hard pork. The sauce was mostly tasteless. When I put Bun in, it really tasteless so I decided not to put in many Bun. The sauce smell like sauce for other dished which was Banh Cuon. So 90% of the Bun Cha was not good, that made the whole Bun Cha not good anymore. So It was my bad choice in this trip

reviews.author: 244galb
reviews.title: The food is not fresh and cooked one time in the morning
reviews.content: We went because of the good reviews we saw,but unfortunately when we asked were they cook the food, they said it’s cooked before! The meat was not good and we felt not good after. Not recommended.

reviews.author: AndrewNicholson
reviews.title: Yum, great food, eat this.
reviews.content:
As my title says, eat this food, its good, really good, you know you want to eat it - so go and eat it. 

It's Bun Cha, Pork belly - good, Pork balls - good, Broth - good, Rice noodle - good, Fresh herbs - good.

Eat it.

5/5

reviews.author: tabigasuki08
reviews.title: Great place to try Bun Cha!
reviews.content: Food was great, and so was the service! It was my first time to try Bun Cha so I have nothing to compare it to, but I thought it was delicious!

reviews.author: ynmw
reviews.title: Amazing food and service
reviews.content: The food was one of the best in Hanoi. A friendly and smiling waitress, Ngoc, explained to us how to enjoy the meal correctly. Do try the black sticky rice with yogurt, it was sooooo good!

reviews.author: Marin C
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha!
reviews.content: Food here is consistently good. Spring rolls are great, along with the rice wine whiskey! The server Jing is so helpful, she has great recommendations:)

reviews.author: Kacy W
reviews.title: Great Food with English-Speaking Service
reviews.content: This place doesn’t have a line out the door; it is mainly western tourists who go here. That said, the food is delicious and menu easy to navigate. Our server Ann explained to us how to eat Bun Cha, and she even made recommendations on other food in Hanoi and where to go next. Although they didn’t know whether the fresh  veggies had been washed in distilled water (for western tummies), the staff was kind enough to tolerate me when I washed the bowl of herbs in my own bottled water, then got up from my seat to dump the washing water outside. My husband was raving about the food afterwards.

reviews.author: Drew P
reviews.title: Amazing intro to Bun Cha
reviews.content: We were new to the amazingness that is Bun Cha. Our waitress was very sweet and took the time to walk us through the menu. We ended up opting for her helpful recommendations. The meals were delicious, all ingredients seemed fresh and overall it was a great experience. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.title: Top1
reviews.content: Great place to eat Bun Cha, very nice staff, June was very helpful and explain me all details of the dishes. Spring rolls are amazing, a must visit place, thanks for a great meal!

reviews.author: marcel
reviews.title: Great food and service
reviews.content: We went there to eat bun cha. The food was really good and our host Ann was super welcoming. She explained the origin of the food as well as how to eat it. Moreover, she was super kind an recommended us other places like cafés, where just the locals go. I would highly recommend to pay Bun Cha Ta and Ann a visit!

reviews.author: Ellen J
reviews.title: Will visit again
reviews.content: Definitely a must try if you're in Hanoi. Great atmosphere, cosy interior and food is suuuper delicious and authentic! And not to mention great service. We got some great advice from Trinh about where to go for good coffee and traditional vietnamese dessert. :D

reviews.author: jamecrew15
reviews.title: Priceless
reviews.content: A MUST!! What a very special place to eat Bun Cha, a famous dish of Hanoi.  This dish is just perfect and delightful in every way.  The staff is so friendly and helpful and inviting. An all around unforgettable experience

reviews.author: Yochai G
reviews.title: Bun Cha is a must dish when visiting Hanoi
reviews.content:
Bun Cha is a soup with grilled meat and grilled patties. The pork variety is the best in my opinion. This is definitely my favorite Vietnamese dish thus far.
The service at Bun Cha Ta is great, and the soup is excellent.

reviews.author: Alex P
reviews.title: Delicious Hanoi food
reviews.content: Bun Cha is a noodle soup with grilled pork and fried spring rolls that's popular in Hanoi. We got it at this place and it was delicious. You should also try their egg coffee which was outstanding.

reviews.author: José
reviews.title: Simply delicious
reviews.content: Amazing food, friendly staff, great space. Please choose the seafood rolls as a side dish, you can't miss this

reviews.author: showey L
reviews.title: Worth to try!!
reviews.content: Grilled pork dip with special soup base; may choose the Vege you like to eat with the pork and noodles! Very clear briefing about how to eat when you are the first timer. Nice food with reasonable price.

reviews.author: Madeleine H
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.content: Food was so yummy!!! Lovely atmosphere and the waiter named hanh was so kind and funny! We loved the idea of putting everything in the hot broth as you go yum yum yum <3

reviews.author: Filipa Azevedo Serrano
reviews.title: Cosy meal
reviews.content: For a first timer in vietnam food, it's a nice and cosy place to go to. Food is very comforting and not too expensive.

reviews.author: Garrett D
reviews.title: A Must Eat!
reviews.content: Definitely stop by this place. The food was amazing and the service was top notch. Ngoc was very informative about the food and Vietnam. 100% recommend!!

reviews.author: travelermei
reviews.title: Mediocre food but great service
reviews.content:
Having tried other bun cha in Hanoi, Bun Cha Ta was a bit lackluster. The soup was a bit too salty and the pork meatballs were rather uninspired. However, it’s still a solid meal. This place definitely caters to tourists. We didn’t see a single local there during our meal. It’s also a bit on the pricier side. 

But the staff speaks great English and are extremely friendly and welcoming. The spring rolls were also very good.

reviews.author: Mr. Morten
reviews.title: The best
reviews.content: Ngoc was very friendly towards us and delicious food!!! she even told us a bit history about the food

reviews.author: Extraordinary819771
reviews.title: Good Bun Cha
reviews.content: The bun cha here is very good, served with springrolls and a fresh bowl of herbs, a nice presentation on “how you eat it” by Ngoc 👌🏻

reviews.author: Richard N
reviews.title: Great place for Bun Cha
reviews.content: I landed in Hanoi 2 hours ago and was recommended this place by my hotel as it's a few blocks away. The food is fantastic and Ngoc - the main hostess and waitress is extremely helpful. It's a locals place that is beginning to cater to tourists by offering English menus and helpful staff. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: huntsvilletri
reviews.title: Fantastic food and service
reviews.content: This resto came highly recommended by our hotel, La Selva, and it didn't disappoint.  We had two number 1s and three side dishes of veggie spring rolls which was good enough to feed my wife and I, and two kids.  Thank you so much for the chopstick lessons!

reviews.author: corobo-traveler
reviews.title: Nice and casual street food restaurant in hanoi
reviews.content: We ate "Bun Cha" several times in hanoi. Consequently, we thought that this restaurant is the best! They served us a lot of mint to eat with "Bun Cha". That combination was the best for us. Also waitress was so great. Ms Lee welcomed us kindly. She teached us about foods, tourist spots, and more. That dinner was a great experience.

reviews.author: Nha D
reviews.title: Love Bun cha Ta Hanoi
reviews.content: Very delicious Bun Cha and comfortable places for foreigners..will come back soon..Hanoi Nov 3rd 2018

reviews.author: tillsmint
reviews.title: Amazing food!
reviews.content: Had the most amazing food here on our arrival to Hanoi. We where greated by our host NGOL, who not only showed us favourite options on the menu but also gave us helpful tips for the area. Will defiantly be coming back to this restaurant.

reviews.author: misslaralynn
reviews.title: Best lunch in Hanoi!
reviews.content:
We loved the casual atmosphere here and fantastic food. The fried spring rolls are a must side dish. The staff was very friendly and eager
To practice their English. Delicious stop for lunch or dinner!

reviews.author: Tourist555674
reviews.title: Very tasty!
reviews.content: We had a fantastic lunch here with really tasty, fresh ingredients. We loved experiencing bun cha for the first time. Jing was a brilliant waitress who showed us the best way to eat bun cha. She went above and beyond and told us about other different foods to try whilst we travel around Vietnam and let us try some homemade ginger liquor. We will definitely return!

reviews.author: Kieren H
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: We came here on recommendation from one of the staff at our hostel and we were not disappointed. We were new to Bum Cha and the staff happily showed us the correct way to eat this cuisine (yes there is a way) since coming here and getting a taste for the dish, I've tried a couple of other restaurants, including the infamous bun cha Obama. But none of them come close to this place, which is why we keep coming back. One waitress in particular stands out, Ngoc (Jade) who was incredibly friendly and helpful and made our dining experience even better. I could not recommend this place enough!

reviews.author: Ujjwal G
reviews.title: Friendly staff and nice ambiencw
reviews.content: The food is delicious and Ngoc our waitress was a really friendly person. Showed us how to eat the dishes the Vietnamese way and actually even chatted with us about our trip.

reviews.author: mzh0u
reviews.title: Cater to foreigners
reviews.content: We ate here as recommended by our hotel staff and was told it’s a local favorite but when we got to the restaurant, it was all foreigners. The food was okay; street food was better. We also thought it was more pricey compare to the street stalls. It was nice of the waitress to teach all the customer how to eat Bun Cha though

reviews.author: Madeline S
reviews.title: Do yourself a favour and eat here!
reviews.content: After being recommended here by a friend who used to live in Hà Nội I knew it would be great. Jing served us and explained how to eat our bun cha like a local. She also told us many things about the cuisine in the area and other types of food to try. She was so friendly and welcoming! We can’t wait to go back! Easily the tastiest dish we have had in Hà Nội so far!

reviews.author: fabbosiger
reviews.title: Great food amazing hospitality
reviews.content: Lovely meal here tonight, the staff in particular Ngoc was amazing and talked me though how to eat also giving me some great local advise for things to do and see in the area !!

reviews.author: Thomas P
reviews.title: Very good and fast!
reviews.content: We ate traditional spring rolls which were delicious, served with a big portion of soup and rice. Very friendly staff (jade ngoc). Also very cheap so I recommend this vietnamese streetfood restaurant to everyone!

reviews.author: jcglasgo
reviews.title: Excellent Food in an Attractive Setting
reviews.content: We were recommended this restaurant by our hotel, and they weren't wrong. The food wad delicious, the service was great with the waitress explaining how to eat our meal and what to add to it, and a calm setting in among the hustle and bustle. We both opted for the Bun Cha with spring rolls. The spring rolls were the best I've tasted in the whole of South East Asia, and i tried different ones almost every day. The pork was really tasty, broth was fragrant and salad fresh. Worth a visit if you're nearby.

reviews.author: OnAir826865
reviews.title: Decent bun cha
reviews.content: We appreciated the staff's effort in walking us through the right way to eat bun cha. Food was good but we found that our spring rolls were quite oily. It's also more expensive (115VND for bun cha + seafood roll) when compared to Bun Cha Huong Lien aka Bun Cha Obama (85VND for bun cha + seafood roll + beer) but definitely still worth trying if you're in the area looking for something to eat.

reviews.author: Yvonne & Jason Australia
reviews.title: 1st time for Bun Cha from Australia
reviews.content:
Wow, what a shame we left it until our last night to go here. Bun Cha #1 & #4 were just beautiful, so fresh and full of flavor. Katy was fantastic, she explained everything with excellent English and she was such a happy positive girl. 
Thank you very much, from Yvonne and Jason.

reviews.author: Ellen U
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta Hanoi, Vietnam
reviews.content: Service was excellent and prompt. Their Bun Cha (beef soup with noodles) was delicious. Vegetables were all very fresh. Be careful of how much fresh garlic and chili you use. It's available on the tables-you just need a little bit!

reviews.author: Andy22L
reviews.title: a must-eat when in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Hanoi is famous for bun cha, so this dish is a must-try when in Hanoi. I recommend item no.1 on the menu which is the bun cha set with fried spring rolls. At only VND95,000 it's really affordable given the generous portion sizes. Be prepared for an explosion of interesting new flavours as you dig into your food. The restaurant is in a tiny 3 story building with a very steep staircase leading to the upper floors. If you have leg problems, then try to get a seat on the ground floor.

reviews.author: Chuck D
reviews.title: Must Have!!
reviews.content: Literally no menu, you sit and they bring you food. Only thing the ask you is what you want to drink. The food is delicious, the pork is to die for!

reviews.author: carloscharmy
reviews.title: Bun Cha
reviews.content: One of my favourite dishes in Hanoi! I ordered the Bun Cha Ta full option and it was great! I'd like to point out something. If you order a hot cacao do not bother ordering the "egg chocolate cream" dessert because it is the same thing! I had a hot cacao and I ordered that dessert and I was disappointed to see that it was the same thing ><"

reviews.author: katerina20153
reviews.title: Good food
reviews.content: Food quality was great, but I believe the full set was slightly overpriced. However, it's worth visiting this place at least once to taste bun cha.

reviews.author: Craig Gilroy
reviews.title: Great traditional food
reviews.content: Great food in a traditional setting. Friendly staff and a great atmosphere. Try and sit upstairs where its shoes off and sit on the floor. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dylansanderism
reviews.title: Best bun cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: I enjoyed my meal so much I returned two more times before leaving Hanoi. The service was amazing and I couldn't pass up trying their rice wine whiskey. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: JojoFromManila
reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.content: Great value for your money! Great ambiance with warm welcome from staff. Super tasty pho and superb service from Katy!

reviews.author: Mary-Ann S
reviews.title: Good food and egg coffe
reviews.content: Great food. Try the full package nudle soup with springrolls on the side. I recommend egg coffee for a dessert. Egg coffee is a must try. It is a sweet eggcream instead a milk with your coffee. So good!

reviews.author: jendoublen
reviews.title: A must !
reviews.content: Delicious and great value. Highly recommend if you are looking for a good place for Bun Cha. We got number 1 which includes spring rolls.

reviews.author: ronanosullivan91
reviews.title: Amazing, a must visit
reviews.content: We went during the day for lunch and it was some of the best food we had in our time in Vietnam. The staff were so warm and friendly. We got the #1, it was delicious. Also got an Egg Coffee, it was really nice. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mancunianabroad90
reviews.title: Fab food and nice environment
reviews.content:
Bun cha is my favourite Vietnamese food and I know it’s more of northern dish so Bun cha ta was the first place we visited on our trip to Hanoi from
Ho Chi Minh City. The seating area is quaint, up the stairs and has a very authentic feel to it. The food was well priced and tasted fantastic, it still baffles me how such simple ingredients can create such a tasty dish. The staff were friendly, helpful, attentive and spoke good English. I’d definitely recommend it as a well priced place to eat in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Haldun D
reviews.title: Very pleased Bun cha restaurant in Hanoi
reviews.content:
This restaurant has been advised us in Hanoi. Altough Bun cha Obama was there too.. Just at in Old quarter.. Clean,well organised and worker has explained to us how we prepare our Bun cha on the table..
Absulatly advisable..

reviews.author: mayasee
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha ever!
reviews.content: Food was so delicious, generous portion sizes and really lovely environment setting. The staff were welcoming and lovely. Would highly recommend this place !

reviews.author: Saf Traveler
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: Was literally one of the best meals I've had in recent memory. Friendly service, food arrived in no time and was freakin delicious. I highly recommend you go here.

reviews.author: LoveToTravel1010
reviews.title: Great little local restaurant
reviews.content: Great food, great service! Add in air con plus wifi equals a perfect meal out! Simple menu, basically the bun cha plus spring rolls. Quick friendly service so we were in and out within an hour! Highly recommend it for a quick simple local meal.

reviews.author: TuiG483
reviews.title: What a taste explosion!
reviews.content:
The meat was pull apart tender, the broth the perfect mix of flavors, lots of fresh herbs to add, fresh chilli, garlic, noodles...perfection in a bowl. The iced lemon drink was great to quench the thirst on a hot Hanoi day. 
They use bottle water for everything so you know it is safe to sit down & enjoy a few minutes away from the hustle of the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Hiang C
reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit
reviews.content: It was my first time trying Bun Cha Ta in Hanoi and it did not disappoint. The spring rolls (vegetarian) ones were the BEST! It was so crispy and refreshing

reviews.author: Fuzzynurse
reviews.title: Delicious for vegetarian too
reviews.content: We came here for lunch, lovely cool oasis out of the bustle of the streets. Staff was very helpful at explaining how to add the various goodies to the broth which was none we had had in the 2 weeks before throughout Vietnam. Also explaining what some of the herbs we could add we good for. The vegetarian spring rolls were excellent too. Would be happy to go back again if we were in Hanoi longer.

reviews.author: Michaelcarts82
reviews.title: OMG!!
reviews.content: If your in Hanoi... This is a must do! From the shoes off funky seating to the lovely staff you can’t miss this place! Bun cha is amazing... (Number 1 on the menu) Might not look filling but it’s a perfect amount. You even get fryed spring rolls that I don’t like in most places. These aren’t the tiny ones and packed full of flavor. Get there for dinner you won’t be disappointed! Be carful adding the chili, THEY HOT 😉

reviews.author: DanL
reviews.title: Friendly service
reviews.content: The staff was very welcoming and provided great service. The bun cha is decent. The flavor is pretty good but would’ve liked more pork belly and smokiness. The herb try was subpar and the prices are quite high. However, if you don’t speak Vietnamese and are looking for a convenient location, this place is not a bad option for bun cha.

reviews.author: Jeff H
reviews.title: This. Is. Life changing.
reviews.content:
I cant get enough of this.  I went once ... and then went every day afterward until I left the country.  Bun cha is freaking amazing.  It's indescribable, just go.

Oh, did I mention that dinner costs like $3?

reviews.author: dio
reviews.title: Great pork and atmosphere
reviews.content: Visited Hanoi and dreamed of trying bun cha in the city for some time now. This place did not disappoint us at all. Great grilled pork, silky smooth noodles and amazing lemonade.

reviews.author: Travelbysarsha
reviews.title: “Great spot for family eating”
reviews.content: We visited here after a recommendation from our hotel for local and fresh - but also something the kids would enjoy. Our kids are 12 & 10 yrs old (one is particularly fussy!) and we all loved the Bun Cha with Pork and Spring Roll (number 1 on Menu). Jing our waitress upstairs in the sunken seating dining room - was very helpful and friendly!! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: James A
reviews.title: Dinner
reviews.content:
We were recommended this place by our Concierge. It is a traditional Hanoi street food. We were not disappointed. I would go as far as saying after 3 weeks of travelling south to north it was possibly one of the best dishes. There are so many elements to this dish it’s hard to describe. As a westerner I would say it’s a Pho style broth however the flavour is dialled right up. It has a load of greens and and noodles that you add as you please however the winner for me is the bbq meats that are in the broth when served. It gives a lovely subtle charcoal flavour and the meat melts in your mouth......
I will be sourcing this dish on my return to Melbourne 
PS. Just order dish number 1. It’s the hero of the menu. They have kept this part of ordering simple

reviews.author: DP19900
reviews.title: Beautiful food
reviews.content: We searched for a Thai place and it brought us to this little hidden gem. The food was amaaaazing! The staff were so lovely and they explained everything and the food was really cheap compared to other places. We got the first thing on the menu, can’t remember what it’s called but it was beautiful!

reviews.author: gwnhvy
reviews.title: Couldn't have been better!
reviews.content: We were blown away by our meal here -- my partner got the #1, and I got the vegetarian option (tofu & an awesome tomato sauce), and we both were super impressed with the flavours. The egg coffee and rice&yogurt dessert were great as well. And the staff were super sweet - Jun & another very lovely girl whose name we didn't catch were super helpful and made our meal even better. We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Adamsmith123
reviews.title: Delicious bun cha
reviews.content: Great little restaurant, bun cha comes with some seriously good fried spring rolls. You get all of this for 100k dong. Service is also really friendly 😁

reviews.author: Sloane4
reviews.title: Bun Cha - Yee Ha
reviews.content:
Absolutely delicious, amazing little restaurant. You take you shoes off at the door before seated. Katy our waitress was more than
 that, she showed us how to eat Bun Cha and gave us lots of interesting information about the food we were eating. Our children, 11 and 13 said "this is the best food in Vietnam". Definitely worth going to.

reviews.author: Lisa E
reviews.title: So good!
reviews.content: We went here on a street food tour and tried the bun cha. It was sooooo good! My favourite dish of the tour :)

reviews.author: lziem
reviews.title: One of the best food experiences I had in Vietnam!
reviews.content: I actually went searching for finally find a good pho bo place (since I’ve been in Vietnam weeks and haven’t had one at all). Well this place came up on my google search so I went there, figuring out they actually don’t have pho but he place looked so nice! You take your shoes off and sit on the wooden floor and the place is decorated really nice and warm! So I took the bun cha, which includes rice noodles and pork meat. I don’t even like pork meat a lot but I figured if this place is called like the dish, I should get! It was absolutely amazing, you get a bowl of salad and noodles and the actual dish: the pork with brooth. The pork war so delicious, really like bbq meat and the taste was really intense! I would definitely come again! It was amazing :)

reviews.author: adequate8
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content:
Sceptical sometimes of street food dishes on TA but this place is fantastic! Delicious Bun Cha with awesome spring rolls. 

Special mention to the staff who are super friendly and helped us with our Vietnamese!

reviews.author: wofa
reviews.title: Lunch at Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: This was one of the best restaurants we have been to in hanoi. Good air con, Double story, and our food came within 3 minutes of order.the Food was exellent  for its value and waitress was super helpful.i would recommend this place to anyone going to hanoi for at least one night and 1 day.delicious food :) :):)

reviews.author: Sophia0420
reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.content: Believe the hype.  Excellent Bun Cha in a fun and friendly atmosphere. Don’t worry if you’ve never had bun cha -  they will show you the right way to eat it.  Usually busy, but no lines - and they have multiple floors so they will find you a spot right away.  Fast and inexpensive, and delicious!  Get the classic #1 and enjoy.

reviews.author: Nicolezzhu
reviews.title: Very nice foods
reviews.content: Loved the grill pork noodle soup with the spring rolls. Very friendly staffs, and clean environment for a good price. Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Natasha B
reviews.title: Cheap, traditional, tasty, clean
reviews.content: Excellent English speaking hostess with a beautiful disposition. Very tasty bun cha in a very cool environment: temperature and atmosphere. Very good value for dong. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Emilija K
reviews.title: The best place to eat Bun Cha!
reviews.content: We discovered this place with a food tour we did on our first day in Hanoi. Our dishes were so tasty, so we came back two more times! This place is always full of locals and tourists, so it shows how good the food is. I ordered vegetarian version and my husband took Bun Cha with meat and we both left very happy each time. Today our waitress was Hanh and she was such a lovely and interesting person to speak with! Highly recommending this place to everyone.

reviews.author: letmegonow
reviews.title: Must try.
reviews.content: Stumbled on this restaurant and had fantstic bun cha. Very kind staff explained how to eat the meal which was great saved me embarrassing myself. Definately recommend this one. Really great food and cheap.

reviews.author: Klára Š
reviews.title: Amazing Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: Amazing food, great service, nice atmosphere and good value for money. Absolutely recommend number 1 from the menu 😊🔝

reviews.author: En1gmat1on
reviews.title: Authentic and delicious Bun Cha.
reviews.content: Found this place in trip advisor and saw so many good review. I knew i need to try their bun cha. Very friendly and english speaking hostess. We went thru the correct way of eating Bun Cha.We were also introduce to their local rice wine Apple/Appriciot and black ginger rice wine which is said to help fatigue. Thumbs up to the Hostess!!

reviews.author: Stevie F
reviews.title: Great food, even better service!
reviews.content: This restaurant came recommended by our hotel. We ordered the #1 on the menu and the bun cha was amazing! Best of all, our server, Jing(?), took the time to explain the menu and showed us how to properly enjoy the food when it arrived. She was a fantastic person to have a conversation with to get to better understand the local culture.

reviews.author: Flo L
reviews.title: Fantastic Bun Cha! Must have in Hanoi!
reviews.content:
As we were looking for a place to have Bun Cha, the traditional meat, rice noodles and soup in Hanoi, this place was recommended to us by our hostel.

The food is amazing, the staff is helpful & friendly (you get an introduction in how to eat it like a local) and the place super comfy. Only thing that can be improved are the fresh juices and tee - too much water less taste. 

Went there twice during our time in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Eljohannes
reviews.title: Best soup
reviews.content: Not a fan of soup and the Pho I tried the first time I was in Vietnam didn't even make me write a review.  But, this one is different. It was absolutely amazing.  They serve a clear soup which blends sweetness amd sourness - this you can spice up dependingbon your preference.  Take item 1 and 4 and they will also serve the most amazing spring rolls ever!

reviews.author: Martin L
reviews.title: Just go!
reviews.content: Gorgeous food. Bun Cha is a Hanoi speciality you have to try. Bun Cha Ta was maybe our best meal in Vietnam (3 week trip). Staff were busy but really friendly, and a young lady called Hue was no.1. She spoke perfect English and explained how Bun Cha is made. We also had a great chat with her about Vietnam. Our friend in Liverpool UK ate here a few years ago and advised us to eat here. So glad we did x

reviews.author: Passenger814302
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: You must try, it is so great. Grill pork with white noodles, it is so delicious. Next time when i come Vietnam, i will come back!

reviews.author: Michael Y
reviews.title: Great food and service!
reviews.content: Delicious Bun Cha, the best we had in Hanoi! Great service, friendly staff, cost was $5 a plate. The meat in the soup was particularly good, highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Harvirules
reviews.title: Street food tour
reviews.content: I was introduced to Bun Cha Ta during a food tasting tour. I tried the egg coffee for the first time and I would highly recommend it. The bread roll was warm and fluffy , I can still taste the soft bread melting in my mouth. Friendly staff.

reviews.author: Rachael S
reviews.title: Tasty!
reviews.content: On a friend’s recommendation we dropped into Bun Cha Ta. It was very tasty and my husband loved the seafood spring rolls. Definitely check it out. Cold beer too!

reviews.author: Wilsonkjc
reviews.title: Delicious food!
reviews.content: Delicious bun cha in cozy restaurant. Was led to second floor by english speaking girl, Ting. Super friendly and recommend us places to visit and food to try in Hanoi. Definitely make our experience here better. Thanks, Ting!

reviews.author: María M
reviews.title: Bun Cha
reviews.content: Spectacular food, great experience of Vietnamese food. The portions are very well served. The best of all is the service, the staff is very friendly, especially Jing, she is very nice and an excellent host, she even made recomendarions. I would definitely repeat.

reviews.author: Emilypie
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: This was the highlight meal in Hanoi. We came here on an eating tour and had to come back the next night for dinner. We both had the Bun Cha, it is barbecued pork. The flavors are amazing and the meat is so tender and moist. I wish we were staying more nights in Hanoi so we could eat here more!

reviews.author: Ben C
reviews.title: The best noodle soup we had in Asia
reviews.content:
Vegetarian friendly -  I recommend the Bun Cha with Tomato Tofu.
Its just so super tasty.

Theres a really nice atmosphere, as the restaurant is made up of several floors, each with a cosy little dining room. The seating is kind of in the floor which is cool.

Really helpful and friendly staff, will also explain how to eat the food if you're not sure.

We went twice since it was the best food we had in Hanoi by a long shot.

reviews.author: Enric O
reviews.title: Great discovery
reviews.content: We came here during our street food tour and we must thank our guide for showing us this place since both food and service are excellent. We had here bun cha ta (as the name of the restaurant) and it was the best I've tried. My wife does not eat meat and they prepared a special version for her with non-meat broth, it was a fish broth actually and instead of meat had spring rolls which had to be put in the broth itself.  We will definitely be coming back to this place on our next visit to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sini
reviews.title: Very delicious food and friendly waitress!
reviews.content: Our first meal in Hanoi, selected the place based on review and was well worth it! Very delicious food and extremely good customer service, definitely recommended to visit! We chose option 1. grilled pork, rice noodle & spring rolls, very good!

reviews.author: Alvin Y
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content:
when come to Hanoi, just visit this little shop.
the bun cha was great, the spring roll was very good.
also the server is super friendly, they will guide you how to eat if you are first timer.
love the flavor as well.

spend : $30 for 3 pax

reviews.author: Alex J
reviews.title: One of the best meals I’ve had in SE Asia!
reviews.content:
Been travelling for nearly 2 and a half months now and can safely say that the Bun Cha here is one of, if not, THE best meal I’ve had! 
I went on 1st Sep 18 for evening meal, loved it so much I’m here again today (2nd Sep 18) for lunch and am seriously considering coming here again tonight 😂 
Staff are so friendly and the food is of such high quality despite being street food-like prices! 
A must visit in Hà Nội

reviews.author: Joanna B
reviews.title: Great restaurant! Great service!
reviews.content: I went to this place three times during my week in Hanoi. The place is clean, the bun cha is delicious, the service is phenomenal! The staff are friendly and even show you how to eat the food and can tell you the history of the dish and egg coffee. They gave me a shot of rice whiskey two of the times that I ate there. 100% recommend this restaurant!

reviews.author: Chloe H
reviews.title: The best Bun Cha!
reviews.content: Great, authentic street food for a reasonable price. The staff were really friendly telling us how to eat the bun cha as it was our first time having it. It was that good that we went again, this time sitting upstairs. The waitress upstairs was very friendly and chatty teaching us some basic Vietnamese. Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Misschoden
reviews.title: First timer
reviews.content: Our first time eating Bun Cha Ta. We had no idea what it was but came along because of the reviews. Our waitress Jing was very nice and sweet. She instructed us on how to eat it while also explaining the history behind it. Thank you for your help and we will come back before we leave Hanoi!

reviews.author: Siok H
reviews.title: Satisfied!
reviews.content: My family’s first time to Vietnam and this is our first meal. They love it. The waitress Trinh is enthusiastic and goes extra mile to give us other food recommendation in Hanoi. Good head start for our trip.

reviews.author: Vacation714423
reviews.title: Great meal!
reviews.content: Such a great meal--definitely try the Number 1: Bun Cha Ta. My friends and I loved it. Jun was also a great hostess. Overall wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Eline D
reviews.title: Great food and service!
reviews.content:
We highly recommend this place, the food was amazing and the girl explained us how to eat it and invited us a shot of rice liquor. It’s cheap (50-95 dong per meal) and the quantities are perfect. The Vietnamese rolls and the meat are fresh, they also go there with food tours. 
We would go back here for sure!

reviews.author: Eric M
reviews.title: Number 1 special. Amazing. Had it 3 times!
reviews.content: The Bun Cha (meat noodle soup) is out of the world. I was in hanoi for a week and came back to Bun Cha Ta three times. It's a bit more expensive than usual meals in hanoi, but it is worth it!

reviews.author: Jon H
reviews.title: Fabulous Bun Chat
reviews.content: Really good Bun Chat. Very fresh and great tasting. Also, very reasonably priced. We had a lovely meal, despite a couple of power cuts!! Worth visiting.

reviews.author: Fabienne P
reviews.title: Best springrolls in town
reviews.content: We bumped up this place and had a lovely meal. Friendly staff and fresh food, must try the springrolls

reviews.author: Hussain S
reviews.title: Lunch!
reviews.content: Really delicious and authentic Vietnamese food and excellent service! Would definitely come again if I re-visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: Chelsea F
reviews.title: Buncha was just okay
reviews.content: Had high expectations after seeing good reviews for this place but was slightly disappointed. The buncha here is served with only pork patties and not pork belly meat, and I felt that the dipping broth was not as flavorful as some that I’ve tried. It was a decent meal but you can definitely get better bunchas at other local eateries at lower prices.

reviews.author: Oriental T
reviews.title: Tourist friendly place - common food tour stop
reviews.content:
We came here with a group of 7. There were many other food tours that came here with their guests. For a good reason for sure.

The staff spoke very good English and showed genuine curiosity in where we come from. We were a weird group of people from everywhere and of all ages. 

The food is good. You could probably find the same dish on the streets. But if you don't want to grind it out, this is a great option with a/c, service, sit-down experience, English menu that you can check out.

reviews.author: Steve Walker
reviews.title: Simply delicious
reviews.content: Small place with a limited menu but the flavours will knock your socks off... I'd very much recommend the Bun Cha Ta Full Option (number 1 on their menu) for two people to share.... Yummmy...

reviews.author: barreirosjn
reviews.title: Cosy Restaurant - Street Food
reviews.content:
Cosy restaurant. Eat like a truly Vietnamese (without your shoes - upstairs room) and great food. 
Lovely service and attending from Trinh. 
Pit stop recommended!

reviews.author: Quentin R
reviews.title: Very good bun chan
reviews.content:
Really nice ! Very friendly and good bun cha for cheap price 
I recommande for a dinner in a cool place

reviews.author: MaxDamage
reviews.title: Simple and tasty
reviews.content: Went here for lunch do on after arriving in Hanoi. This was recommended by our hotel. Our first experience of the local speciality was a great one. A small menu, mostly bun cha. The main dining area is quite unique. The waitress taught us how to eat Bun Cha as well which was very handy. By UK standards incredibly cheap, 2 Bun Cha meals with 2 beers around £8. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Balirevs
reviews.title: The best fried spring rolls in Hanoi
reviews.content: Delicious Bun Cha ta. Will go again before we leave. Best Hanoi spring rolls. I’m salivating while typing this up. U won’t regret it.

reviews.author: 998chanellep
reviews.title: Awesome bun cha!
reviews.content:
My husband and I visited this bun cha restaurant for lunch and loved it. As neither of us eat pork it can be hard finding bun cha that caters to other dietary requirements so we appreciated the vegetarian options that were available. 

Our waiters Zun was genuinely lovely. She took the time to explain the meal and also explained what all the herbs were and what benefits each one has. 

We highly recommend a visit to Bun Cha Ta when in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Louise K
reviews.title: The absolut best bun cha in Vietnam
reviews.content: The titel says it all. I have recommended this place to everyone i've talked to. The taste is perfect, the noodles aren't sticky and the taste of the meat is amazing. The best place, and i travelled through Vietnam, having bun cha several places.

reviews.author: Anouk R
reviews.title: Best dinner in Vietnam
reviews.content: This was my first solo dinner but it was the best one so far. Hanh really took the time to explain all the dishes and how to eat with chopsticks. She gave me advice on my further travels. We even turned out to both be finance students. Would recommend anyone to go and have dinner here!

reviews.author: yboxer
reviews.title: Best Bun cha ta
reviews.content: The best Bun cha ta dish in Hanoi. Great atmosphere - go upstairs to the second floor. The service is excellent - speaking English.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Our favourite food
reviews.content: We had never tried Bun Cha until it got recommended to us. Felt like we were eating in someone’s living room which added to the charm of the experience. Menu serves Bun Cha and spring rolls only, but you do not need anything else. Definitely worth a visit!!! Staff were so friendly

reviews.author: Jaclyn
reviews.title: Next favourite Vietnamese dish!
reviews.content:
Besides Pho, this Hanoi speciality has gone into my next favourite Vietnamese dish!

Staff is friendly and seeing that we are not locals, the female staff took extra length to explain in English how to enjoy the dish. Service was prompt and courteous. Place is clean and spacious. We were being ushered into the level 3 with Japanese alike tatami restaurant setting, with our legs resting upright inside an area. 

We ordered the set which came with the fried spring rolls and it was a perfect side dish to the rice noodle soup with yummy grilled pork. We were being told that the original bun cha experience comes with the self assembling of the rice noodle with your picks of vegetables to your soup broth. Another information told was that this is also uniquely found in Hanoi and the Northern & Southern serve and eat the dish differently. 

The highlight was really the broth for us. It has a sour and sweet soul. When you dip the crispy appetisers in it, the seafood or pork spring rolls when infused with the broth tasted really great with it. 

Glad to find a quality bun cha served by this restaurant.

reviews.author: sanghol308
reviews.title: First Time to Have a Bun Cha
reviews.content: It was the first time for us to have Bun Cha. The dish was delicious and our two kids love it too. This place has air conditioner so it was cool inside. The staffs are very kind and very helpful.

reviews.author: LML_15
reviews.title: Perfect!!!
reviews.content: I really enjoyed this place. The food is tasty and the staff very professional and kind! I recommend it!!! Come and try it!!!

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: Fantastic bun cha
reviews.content: If you're looking for good bun cha, look no further. The service, food, and atmosphere here is wonderful. If you can, sit upstairs, it's quieter and there is a peaceful sunken dining room for guests. Generous portions, cold beer, and excellent service. I look forward to my next visit.

reviews.author: Brandon Lim
reviews.title: Extremely delicious food with even better service
reviews.content:
A must come when in Hanoi.

The food is delicious and the waitresses there have an exceptional level of service and made us feel very welcome. They also speak fluent English and are knowledgeable on the best places to eat and visit.

We tried a variety of items on the menu and all were really good. A must come for cheap and tasty food!

reviews.author: Emmanuel S
reviews.title: Good Local Food......
reviews.content:
Having lived in Hanoi for years, I can confidently say that the Bun Cha here is very good.

The staff working there are very accommodating and friendly.

The restaurant itself has a very good local feel and the service is pretty fast.

I will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Donald_950512
reviews.title: Thanks for Zun
reviews.content:
처음 가서 1번 메뉴 분차타 풀 옵션 시켜먹었는데 여행객 상대로 한 음식점 치고 가격도 저렴하고 고기에서 한국에서 먹던 돼지갈비 맛이 나서
너무 맛있게 먹었네요.
같이 나오는 스프링롤은 조금 기름졌는데 그냥 먹을수 있을정도였구요 느억맘소스가 그렇게 시큼하지 않아서 피클싫어하는 저로서는 너무 좋았습니다

I visited here for the first time.
I ordered Bun Cha Ta Full Option.
It was really nice to me.
The spring rolls were good but a little oily.
But the pork was tottally good.
Souce was not too sour so I loved it.

reviews.author: Roaming Kiwi
reviews.title: Top notch food
reviews.content: Fantastic flavourful food - a simple menu done very well. The staff are delightful and it was great to have a tasty vegetarian bun cha option as well!

reviews.author: Jerry Háša
reviews.title: Amazing bun cha
reviews.content: Very good bun cha. A lot of food for 95k dong. The waitress (Zun) was so kind and cheerful. We loved it here and would come back again if we had time.

reviews.author: Adna D
reviews.title: Went back for a second helping!
reviews.content: Highly recommend eating here! We stumbled on it completely by chance and had the best time. The Bun Cha Ta full option was delicious and a fun experience to add ingredients as you eat. We then went back a second time during our stay because we loved it so much - Hue was a star and made us feel very welcome!

reviews.author: Adrienne
reviews.title: My new fave!
reviews.content:
I only always have Pho as my Vietnamese fix but ever since I tried this Bun Cha, it tasted like heaven!!! I googled online and this place came up as one of the best reviewed restaurants in the Old Quarter. Best to have it while the soup is still hot as it gets cold pretty quick. 

Although this restaurant can be pretty expensive (90k dong for a full set) compared to the side street food shops, which you can get a Bun Cha for only 25-35k dong, the ambiance and the service here make it all worthy! Jun served me and all the other guests during that day and she was very friendly. She would talk to everyone and even offer an introduction on how to eat the food if it's your first time to have it. 

So if you're a little conscious about eating street foods and would opt for a cleaner version, then try it here! But if you're adventurous, you can find Bun Cha on the same side of the street with much cheaper price, probably a walk of 1-2 minutes. Either way, trying both won't hurt so much! :)

reviews.author: Nicksyang
reviews.title: bad smelly noodle for Bun Cha
reviews.content:
I had Bun Cha.
the sauce and pork meat was not bad.
but noodle for Bun cha smelled aged and rotten rice
I can’t recommend Bun Cha.

reviews.author: Sergio F
reviews.title: Excellent food and value for money
reviews.content: Went there following a recommendation on trip advisor and thoroughly enjoyed the service and the food was absolutely delicious

reviews.author: Anitapinto
reviews.title: Tasty, clean, comfortable
reviews.content: Very conveniently located in the old quarter. Had a great seating area upstairs where you sit with your shoes off. Our hostess Zun took the time to explain how to eat our food and explained a little about Vietnamese culture. We really appreciated her warmth and excitement. The food was really tasty and the pork perfectly cooked. Soup was a great balance of salty and sweet. For a random pick based on reviews I’m happy I found this place

reviews.author: speak.unicorn
reviews.title: Fun little dinner with my parents & boyfriend
reviews.content: It’s a really cute place! We sat upstairs and ate the bun cha. Atmosphere was young and a good experience but the bun cha was too sweet for me.

reviews.author: Colombe
reviews.title: Thanks Zun !
reviews.content:
Amazing restaurant, really cosy and cute ! Thanks to Zun the waiteress,she was so kind and so friendly !
We will come back for sure !

reviews.author: Lydia B
reviews.title: Best food in Vietnam
reviews.content: Stopped here by chance and am so pleased that I did! Zun was delightful and explained how to eat the delicious food. I would fully recommend the full option, well worth the price!

reviews.author: Caitlin
reviews.title: Excellent Bun Cha
reviews.content: Tried vietnamese food all over Vietnam and this did not disappoint! Excellent fresh food, so much flavour. We went twice during our stay in hanoi as is was so good!

reviews.author: Robert Thompson
reviews.title: Lovely food and staff
reviews.content: I had some lovely food, the fried rolls being the best I have tastes. I was also given some information about the dishes. The young lady came over, made me feel welcome, told me about the food I was trying and some other dishes I should try.

reviews.author: Phebe H
reviews.title: Best bun Cha!
reviews.content: Come here to eat Bun Cha! It’s an air conditioned indoor seating restaurant. Their #1 special comes with noodles and bun Cha and 2 spring rolls. The pork balls are so juicy and delicious. We also tried the egg cream coffee and hot chocolate and both were creamy and delicious. It’s on the western side of Old Quarter so very accessible as well.

reviews.author: megju
reviews.title: Great food and atmosphere
reviews.content: Our hotel recommended to go to this restaurant and try Bun Cha, the food is delicious, we had option 1 - soup with pork meatballs, plate of noodles, herbs and 2 spring rolls. You dip the noodles and spring rolls in the flavourful broth - delicious! Our waitress Trinh was very friendly and explained everything to us! We really enjoyed the food, service and atmosphere.

reviews.author: gracieobn
reviews.title: Grilled pork a Must !
reviews.content: Venue easy to locate. Yummy, healthy food with friendly staff. Well spoken staff to recommend and share their culture.  Worth a visit!

reviews.author: mach3blackbird
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha!
reviews.content: We stopped here for dinner and had the Bun Cha Ta full option as recommended by our excellent waitress Trinh. They only serve Bun Cha which is similar to Pho but more meat and a different broth. It was delicious - the spring rolls are especially good!! Trinh was great, explaining what each menu item was. Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: Craig B
reviews.title: The best bun cha in Hanoi!!
reviews.content: What can I say, I’ve been back twice over 3 days because it’s that good. The taste is out of this world. I’ll be back again for sure!!!!

reviews.author: Danni R
reviews.title: Great local street food!
reviews.content:
Went for lunch, Great food. 
Location and shop does make you think your tummy may disagree with your choice, however not at all. 
Quick with your order, service and busy . 
Great food, good price, lovely staff. 
Two floors second floor you take your shoes off and sit on the ground. We preferred the ground/first floor with a normal sized table. 

Thank you Bun Cha Ta!!  We will be back.

reviews.author: repository138
reviews.title: Good food, great owner!
reviews.content: I'm very happy that this was my first food stop in Hanoi. The bun cha was delicious. My dad, who had never had Vietnamese food before, loved it (especially the fried spring rolls). Trinh, the owner, was incredibly nice and spent time talking to us about her cooking process and even some other local places that were good stops for eats throughout the city. I even got some impromptu Vietnamese lessons to supplement my fledging vocabulary. Will definitely visit again next time I'm in the north.

reviews.author: Sander S
reviews.title: 5 stars is not enough
reviews.content: The food here is absolutely amazing. Number 1 on the many is absolutely fantastic. It is of great quality and the staff is amazing. Waitress Zun helped us during our two visits. She not only has a very positive attitude but does everything to make you feel comfortable incl. teaching us our first words of Vietnamese. We enjoyed it a lot!

reviews.author: Minh-Ha N
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.content:
I came here because of the positive reviews on tripadvisor. But to be honest i was a bit disappointed with their main dish “bun cha”. The taste is nothing special, if i don’t want to say not so good, compared to other cheaper bun cha restaurants in town. The decoration is old and not as clean as i expected. The service is quick though. 
I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant for its bun cha. No wonder there is no Vietnamese in the restaurant when we came for lunch, only foreigners.

reviews.author: madden03
reviews.title: Delicious local food
reviews.content: Was recommended this restaurant by a friend who had recently been in Hanoi. We ate here on our second night in Vietnam and so glad we did. Delicious food and friendly staff, who taught us how best to eat our Bun Cha Ta. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jordan M
reviews.title: Best meal in Hanoi, especially for first-timers!
reviews.content: This was our first meal in Vietnam, and we may have eaten here twice more when we realised that we had just had to bring our fiends! The women working here were so helpful in helping us order and showing us how to eat the food. The food is both devious and affordable, I had the recommended option with pork whilst my girlfriend had the vegetarian option. The food is tasty and affordable. Twice we ate upstairs which is a great atmosphere and very much in line with the sense of community in this wonderful city.

reviews.author: zap98
reviews.title: Friendly staff and delicious food
reviews.content: This was the first place we ate in Hanoi as a recommendation of our hotel and we very happy! The staff were really friendly and helped to explain how to eat the food (not in a condescending way at all, very interested in helping you out).
